GitHub Actions completed successfully for head 726fe086. The [TUI workflow run](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/43435057009) succeeded, including no-flicker, component and all three runtime/renderer legs. All scheduled checks reported success. Skipped Windows, macOS and installed-distribution matrix jobs are not passing platform evidence. The earlier Darwin/Bun component interruptions remain unqualified and are not reclassified by this CI result.

This PR is ready for review, with merge order still dependent on #17148 → #15948 → #15950 → #15951. Those prerequisites have not all merged. CI success does not authorize automatic merge or establish final merged-main migration acceptance.

本 PR 已可进入审阅，合并顺序仍依赖 #17148 → #15948 → #15950 → #15951，前置项尚未全部合并。CI 通过不授权自动合并，也不等于最终 merged-main 迁移验收完成。

prs.title: feat(core): resolve the loop switches per surface with env force on/off
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Resolves the two experimental loop switches per surface instead of with one boolean for every surface, and lets the environment variable force a surface on or off. Each switch resolves in order: the environment override when it addresses the surface, else the explicit setting when set, else the surface's built-in default (off everywhere today). The environment variable now accepts `1` and `0` to force every surface on or off, and a comma-separated list such as `headless,acp=0` to force individual surfaces; unknown or malformed tokens are ignored so a list written for a newer CLI cannot break an older one. Each loop entry point names its surface. The setting becomes tri-state at runtime (the CLI stops collapsing unset to false), while the schema default stays until the first surface default flips so the settings dialogs' first-toggle behavior is unchanged. The ACP and TUI parity off arms now force the variable to `0` instead of leaving it unset.

## Why it's needed

The loop rollout (#17045, block B) opens one surface at a time, but a single boolean covered headless, ACP, both TUIs and AgentCore at once, and the environment variable could only force the shared loop on. A default change moved every surface together, and there was no way to force a surface back off from the environment — which the rollout rules require as the switch-back. This is the mechanism that lets a later PR flip one surface's default and only that surface's, and lets a parity arm or a targeted canary force a single surface. It builds on the merged #17050 (the nightly legs that produce the signal each default change waits on).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Resolution module: `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/config/agent-loop-rollout.test.ts` — env unset/blank, `1`/`0` force-all, bare surface name, `surface=0/1` tokens, trimming, unknown/malformed tokens ignored, first-match-wins, hyphenated `agent-core`, and the env > setting > default order.
- Config getters: `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/config/config.test.ts -t "AgentLoop|default tables are independent"` — per-surface default off, constructor param honored, env `1`/`0` overriding the param in both directions, env list forcing only named surfaces, and flipping one switch's surface default leaves the other switch off (per-switch independence).
- CLI wiring: `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/config/config.test.ts -t "agent loop"` — unset passes through as undefined, explicit true/false propagated for both switches.
- Round-2 pins: warn-once env-token dedup is in the resolution-module suite above; whole-set surface assertions via `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/agents/runtime/agent-core.test.ts -t "preserves settled execution status"` and `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/acp-integration/session/Session.test.ts -t "Cron round and records its prompt once sent|Notification round and shows its response once"`; sandbox env forwarding via `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/sandbox.test.ts`.
- Parity suites with the forced off arms: `cd integration-tests && QWEN_SANDBOX=false npx vitest run cli/acp-agent-loop-parity.test.ts` and `cd integration-tests && QWEN_E2E_RENDERER=ink npx vitest run interactive/tui-agent-loop-parity.test.ts`.
- The required-argument getter signature is the safety net: any missed call site fails `npm run typecheck`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (config mechanism and test-harness change; no UI).

Local verification on Linux (Node 24.22.1):

- Build + bundle exit 0 (the cli typecheck passed, so all nine call sites name a valid surface).
- Resolution module 21 passed; Config getters 11 passed; CLI wiring 5 passed; settings docs-sync + schema 70 passed; integration-tests typecheck 0 errors. (R3–R5 added variable-attribution warn-once, per-switch default tables, and the project-env exclusion pin; see the merged-tree line below for the full re-verification.)
- Real CLI probe against a fake OpenAI server with a fresh bundle, eight arms: force-off beats an on setting, list force-off/on, other-surface fall-through, kernel via list, kernel env-`0` force-off, unknown-token fall-through — the `[EVENT_BUS]` kernel marker appears exactly on the kernel arm and all arms return the identical answer.
- ACP parity 25/25 and TUI (ink) parity 24/24 with the forced `0` off arm.
- Mutation witness (byte-level restore verified): removing the force-off branch, ignoring the env override, and removing the surface filter each turn the module tests red (3/3 killed).
- R5: shared-env-keys membership pin added — deleting either loop-switch exclusion literal reds exactly the new pin (54 siblings stay green), byte-level restore verified; settings docs-sync + schema + shared-env-keys 125 passed with the project-env restriction sentence identical in all four copies.
- Merged `main` after #17050 landed and re-verified on the merged tree: build + bundle exit 0, core 1311 passed (resolver 21, config 1067, agent-headless 223), cli 719 passed, headless+ACP parity 42/42, TUI (ink) parity 26/26. Slice 4's CI-failure issues were delivered by #17172 (all five closed as test-harness races, not loop regressions); the design doc records this.
- verify-pr follow-up: M14 fixed (`4445261f72`) — the two core agent-headless off arms now force env `'0'` instead of relying on the built-in default, so a future surface-default flip cannot collapse them to shared-vs-shared. N1 (design-doc draft wording) and N2 (stale counts) corrected; R4-2 cleared by the retarget to `main` (the lint/typecheck/unit/integration gates now run and pass).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Local build + bundle, fake OpenAI server, isolated QWEN_HOME/QWEN_RUNTIME_DIR per run; no sandbox. The TUI parity ran under the ink renderer locally; the OpenTUI renderer is covered by #17050's nightly legs.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the environment variable's `0` now forces off where it was previously inert (only `1` was read). Existing scripts that set `0` intended off, so this aligns with intent; `1` is unchanged. The getter now requires a surface argument — an experimental internal API, and the rollout design prescribes this shape.
- Not validated / out of scope: flipping any surface's built-in default (a later PR), removing the schema default (deferred to the first default flip to keep the dialogs' first-toggle behavior), and the `/about`//`/bug` visibility line (slice 3). The speculation read site in #17029 will pass `speculation` when it rebases onto this signature.
- Coordination with #17048: the bidirectional force-off overlaps with #17048 ("let the loop switches be forced off, not only on", open against `main`). Split by scope, not duplication — this PR owns the per-surface resolution, the `1`/`0` whole-value and comma-list grammar, and the project-`.env` exclusion; #17048 owns the whole-value `true`/`false` spellings and the nightly `current`-leg pin. This PR therefore accepts only `1`/`0` as whole values today, and a `true`/`false` value falls through to the setting until #17048 lands. Whoever lands second reconciles the shared sites (the Config getters, the four settings copies, `e2e.yml`). The `current`-leg pin must land before the first surface default flip; this PR flips no default, so it is safe in either landing order. Recorded in the design doc's Slice 2 and Constraints sections.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none for users; `experimental.unifiedAgentLoop` / `experimental.eventBusAgentLoop` keep their meaning and default.

Design doc: [English](docs/design/2026-11-12-loop-rollout-switches.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-11-12-loop-rollout-switches.zh-CN.md) — both complete and synchronized.

## Linked Issues

Part of #17045 (block B, slice 2 of 4). Retargeted to `main` after #17050 merged. Slice 1 (#17050) is merged; slice 4's CI-failure issues were delivered by #17172; slice 3 (loop visibility) remains.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做什么

把两个实验性 loop 开关改为按入口解析，而不是一个布尔值管所有入口，并让环境变量能把某个入口强制开或关。每个开关按顺序解析：环境变量指向该入口时用环境覆盖，否则用被设置的显式设置，再否则用该入口的内置默认值（今天所有入口都是关）。环境变量现在接受 `1` 和 `0` 强制所有入口开/关，以及逗号分隔的列表（如 `headless,acp=0`）强制指定入口；未知或畸形 token 被忽略，因此为新版 CLI 写的列表不会弄坏旧版。每个 loop 入口写明自己的入口标识。设置在运行时变为三态（CLI 不再把未设置塌缩成 false），而 schema 默认值保留到第一个入口默认值翻转，使设置对话框「第一次切换即开启」的行为不变。ACP 与 TUI 对拍的 off 臂现在把变量强制为 `0` 而不是留空。

## 为什么需要

loop 灰度（#17045 的 B 块）一次放开一个入口，但一个布尔值同时覆盖 headless、ACP、两个 TUI 和 AgentCore，而且环境变量只能强制开启共享 loop。改一次默认值所有入口一起动，也没有办法从环境变量把某个入口强制关回去——而灰度规则要求环境变量作为切回手段。本 PR 提供的机制让后续 PR 能只翻转一个入口的默认值，并让对拍臂或定向金丝雀强制单个入口。它建立在已合入的 #17050（产生每次默认变更所等待信号的 nightly 组）之上。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- 解析模块：`cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/config/agent-loop-rollout.test.ts` —— env 未设置/空白、`1`/`0` 强制全部、裸入口名、`surface=0/1` token、去空白、未知/畸形 token 忽略、首个匹配生效、带连字符的 `agent-core`，以及 env > 设置 > 默认值的顺序。
- Config getter：`cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/config/config.test.ts -t "AgentLoop|default tables are independent"` —— 按入口默认关、构造参数生效、env `1`/`0` 双向覆盖参数、env 列表只强制点名入口，以及翻转一个开关的入口默认值不影响另一开关（按开关独立性）。
- CLI 接线：`cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/config/config.test.ts -t "agent loop"` —— 未设置以 undefined 透传，两个开关的显式 true/false 都传播。
- 第 2 轮钉子：env token 每进程告警一次的去重在上面的解析模块套件里；全量 surface 断言用 `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/agents/runtime/agent-core.test.ts -t "preserves settled execution status"` 与 `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/acp-integration/session/Session.test.ts -t "Cron round and records its prompt once sent|Notification round and shows its response once"`；沙箱 env 转发用 `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/sandbox.test.ts`。
- 强制 off 臂的对拍套件：`cd integration-tests && QWEN_SANDBOX=false npx vitest run cli/acp-agent-loop-parity.test.ts` 与 `cd integration-tests && QWEN_E2E_RENDERER=ink npx vitest run interactive/tui-agent-loop-parity.test.ts`。
- getter 的必选参数签名是安全网：任何漏改的调用点都会让 `npm run typecheck` 失败。

### 证据（改动前后）

N/A（配置机制与测试 harness 改动；无 UI）。

Linux 本地验证（Node 24.22.1）：

- build + bundle exit 0（cli 类型检查通过，故九个调用点都写了合法入口）。
- 解析模块 21 通过；Config getter 11 通过；CLI 接线 5 通过；设置文档同步 + schema 70 通过；integration-tests 类型检查 0 错误。（R3–R5 新增变量归属 warn-once、按开关独立默认表、项目级 env 排除钉；完整复验见下方合并树行。）
- 真实 CLI 探针（fake OpenAI server + 新 bundle）八臂：强制关胜过开启的设置、列表强制关/开、其他入口回退、经列表开内核、内核 env-`0` 强制关、未知 token 回退——`[EVENT_BUS]` 内核标记恰好出现在内核臂，所有臂答案一致。
- 强制 `0` off 臂下 ACP 对拍 25/25、TUI（ink）对拍 24/24。
- 变异见证（字节级还原已验证）：移除强制关分支、忽略 env 覆盖、移除入口过滤，各自把模块测试打红（3/3 杀掉）。
- R5：新增 shared-env-keys 成员钉——删除任一 loop 开关排除字面量恰好把新钉打红（54 个兄弟用例保持绿），字节级还原已验证；设置文档同步 + schema + shared-env-keys 125 通过，项目级拒绝句在四份副本中一致。
- #17050 合入后合并 `main` 并在合并树上复验：build + bundle exit 0、core 1311 通过（resolver 21、config 1067、agent-headless 223）、cli 719 通过、headless+ACP 对拍 42/42、TUI（ink）对拍 26/26。切片 4 的 CI 失败 issue 已由 #17172 交付（五个均按测试 harness 竞态而非 loop 回归关闭）；设计文档已记录。
- verify-pr 后续：M14 已修（`4445261f72`）——两个 core agent-headless off 臂改为强制 env `'0'` 而非依赖内置默认值，未来源式默认翻转不会使其塌成 shared-vs-shared。N1（设计文档 draft 措辞）与 N2（过期计数）已更正；R4-2 随 retarget 到 `main` 清除（lint/typecheck/unit/integration 门禁现已运行并通过）。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ 已测试 |

### 环境（可选）

本地 build + bundle、fake OpenAI server、每次运行隔离 QWEN_HOME/QWEN_RUNTIME_DIR；无沙箱。TUI 对拍本地跑在 ink 渲染器下；OpenTUI 渲染器由 #17050 的 nightly 组覆盖。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：环境变量的 `0` 现在强制关，而此前是惰性的（只读 `1`）。既有设 `0` 的脚本本意就是关，因此与意图一致；`1` 不变。getter 现在需要入口参数——这是实验性内部 API，灰度设计规定了此形状。
- 未验证/范围外：翻转任何入口的内置默认值（后续 PR）、移除 schema 默认值（推迟到首次默认翻转以保留对话框首次切换行为）、`/about`//`/bug` 可见性行（切片 3）。#17029 的 speculation 读取点会在 rebase 到此签名时传 `speculation`。
- 与 #17048 的协调：双向强制关闭与 #17048（「let the loop switches be forced off, not only on」，对 `main` 开启）重叠。按范围分工而非重复——本 PR 负责按入口解析、`1`/`0` 整值与逗号列表文法、项目级 `.env` 排除；#17048 负责整值 `true`/`false` 拼写与 nightly `current` 腿钉住。因此本 PR 今天整值只接受 `1`/`0`，`true`/`false` 值在 #17048 落地前回退到设置。后落地方协调共享站点（Config getter、四份设置副本、`e2e.yml`）。`current` 腿钉住须在第一个入口默认值翻转前落地；本 PR 不翻转任何默认值，故两种落地顺序下都安全。已记录在设计文档的切片 2 与约束小节。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：对用户无；`experimental.unifiedAgentLoop` / `experimental.eventBusAgentLoop` 含义与默认值不变。

设计文档：[English](docs/design/2026-11-12-loop-rollout-switches.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-11-12-loop-rollout-switches.zh-CN.md) —— 两版完整同步。

## 关联 Issue

Part of #17045（B 块，4 个切片中的第 2 个）。#17050 合入后已 retarget 到 `main`。切片 1（#17050）已合入；切片 4 的 CI 失败 issue 已由 #17172 交付；剩切片 3（loop 可见性）。

</details>

prs.title: fix(cli): bound OpenTUI extension dialog content widths
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Keeps extension choice and extension settings content inside the shared OpenTUI dialog width. The remaining change against the integrated main candidate is a focused width fix with six regression cases: two files, 50 additions and 4 deletions. The extension dialog feature itself is already on main.

## Why it's needed

At terminal widths of 80, 120 and 200 columns, both routes previously received content widths of 76, 116 and 196 instead of the dialog's available 72, 96 and 96 columns. This bypassed the shared content budget, especially on wide terminals. This addresses the [maintainer's P1 review](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15950#discussion_r4567427980).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): add the DingTalk adapter on the managed channel path
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds DingTalk as the second provider on the managed channel path, alongside email. The shared adapter contract moves out of the email package into the channel base so both providers and the CLI share it, the adapter union and the core enablement list gain `dingtalk`, and a new managed DingTalk adapter routes inbound robot messages into bound Sessions through the control plane and returns replies through the receipted, multi-segment outbox. A `managed-dingtalk` command wires it up, mirroring `managed-email`. The adapter drives no model; the Java control plane is already provider-agnostic, so this is a TypeScript-only slice. The design document (English + Chinese) is included in this PR.

## Why it's needed

The managed path had exactly one adapter, so the multi-segment delivery capability landed in #17002 was only ever exercised by email. A second real provider proves the contract is genuinely provider-agnostic and surfaces provider-specific durability needs. DingTalk was chosen by product priority. Its stream acks each message on receipt and never redelivers it — unlike email's re-fetchable mailbox — so the pending claim persists the full inbound event and a restart re-drives that exact event. That divergence from email is load-bearing and is documented in the design doc. The outbox failure handling mirrors the email reference so a deterministically refused or unregistered orphan receipt is dropped or re-registered instead of wedging every later delivery.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the deps-injected witnesses (no live provider needed). Inbound: a robot message is admitted once and a redelivery is deduped; a sender outside the allowlist and a non-text message are skipped; over-long text is truncated to the wire's character and byte bounds rather than dropped; a lost admission answer is re-driven without rebuilding the event; a restart re-drives the persisted event with no stream redelivery; a deterministic admission refusal drops the message visibly and never re-drives it; consecutive instance-scoped refusals stall admission (and the stall is restored from the persisted held claim across a restart); an admission refused as not registered re-registers and keeps the event. Outbox: each claimed segment is sent in order and receipted by ordinal; a definitive webhook refusal reports `rejected` and a transient failure reports `unknown`, and neither resends; a non-accepted segment stops the rest of its delivery; a delivery with a missing committed target or no webhook is rejected, as is a reply to a disallowed sender; the newest learned webhook is used; a persisted receipt replays on restart instead of settling `unknown`. Failure handling: a deterministically refused orphan receipt is dropped without blocking the entries behind it, and an orphan receipt refused as not registered re-registers on the next tick and then settles. The load-bearing rules are pinned by mutation-verified witnesses; the remaining coverage gaps are tracked in #17173.

Commands and results: `cd packages/channels/dingtalk && npx vitest run` → 906 passed; email suite → 82 passed; `packages/core` managed-channel-record → 151 passed; CLI `managed-dingtalk` + `managed-email` → 4 passed; full `npm run typecheck` clean; ESLint and Prettier clean on all changed files.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — non-UI change (adapter, shared contract, and command).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

Locally verified on macOS; CI covers all three platforms.

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only, with deps-injected fakes for the stream client, webhook transport, lock, and control plane. No live DingTalk tenant is required; a live-tenant smoke is a follow-up, not a merge gate.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the inbound stream is ack-once, so a crash before the inbox drains loses the acked-but-unadmitted messages still in memory (bounded by the 256-entry inbox) — the provider's inherent at-most-once window, matching the Legacy DingTalk adapter. Once a claim is admitted it is durable: a restart replays the same event or reports the same segment `unknown`, never a second input and never a second send.
- Not validated / out of scope: live-tenant smoke; DingTalk interactive/card surfaces (H5e); attachment kinds beyond inline staging; proactive sends and automation (H6). The Legacy `DingtalkChannel`'s behavior is unchanged — the only Legacy edit extracts the connect-logging credential guard into a shared module so it has one copy; the managed adapter is a separate implementation that reuses the provider mechanics, not the Legacy class.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none for email — the contract move is behavior-preserving and email's suites stay green unchanged. Enablement adds `dingtalk` without removing `email`. No Java control-plane change is required.

Design document: [English](docs/design/2026-11-13-managed-channel-dingtalk-adapter.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-11-13-managed-channel-dingtalk-adapter.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Part of #12827 (slice H5d, second adapter). Builds on the multi-segment producer #17002 (merged) and the per-segment delivery ledger #16797 hardened by #16818.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

在托管通道路径上，继 email 之后新增 DingTalk 作为第二个 provider。共享适配器契约从 email 包移入 channel base，使两个 provider 与 CLI 共用；适配器联合类型与 core 启用列表加入 `dingtalk`；新增一个托管 DingTalk 适配器，把入站机器人消息经控制面路由进绑定的 Session，并通过带回执的多分段 outbox 返回回复。`managed-dingtalk` 命令将其接线，仿照 `managed-email`。适配器不驱动模型；Java 控制面本就与 provider 无关，因此这是一个纯 TypeScript 切片。设计文档（英文 + 中文）随本 PR 一并提交。

## 为什么需要

托管路径此前只有一个适配器，因此 #17002 落地的多分段投递能力只被 email 验证过。第二个真实 provider 证明契约确实与 provider 无关，并暴露 provider 特有的持久化需求。DingTalk 按产品优先级选定。它的流在收到每条消息时即 ack、绝不再投递——不像 email 的信箱可重拉——因此待决领取持久化完整的入站事件，重启重驱的正是这条事件。这一与 email 的分歧是承重的，已写入设计文档。outbox 失败处理沿用 email 参考实现：确定性拒绝或未注册的孤儿回执会被丢弃或重注册，而不是楔死其后的所有投递。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

运行 deps 注入的见证（无需真实 provider）。入站：一条机器人消息被准入一次、重投递被去重；允许名单之外的发送者与非文本消息被跳过；超长文本被截断到线上的字符与字节上界而非丢弃；丢失的准入应答被重驱且不重建事件；重启后在没有流重投递的情况下重驱持久化事件；确定性准入拒绝可见地丢弃消息且绝不重驱；连续实例级拒绝停滞准入（且该停滞在重启后从持久化的 held 领取恢复）；被拒为未注册的准入重注册并保留事件。outbox：每个领取的分段按序发送并按 ordinal 回执；确定性 webhook 拒绝报 `rejected`、瞬时失败报 `unknown`，二者都不重发；非 accepted 的分段停下其投递的其余分段；缺失提交目标或无 webhook 的投递被拒绝，回复不允许的发送者同样被拒绝；使用最新学到的 webhook；持久化回执在重启后重放而非落 `unknown`。失败处理：确定性拒绝的孤儿回执被丢弃且不阻塞其后的条目；被拒为未注册的孤儿回执在下一 tick 重注册后落定。承重规则均由经变异验证的见证钉住；其余覆盖缺口记录于 #17173。

命令与结果：`cd packages/channels/dingtalk && npx vitest run` → 906 通过；email 套件 → 82 通过；`packages/core` managed-channel-record → 151 通过；CLI `managed-dingtalk` + `managed-email` → 4 通过；全量 `npm run typecheck` 干净；所有变更文件 ESLint 与 Prettier 干净。

### 证据（Before & After）

N/A —— 非 UI 变更（适配器、共享契约与命令）。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

本地在 macOS 验证；CI 覆盖全部三个平台。

### 环境（可选）

仅单元测试，流客户端、webhook 传输、锁与控制面均用 deps 注入的 fake。无需真实 DingTalk 租户；真实租户冒烟属后续工作，不是合入门禁。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险 / 权衡：入站流是 ack-once，inbox 排空前崩溃会丢失仍在内存中已 ack 未准入的消息（以 256 条 inbox 为上限）——这是 provider 固有的 at-most-once 窗口，与 Legacy DingTalk 适配器一致。一旦领取被准入即持久化：重启重放同一事件或把同一段报 `unknown`，绝不二次入站、绝不二次发送。
- 未验证 / 范围外：真实租户冒烟；DingTalk 交互 / 卡片界面（H5e）；内联暂存之外的附件类型；主动发送与自动化（H6）。Legacy `DingtalkChannel` 的行为不变——对 Legacy 的唯一改动是把 connect-logging 凭据守卫抽到共享模块、使其只有一份；托管适配器是复用 provider 机制的独立实现，而非 Legacy 类。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：对 email 无破坏——契约移动保持行为不变，email 套件原样全绿。启用列表加入 `dingtalk` 而不移除 `email`。无需 Java 控制面变更。

prs.title: feat(channels): fold superseded watch events and digest startup comment backlog
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When a GitHub channel with bound-session delivery restarts after a downtime gap, two things now happen that did not before. First, watch events whose facts have been superseded are retired visibly instead of delivered: a CI-failure event for a head that has since been replaced, a merge-conflict event after the conflict was resolved, and intermediate head hops are folded into the net change (a round trip back to the original head retires the hop instead of announcing a move from a SHA to itself). This covers both queued events and parked backpressure tasks — the dominant stale path, since detection claims events immediately and a full session prompt queue parks them to retry across restarts. Every retirement writes a dead-letter record and a journal row; a failed dead-letter write keeps the event queued, and a recovery pass that finds an already dead-lettered task completes the retirement instead of delivering it. Second, the channel stamps a heartbeat into its poll cursor and, when the first poll after startup sees a gap above a threshold (ten minutes, or five poll intervals, whichever is larger), the first complete watch pass delivers each bound PR's same-account comment backlog as ONE private summary prompt — total count, the newest twenty excerpts with links, and a visible omission notice — instead of one prompt per comment. The summary keeps the comment event class, so role routing, authorship exclusion, dedupe, and cursor crash-safety behave exactly as individual deliveries do.

State events stay individual (at most four per PR after a gap, each describing the current state), the notification lane is untouched, and no new configuration keys are introduced. The bilingual design document explains why bundling state events into the summary would regress role-template routing and why the comment lane is the only unbounded flood source.

## Why it's needed

After an overnight stop or a long outage, bound PR sessions were flooded with stale prompts: every comment created during the gap arrived as its own model turn, and CI-failure events for heads that had already been replaced kept retrying out of the backpressure queue for up to the four-hour deferral horizon. Each stale prompt costs a model turn and can trigger work on already-resolved state. The delivery contract deliberately treats restart re-injection as correct recovery and forbids silent consumption, so this change keeps every retirement visible and every current fact deliverable while removing the stale and the duplicated.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Unit tests (33 new cases in the bound-session watch suite, all collocated): from the repository root run `cd packages/channels/github && npx vitest run src/GithubAdapter.test.ts -t 'startup backlog'`. They cover each folding rule on both queued events and parked tasks (including the fail-closed dead-letter write, unknown-SHA and null-mergeable non-folding, in-flight/delivered/non-backpressure tasks never folded, the round-trip retirement and its write-failure fallback, legacy pending items without the new coalescing field), recovery completing a dead-lettered task (legacy and role-aware), heartbeat validation and clock skew, gap threshold scaling with the poll interval, digest bundling with member dedupe, union authorship exclusion (single-target and role-aware), the 25-member omission notice, inline review locations, excerpt truncation, cursor hold on a refused dispatch, gate grace under the digest, digest-mode retention across an aborted pass, and first-observation silence under a gap. The full package suite passes: `cd packages/channels/github && npx vitest run` (1005 tests).

End-to-end (hermetic mock GitHub + isolated daemon, two-stage restart fixture): boot the daemon, bind a session to a PR, let the silent baseline form, stop the daemon, rewrite the comment cursor and the heartbeat to simulate a one-hour gap, reboot, and count the prompts in the session transcript. Before this change the gap arm delivered five separate comment prompts; after it delivers one summary containing all five excerpts and links, with every member dedupe key recorded. A no-gap control still delivers five individual prompts; a backpressure arm (full prompt queue, CI red then head advance) shows the stale CI-failure task retired with a `superseded: head advanced` dead-letter record and no stale prompt; a first-observation-under-gap arm stays silent. The fixture script and per-run result snapshots are available on request; the full plan lives in the local E2E test plan referenced by the design document.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before (global 0.27.3 baseline, same fixture): gap arm = 5 bound prompts, one per comment; backpressure arm = stale `watch:ci_failure` task parked with a growing deferral count, surviving the head advance.

After (local build): gap arm = 1 bound prompt beginning `Offline backlog: 5 new comment(s) on the PR while this channel was not running:` with all five excerpts and comment URLs; backpressure arm = dead-letter record `reason: "superseded: head advanced"` naming the stale key, task store holding only the current head-change event, zero stale prompts. No-gap and first-observation arms unchanged.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Node v24.22.1; `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run bundle` all exit 0; E2E ran against `node dist/cli.js` with an isolated `QWEN_HOME` and a local mock GitHub (no real GitHub traffic).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a digest excerpt cap can hide an actionable comment behind the omission notice; the notice names the remedy (list the PR comments) and the shared bound-prompt body ceiling still caps the final text visibly. The alternative is the prompt flood this change removes.
- Not validated / out of scope: the notification lane's other-account backlog keeps today's behavior (it already batches per thread and carries the highest-risk mark-read/publication contract); events still queued in `pending` at shutdown drain before the first detection can fold them (bounded, current at detection time); macOS/Windows not tested locally.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The new cursor heartbeat and the new pending-item coalescing field are additive; legacy state loads unchanged and the upgrade poll does not fabricate a gap. The bound-session-events acceptance "every transition instance produces exactly one injected prompt" is amended to "…or one visible superseded retirement"; legitimate recurrences still fire.

Design document: [English](docs/design/2026-11-14-bound-delivery-startup-backlog.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-11-14-bound-delivery-startup-backlog.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

N/A

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

启用绑定会话投递的 GitHub channel 在停机缺口后重启时，现在会有两个此前没有的行为。其一，事实已被取代的 watch 事件被可见地退役而非投递：head 已被取代的 CI 失败事件、冲突已解决的合并冲突事件、中间 head 跳变被折叠为净变化（往返回到原始 head 时退役该跳变，而不是宣告从某个 SHA 移动到它自身）。这同时覆盖排队事件与停放的背压任务——后者是过期主路径，因为检测立即认领事件，会话 prompt 队列满时将其停放并跨重启重试。每次退役都写死信记录与 journal 行；死信写失败则事件留队；恢复回合遇到已死信的任务时完成退役而非投递。其二，channel 在 poll 游标中盖章心跳，启动后首个 poll 发现缺口超过阈值（10 分钟与 5 个 poll 间隔取大）时，首个完整 watch pass 把每个绑定 PR 的同账号评论积压作为一条私有摘要 prompt 投递——总条数、最新 20 条摘录与链接、可见的省略提示——而非每条评论一条。摘要保持 comment 事件类别，角色路由、归属排除、去重与游标崩溃安全性与逐条投递完全一致。

状态事件保持逐条（缺口后每 PR 至多四条，各描述当前状态），通知 lane 不动，不新增配置键。双语设计文档解释了为何把状态事件并入摘要会回归角色模板路由、以及为何评论车道是唯一无界洪泛源。

## 为什么需要

停一夜或长时间故障后，绑定 PR 会话被过期 prompt 轰炸：缺口期间的每条评论各成为一个模型回合，已被取代 head 的 CI 失败事件从背压队列里持续重试直到四小时推迟视界。每条过期 prompt 消耗一个模型回合，并可能触发对已解决状态的工作。投递契约刻意把重启后重新注入视为正确恢复并禁止静默消费，因此本改动在移除过期与重复的同时，保持每次退役可见、每个当前事实可投递。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

单元测试（绑定会话 watch 套件新增 33 个用例，全部 collocated）：仓库根执行 `cd packages/channels/github && npx vitest run src/GithubAdapter.test.ts -t 'startup backlog'`。覆盖每种折叠规则在排队事件与停放任务两种形态（含死信写 fail-closed、unknown-SHA 与 null-mergeable 不折叠、在途/已投递/非背压任务绝不折叠、往返退役及其写失败回退、缺合并字段的遗留 pending）、恢复完成已死信任务（legacy 与角色感知）、心跳校验与时钟偏移、缺口阈值随 poll 间隔缩放、digest 打包与成员去重、归属并集排除（单目标与角色感知）、25 成员省略提示、行内评审位置、摘录截断、dispatch 被拒时游标保持、digest 下的 gate 宽限、abort 后 digest 模式保留、缺口下首次观测静默。包全套件通过：`cd packages/channels/github && npx vitest run`（1005 个用例）。

端到端（封闭 mock GitHub + 隔离 daemon，两阶段重启夹具）：启动 daemon、绑定会话到 PR、待静默基线形成、停 daemon、重写评论游标与心跳模拟一小时缺口、重启、统计会话 transcript 的 prompt。改动前缺口臂投递五条独立评论 prompt；改动后投递一条含全部五条摘录与链接的摘要，且记录每个成员去重键。无缺口对照仍投递五条独立 prompt；背压臂（prompt 队列满、CI 变红后 head 前进）显示过期 CI 失败任务以 `superseded: head advanced` 死信记录退役、无过期 prompt；缺口下首次观测臂保持静默。夹具脚本与逐次结果快照可按需提供；完整计划见设计文档引用的本地 E2E 测试计划。

### 证据（改动前后）

改动前（全局 0.27.3 基线，同一夹具）：缺口臂 = 5 条绑定 prompt，每条评论一条；背压臂 = 过期 `watch:ci_failure` 任务停放、推迟计数增长、在 head 前进后存活。

改动后（本地构建）：缺口臂 = 1 条绑定 prompt，以 `Offline backlog: 5 new comment(s) on the PR while this channel was not running:` 开头，含全部五条摘录与评论 URL；背压臂 = 死信记录 `reason: "superseded: head advanced"` 点名过期 key，任务存储仅存当前 head-change 事件，零过期 prompt。无缺口与首次观测臂不变。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

Node v24.22.1；`npm run build`、`npm run typecheck`、`npm run bundle` 均 exit 0；E2E 对 `node dist/cli.js` 运行，隔离 `QWEN_HOME` 与本地 mock GitHub（无真实 GitHub 流量）。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：digest 摘录上限可能把一条可操作评论藏在省略提示之后；提示点名补救方式（列出 PR 评论），共享 bound prompt 正文上限仍对最终文本可见封顶。替代方案正是本改动移除的 prompt 洪泛。
- 未验证/范围外：通知 lane 的异账号积压保持现状（已按线程批处理，且携带风险最高的 mark-read/发布契约）；停机时仍在 `pending` 的事件在首次检测可折叠前排空（有界、检测时当前）；macOS/Windows 未本地测试。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无。新游标心跳与新 pending 合并字段均为增量；遗留状态原样加载，升级 poll 不伪造缺口。bound-session-events 验收「每个迁移实例恰好产生一条注入 prompt」修订为「……或一次可见的被取代退役」；合法复发仍会 fire。

设计文档：[English](docs/design/2026-11-14-bound-delivery-startup-backlog.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-11-14-bound-delivery-startup-backlog.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

无

</details>

prs.title: fix(cli): bound provider-warning URL sanitizing to the URL authority
prs.body:
## What this PR does

`sanitizeProviderWarning` stripped credentials from `/status` provider warnings with two bespoke `indexOf` heuristics over the whole warning segment, with no notion of where the URL authority ends. The warning path now delegates to `sanitizeProviderBaseUrl` for each URL segment, and the authority it computes now ends at whitespace.

## Why it's needed

Both forms of the report follow from the missing authority bound:

- A URL with an explicit port inside prose lost everything after it:
  `Cannot reach https://api.example:8443/v1 — contact admin@example.com`
  became `Cannot reach https://example.com`. The colon of `:8443` was read as the start of a password, and the `@` of the contact address as its end — so the port, the path, the em-dash and the word "contact" were all deleted.
- An `@` inside a password leaked the remainder of that password:
  `Failed loading provider https://user:p@ssw0rd-tail@broken.example/v1` kept
  `ssw0rd-tail@broken.example/v1`, because `indexOf('@')` stopped at the `@` inside the userinfo.

`sanitizeProviderBaseUrl` already computes the authority end and takes the last `@` *within* the authority; it had only ever been reached from the fallback branch that the heuristics pre-empted. The warning path now delegates to it for each URL segment, and the warning-specific helpers (`sanitizeProviderWarningSegment`, `hasCredentialPrefix`, `URL_LIKE_PATTERN`) are deleted.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Delegating alone is not enough. The segment splitter deliberately runs past the URL so a password holding a raw space stays intact, which means a pathless URL followed by prose is handed over whole — and `findAuthorityEnd` only stopped at `/`, `?`, `#`, so the "authority" claimed the rest of the line and a later `@` in an email address was read as userinfo. `findAuthorityEnd` now also ends the authority at whitespace, which cannot appear in a URL. A space that sits after the userinfo colon and before the authority's only `@` is still treated as part of the password, so the space-in-password shape keeps stripping correctly.

```sh
cd packages/cli
npx vitest run src/utils/acpModelUtils.test.ts src/serve/workspace-providers-status.test.ts
```

### Evidence (Before & After)

The four new cases were checked against the unfixed source first and fail there (`4 failed | 98 passed`); with the change the two files report 102 passing tests. The before/after for the two warning shapes is quoted verbatim above.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only; no dev server or sandbox.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the warning path and the base-URL path now share one authority computation, so a change to `findAuthorityEnd` affects both. The whitespace bound is the only behavioural addition and is covered by the new cases.
- Not validated / out of scope: full `npm run build`, the full test suite, and a package-level `tsc --noEmit`. In this fresh worktree the package typecheck fails on `TS6305` for unbuilt `packages/core` output, unrelated to these files. ESLint and Prettier are clean on the changed files.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #8136


<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

`sanitizeProviderWarning` 原先用两个自制的 `indexOf` 启发式，在整段警告文本上剥离 `/status` 里的 provider 凭据，完全没有「URL 的 authority 到哪里结束」的概念。现在警告路径对每个 URL 片段改用 `sanitizeProviderBaseUrl`，并且它计算出的 authority 会在空白字符处结束。

## 为什么需要

上报的两种形态都源于缺失的 authority 边界：

- 正文里带显式端口的 URL，其后内容全被删掉：
  `Cannot reach https://api.example:8443/v1 — contact admin@example.com`
  变成 `Cannot reach https://example.com`。`:8443` 的冒号被当成密码开头，联系邮箱的 `@` 被当成密码结尾，于是端口、路径、破折号和 "contact" 一词全被删除。
- 密码里的 `@` 泄露了该密码的剩余部分：
  `Failed loading provider https://user:p@ssw0rd-tail@broken.example/v1` 保留了
  `ssw0rd-tail@broken.example/v1`，因为 `indexOf('@')` 停在了 userinfo 内部的 `@`。

`sanitizeProviderBaseUrl` 本来就会计算 authority 的结束位置，并取 authority *内部*的最后一个 `@`；它此前只从被启发式抢先的兜底分支里被调用。现在警告路径对每个 URL 片段都委托给它，警告专用的辅助函数（`sanitizeProviderWarningSegment`、`hasCredentialPrefix`、`URL_LIKE_PATTERN`）已删除。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### 如何验证

只做委托还不够。片段切分器会刻意越过 URL，以便保持含空格的密码完整，这意味着后面跟正文的无路径 URL 会整体交给它——而 `findAuthorityEnd` 原先只在 `/`、`?`、`#` 处停止，于是「authority」把该行剩余内容全占了，后面邮箱地址里的 `@` 被当成 userinfo。`findAuthorityEnd` 现在也在空白字符处结束 authority，而空白不可能出现在 URL 里。位于 userinfo 冒号之后、且在该 authority 唯一 `@` 之前的空格仍按密码的一部分处理，所以含空格的密码形态仍能正确剥离。

```sh
cd packages/cli
npx vitest run src/utils/acpModelUtils.test.ts src/serve/workspace-providers-status.test.ts
```

### Evidence (Before & After)

新增的四个用例先在未修复的源码上验证过会失败（`4 failed | 98 passed`）；改动后两个文件共 102 个测试通过。上面引用的两种警告形态即前后对照。

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

仅单元测试；没有启动 dev server 或沙箱。

## Risk & Scope

- 主要风险或取舍：警告路径和 base URL 路径现在共用同一套 authority 计算，因此改动 `findAuthorityEnd` 会同时影响两者。空白边界是唯一的行为增量，已由新用例覆盖。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：完整 `npm run build`、全量测试套件，以及包级 `tsc --noEmit`。在这个新 worktree 里，包类型检查会因 `packages/core` 未构建产物报 `TS6305`，与这些文件无关。改动文件的 ESLint 与 Prettier 干净。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## Linked Issues

Fixes #8136

</details>

prs.title: feat(channels): add WeCom group webhook delivery
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds WeCom group Message Push as a send-only Channel alongside the existing intelligent-bot and callback-application integrations. Users configure a named Channel with its secret group webhook URL, start it locally, and deliver Notify, explicit prompt results or supported scheduled-task results to its configured group.

Messages use Markdown V2 with the original content, including tables and fenced code. The adapter validates the official endpoint and its key, enforces the 4096 UTF-8-byte content limit, checks HTTP and WeCom business responses, and follows the existing workspace proxy, bounded-request and shutdown lifecycle. The current logical target and delivery-error contracts are reused.

This is the backend part of #17215. A separate dependent Web PR will expose the connection method in the shared Web Shell. Both PRs remain Draft.

## Why it's needed

The existing WeCom integrations require intelligent-bot or application setup. Users who only want task results posted to an internal group cannot use its Message Push URL, although DingTalk and Feishu already support the equivalent send-only flow. This fills that platform gap within the established Channel framework.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Follow the [WeCom Webhook Sending guide](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/wecom-webhook-channel/docs/users/features/channels/wecom-webhook.md) to configure a named `wecom-webhook` Channel with a literal or environment-backed URL. Confirm ordinary configuration readback hides the credential and that starting creates no remote message or conversational session.
2. Send a short Markdown result through the existing configured-group destination, or let a persistent scheduled task fire. Confirm the target needs no observed contact or manual platform ID, tables/code remain in the content, and the task retains only the logical destination.
3. Check the 4096-byte content boundary, invalid endpoints and remote failures. Oversized content must fail before sending; HTTP 200 with a nonzero business error must also fail, without exposing the key or provider text.
4. Stop during an in-flight request, then restart or reload after replacing the URL. Confirm cancellation drains requests and subsequent deliveries use the updated destination. Existing intelligent-bot and Callback behavior should be unchanged.

### Evidence (Before & After)

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| The built-in catalog lacks `wecom-webhook`; creation returns `channel_settings_unmanageable`. | The type is manageable, exposes a sensitive URL and configured group, and delivers through the existing worker. |
| A WeCom group Message Push URL cannot receive a scheduled result. | A real local cron firing reaches a local HTTPS fixture through the workspace proxy with the exact Markdown V2 result. |

Validation at `8589ad0d`: full build, typecheck and CLI bundle passed; 285 WeCom tests (including existing intelligent-bot and callback coverage) and 73 registry tests passed. Full-repository Prettier, changed-file ESLint, lockfile validation and two clean self-audit passes completed; an independent review found no actionable issues.

The packaged CLI runtime check passed on its first run: 31 delivery attempts, 24 HTTPS POSTs through 24 local CONNECT tunnels, seven pre-send rejections and one real scheduled firing with one mock-model response. It covered ASCII/Chinese/emoji/JSON-escaping byte boundaries, business and HTTP errors, response bounds, secret redaction, cancellation, URL replacement, restart/reload and scheduled-target round trips. Zero external connection attempts occurred, and all recorded processes/listeners were stopped. This is local integration evidence, not a real WeCom tenant test.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ Not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ Tested |

### Environment (optional)

Node.js 24, repository-pinned pnpm, built CLI daemon/worker, a loopback mock model and a local HTTPS receiver behind a workspace-configured CONNECT proxy. The baseline used the previously built CLI because no global `qwen` was installed; the post-change run used this branch's build.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: WeCom limits content to 4096 UTF-8 bytes and 20 messages/minute per webhook; oversized or throttled deliveries fail explicitly. Timeout/cancellation can leave remote acceptance unknown.
- Not validated / out of scope: real WeCom credentials, client Markdown rendering and mention-notification behavior await live E2E. No new test-send UI/API, retry queue, automatic splitting, configurable mentions, media or inbound events are added. Existing manual-trigger/per-run semantics remain in effect.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Existing WeCom modes and saved delivery targets retain their formats. The Web configuration entry is delivered separately.

The complete design is available in [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/wecom-webhook-channel/docs/design/2026-11-14-wecom-webhook-delivery.md) and [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/wecom-webhook-channel/docs/design/2026-11-14-wecom-webhook-delivery.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Part of #17215. This backend PR does not close the issue; the dependent Web integration completes the user flow. Error reporting follows the current contract coordinated by #7521.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

在现有企业微信智能机器人和自建应用回调之外，新增群「消息推送」仅发送频道。用户为命名频道配置敏感群 Webhook URL、在本地启动后，即可向配置群投递 Notify、显式提示词结果或支持的定时任务结果。

消息使用 Markdown V2 保留原始正文，包括表格和围栏代码。适配器校验官方地址及 key，执行 4096 UTF-8 字节正文限制，检查 HTTP 与企业微信业务响应，并沿用既有工作区代理、请求边界和停止生命周期。复用当前逻辑目标及投递错误契约。

这是 #17215 的后端部分。独立且依赖本 PR 的 Web PR 将在共享 Web Shell 中提供该连接方式。两份 PR 均保持 Draft。

## 为什么需要

现有企业微信接入需要配置智能机器人或应用。仅需将任务结果发到内部群的用户无法使用群「消息推送」URL，而钉钉和飞书已支持同类仅发送流程。本 PR 在既有频道框架内补齐这一平台能力。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 按[企业微信 Webhook 发送指南](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/wecom-webhook-channel/docs/users/features/channels/wecom-webhook.md)创建命名的 `wecom-webhook` 频道，URL 可直接配置或引用环境变量。确认普通配置回读隐藏凭证，启动不会发送远端消息或创建会话。
2. 通过既有配置群目标发送简短 Markdown，或等待持久会话定时任务实际触发。确认目标不需要已观察联系人或手动平台 ID，正文保留表格和代码，任务只保存逻辑目标。
3. 验证 4096 字节正文边界、无效地址及远端失败。超长正文应在发送前失败；HTTP 200 但业务错误码非零也应失败，且不暴露 key 或平台错误原文。
4. 在请求进行中停止频道，然后替换 URL 并重启或重载。确认取消会等待请求排空，后续投递使用新目标。既有智能机器人与 Callback 行为应保持不变。

### 证据（改动前后）

| 改动前 | 改动后 |
| --- | --- |
| 内置目录没有 `wecom-webhook`；创建返回 `channel_settings_unmanageable`。 | 新类型可管理，提供敏感 URL 和配置群，并通过既有 worker 投递。 |
| 企业微信群「消息推送」URL 无法接收定时结果。 | 真实本地 cron 触发经工作区代理到达本地 HTTPS 模拟端点，Markdown V2 正文完全一致。 |

在 `8589ad0d` 上验证通过：完整 build、typecheck 和 CLI bundle；285 项企业微信测试（包括原有智能机器人和回调覆盖）；73 项注册表测试。全仓 Prettier、改动文件 ESLint、锁文件校验及两轮干净自审已完成，独立审查未发现需处理的问题。

打包 CLI 的运行时验证首次运行通过：31 次投递尝试，24 次 HTTPS POST 均经过本地 CONNECT 代理，7 次在发送前拒绝；真实定时器触发一次，模拟模型响应一次。覆盖 ASCII/中文/emoji/JSON 转义字节边界、业务及 HTTP 错误、响应上限、凭证脱敏、取消、URL 替换、重启/重载和定时目标往返。外网连接尝试为零，全部记录进程及监听器均已停止。这是本地集成证据，不是真实企业微信租户测试。

### 测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ 已测试 |

### 环境（可选）

Node.js 24、仓库固定版本 pnpm、已构建 CLI daemon/worker、本地模拟模型，以及位于工作区 CONNECT 代理后的本地 HTTPS 接收端。环境没有全局 `qwen`，所以基线使用此前构建的 CLI；改动后使用本分支构建。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：企业微信每条正文最多 4096 UTF-8 字节，每个 Webhook 每分钟最多 20 条；超长或限流会明确失败。超时/取消可能无法确定远端是否已接受。
- 未验证或范围之外：真实企业微信凭证、客户端 Markdown 呈现及 mention 通知行为待真实 E2E。不新增测试发送 UI/API、重试队列、自动分片、可配置 mentions、媒体或入站事件，既有手动触发/每次新会话语义保持不变。
- 兼容性与迁移：无破坏性变更。现有企业微信方式和已保存投递目标格式不变；Web 配置入口单独交付。

完整设计包括[英文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/wecom-webhook-channel/docs/design/2026-11-14-wecom-webhook-delivery.md)和[中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/wecom-webhook-channel/docs/design/2026-11-14-wecom-webhook-delivery.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 Issue

实现 #17215 的一部分。本后端 PR 不关闭 issue，依赖它的 Web 集成补齐用户流程。错误处理沿用 #7521 协调的现有契约。

</details>

prs.title: test(integration): deflake the maximum export document budget (#17203)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Widens the maximum transcript-document browser gate's wall-clock budget on the shared self-hosted ARM64 pool, where the case has crossed its 60-second ceiling under contention, while GitHub-hosted CI and local runs keep the tight 60-second ceiling so a real regression still fails fast.

The explicit 90-second per-case timeout is removed so the case inherits the integration suite's five-minute default. Keeping it would have capped the widened 180-second budget at 90 seconds and moved the same flake from the budget assertion to an opaque test timeout. No assertion, input, or document interaction changes.

## Why it's needed

CI run 43510551946 attempt 1 ran the gate on self-hosted runner `ecs-qwen-hz1-11`; the maximum-document case measured 60,868ms against the 60,000ms budget and failed, while the other five cases in the file passed. Attempt 2 on `ecs-qwen-hz2-17` passed the same gate in 54 seconds, confirming the failure was nondeterministic rather than a deterministic renderer regression.

The same pool has crossed this ceiling before: a 73-second transcript-gate run is recorded in the workflow's own history, and #17158 measured 68.4 seconds. A hard 60-second wall-clock assertion is therefore too tight for this host class, while remaining useful as a hang and pathological-slowdown guard.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the transcript browser gate (`npx vitest run --root ./integration-tests ./chat-transcript-document.test.ts --retry=0`) and confirm all six cases pass. On a self-hosted runner (`RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT=self-hosted`) the maximum-document case is allowed 180 seconds; everywhere else it is allowed 60 seconds. The new unit test pins both tiers, and no rendered output or assertion should change.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: on `ecs-qwen-hz1-11` the case measured 60,868ms and failed the 60,000ms budget; on the rerun host it passed. After: the full file passes 6/6 locally and with `RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT=self-hosted`; the target case completes in about 21.3–21.5 seconds on this host, leaving ample headroom on the 60-second tier and 180 seconds on the pool that flaked. The CI run metadata above is the failing-before evidence; the 6/6 runs are the after evidence.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22 with Playwright Chromium on Linux. The browser gate was run with `npx vitest run --root ./integration-tests ./chat-transcript-document.test.ts --retry=0`; the CI failure is timing-specific to the shared self-hosted pool.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: on self-hosted hosts a slowdown that pushes the gate to between 60 and 180 seconds no longer fails. The ceiling remains a hang and pathological-regression guard, local and hosted CI keep the tight 60-second tier, and the witness test pins both tiers plus the suite-timeout bound.
- Not validated / out of scope: macOS and Windows do not run this browser gate; the exact loaded-host timing cannot be reproduced locally.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #17203

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

在共享自托管 ARM64 池上放宽最大 transcript 文档浏览器门禁的实际耗时预算；该用例在资源竞争下已多次越过 60 秒上限。GitHub 托管 CI 和本地运行仍保留严格的 60 秒上限，使真正的回归仍能快速失败。

移除了用例显式的 90 秒超时，使其继承集成测试套件默认的 5 分钟上限。保留该超时会把放宽后的 180 秒预算压回 90 秒，让同一个 flake 从预算断言失败变成不透明的测试超时。没有修改任何断言、输入或文档交互。

## 为什么需要

CI 运行 43510551946 第 1 次尝试在自托管 runner `ecs-qwen-hz1-11` 上运行门禁；最大文档用例实测 60,868 毫秒，超过 60,000 毫秒预算并失败，而同文件其余 5 个用例均通过。第 2 次尝试在 `ecs-qwen-hz2-17` 上以 54 秒通过同一门禁，确认该失败是非确定性的，而不是确定性的渲染器回归。

同一个池此前也越过该上限：工作流自身的历史记录中留有一次 73 秒的 transcript 门禁运行，#17158 还测到过 68.4 秒。因此，固定的 60 秒实际耗时断言对该主机类型过于严格，但作为挂起和病态变慢的守卫仍然有用。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

运行 transcript 浏览器门禁（`npx vitest run --root ./integration-tests ./chat-transcript-document.test.ts --retry=0`），确认 6 个用例全部通过。在自托管 runner 上（`RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT=self-hosted`），最大文档用例允许 180 秒；其他环境允许 60 秒。新增的单元测试钉住两个分层，渲染输出和断言均不应变化。

### 证据（修改前与修改后）

修改前：在 `ecs-qwen-hz1-11` 上该用例实测 60,868 毫秒，未通过 60,000 毫秒预算；在重跑主机上通过。修改后：完整文件在本地和 `RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT=self-hosted` 下均 6/6 通过；目标用例在本机约耗时 21.3–21.5 秒，在 60 秒分层和发生 flake 的 180 秒池上都有充足余量。上文的 CI 运行元数据是修改前的失败证据；6/6 运行是修改后的证据。

### 测试环境

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

Linux 上的 Node 22 和 Playwright Chromium。浏览器门禁通过 `npx vitest run --root ./integration-tests ./chat-transcript-document.test.ts --retry=0` 运行；CI 失败是共享自托管池特有的时序问题。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：在自托管主机上，把门禁拖慢到 60 至 180 秒之间的回归不再失败。该上限仍是挂起和病态回归的守卫，本地和托管 CI 仍保留严格的 60 秒分层，见证测试钉住两个分层以及套件超时边界。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：macOS 和 Windows 不运行此浏览器门禁；无法在本地复现完全相同的负载主机时序。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #17203

</details>

prs.title: feat(core): run speculation's model rounds through the shared agent loop
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Moves speculation's model rounds onto the shared agent loop, behind the existing `experimental.unifiedAgentLoop` setting. This is PR 6a of the unified-agent-loop program (#15327), reusing the `Turn`-backed model round (`ModelRoundSource` / `turnModelRound`) that the AgentCore migration (#16880) introduced. With the setting on, each speculative round is sent on `runModelRound` over `turnModelRound(chat, model)` and the visible-text and function-call parts are rebuilt from the round's typed events; with it off, the original raw-chunk parsing is kept verbatim. Speculation's tool gate, direct tool execution, copy-on-write overlay writes and boundary handling are untouched. The bilingual design doc gains a speculation section and the migration table splits PR 6 into 6a/6b.

## Why it's needed

Speculation is one of the loops that still calls `LlmChat.sendMessageStream` directly and parses its own chunks. The program converges every surface onto one loop so chunk parsing lives only in `turn.ts` and loop-level behavior is written once. AgentCore (#16880) already added the `Turn`-backed round this needs; speculation is the next surface that can reuse it. The migration is opt-in and parity-gated, like the other surfaces.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/followup/` — 143 passed (6 files), including the new parity suite and all 56 existing speculation tests (off path unchanged).
- The new parity suite runs three scenarios — text-only completion, one tool call then completion, and a two-call batch — with the setting off and on, and asserts the resulting message history, tool-execution count and status are identical. The mock exposes each round both as candidate parts (the raw-chunk round) and as `functionCalls` (the `Turn`-backed round), as a real response does.
- Mutation witness: dropping the function-call part push in the shared-round path reds the parity suite; restored and re-greened.
- `npm run typecheck`, ESLint and Prettier are clean.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — internal architecture, opt-in; the parity suite is the evidence.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment

Local vitest on the worktree source.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: with the setting on, two semantics follow the shared round rather than the old raw parsing — a retry/fallback drops the abandoned attempt's text and calls (the old path kept them), and text arrives as one part per chunk rather than per streamed text part. Both are listed in the design doc's speculation section and match the other migrated surfaces. Default off keeps speculation exactly as today.
- Not validated / out of scope: the tool batch staying on speculation's own gate/direct execution (a later PR 6 step), the default flip and removal (PR 6b, gated on the nightly E2E), and real-model retry/cancel parity beyond the unit suite.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; opt-in, default off.

Design doc (updated, bilingual): [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/unified-loop-speculation/docs/design/2026-10-23-unified-agent-loop.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/unified-loop-speculation/docs/design/2026-10-23-unified-agent-loop.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Continues #15327 (unified agent loop); reuses the round from #16880 (AgentCore). No auto-close.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

把 speculation 的模型轮迁到共享 agent loop，沿用现有的 `experimental.unifiedAgentLoop` 设置。这是 unified-agent-loop 计划（#15327）的 PR 6a，复用 AgentCore 迁移（#16880）引入的基于 `Turn` 的模型轮（`ModelRoundSource` / `turnModelRound`）。开启设置时，每个投机轮经 `turnModelRound(chat, model)` 在 `runModelRound` 上发出，并从这一轮的类型化事件重建可见文本与 function-call parts；关闭时原样保留原有的 raw-chunk 解析。speculation 的工具门、直接工具执行、写时复制 overlay 写入与 boundary 处理均不改动。双语设计文档新增 speculation 节，迁移表把 PR 6 拆为 6a/6b。

## 为什么需要

speculation 是仍直接调用 `LlmChat.sendMessageStream` 并自行解析 chunk 的循环之一。该计划让所有入口收敛到一份 loop，使 chunk 解析只存在于 `turn.ts`，loop 级行为只写一次。AgentCore（#16880）已加入所需的基于 `Turn` 的模型轮；speculation 是下一个可复用它的入口。迁移与其他入口一样是 opt-in 且以 parity 为门。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/followup/` —— 143 通过（6 文件），含新 parity 套件与全部 56 个现有 speculation 测试（off 路径不变）。
- 新 parity 套件跑三个场景——纯文本完成、单调用后完成、双调用批——以设置开/关各跑一次，断言所得消息历史、工具执行次数与状态完全一致。mock 把每一轮同时暴露为 candidate parts（raw-chunk 轮）与 `functionCalls`（`Turn` 轮），与真实响应一致。
- 变异见证：删除共享轮路径的 function-call part 推送会使 parity 套件变红；已恢复并复绿。
- `npm run typecheck`、ESLint、Prettier 干净。

### 证据（Before & After）

N/A —— 内部架构，opt-in；parity 套件即证据。

### 测试环境

macOS ✅；Windows ⚠️ 未测；Linux ⚠️ 未测。本地 vitest 跑 worktree 源码。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险 / 权衡：开启设置时，有两处语义跟随共享轮而非旧的 raw 解析——重试/回退丢弃被放弃尝试的文本与调用（旧路径保留），文本按每 chunk 一个 part 而非每个流式文本 part。两者均已列在设计文档的 speculation 节，与其他已迁移入口一致。默认关闭使 speculation 与今日完全相同。
- 未验证 / 范围外：工具批仍走 speculation 自己的门/直接执行（后续 PR 6 步骤）、默认开启与删除（PR 6b，受 nightly E2E 门控）、以及超出单元套件的真实模型重试/取消 parity。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无；opt-in，默认关。

设计文档（已更新，双语）：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/unified-loop-speculation/docs/design/2026-10-23-unified-agent-loop.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/unified-loop-speculation/docs/design/2026-10-23-unified-agent-loop.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

延续 #15327（统一 agent loop）；复用 #16880（AgentCore）的模型轮。不自动关闭。

</details>

prs.title: fix(web-shell): keep terminal and local commands working over plain HTTP
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a shared id-minting helper that uses the platform's native UUID generator when the browser exposes it, falls back to an RFC 4122 v4 UUID built from `getRandomValues` when only the secure-context-gated generator is missing, and ends with a per-call-random last resort for realms without the crypto global at all. Every unguarded id-generation call site in the shell is routed through it, and the pre-existing guarded factories are consolidated onto the same helper so the package carries a single id strategy. The affected flows are opening a terminal tab, opening a web preview tab, local/slash command ids, managed pending-prompt storage, managed file uploads, transcript block remapping after reload, daemon client ids, split-view instance ids, subagent detail client ids, agent-chat mention idempotency keys, live nonces, managed request ids, and the local-files bridge connection id.

## Why it's needed

The native UUID generator is only exposed in secure contexts (HTTPS or loopback). The shell is also served over plain HTTP from remote hosts — a documented deployment where the user opens `http://<machine-ip>:<port>` from another computer. In that setting the generator is simply absent, so clicking Terminal threw a TypeError inside the click handler before the tab was created: the button appeared to do nothing. The same latent defect broke web preview tabs and local command ids on the same origins. With the fallback, every id-minting flow works identically on secure and non-secure origins, and the no-crypto contract matches what the provider tests already treat as a supported state.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Serve the shell over plain HTTP from a non-loopback origin (for example open `http://<machine-ip>:4170` from another computer, or run the dev server bound to `0.0.0.0` and open it via the machine IP), sign in, open any session, expand the right panel and click Terminal. Before this change nothing happens and the browser console shows `TypeError: crypto.randomUUID is not a function`; after it, a terminal tab opens and connects. Web preview and slash commands behave the same way.
2. Run the focused unit suites from the repository root: `cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run client/utils/random-uuid.test.ts` and `cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run client/App.test.tsx -t 'non-secure context'`. The App case removes the native generator to simulate a non-secure context and asserts the terminal tab is still created; reverting the terminal call site to the bare native call makes it fail. The helper suite pins delegation, v4 format, version/variant bits in both directions, uniqueness over 500 draws, and distinct ids with the whole crypto global stubbed to undefined.
3. The integration lane typecheck that caught the first revision is reproducible from the repository root: `npx tsc -p integration-tests/tsconfig.json --pretty false` (requires the usual build artifacts).

### Evidence (Before & After)

Headless Chromium A/B against a live daemon, same session, page origin `http://215.192.77.27:…` (non-secure):

| Arm | Code | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Before | published 0.27.3 bundle | `pageerror: crypto.randomUUID is not a function`; no tab, no panel |
| Control | published 0.27.3 bundle via `http://127.0.0.1:4170` | terminal opens (loopback is a secure context) |
| After | this branch via dev server on the machine IP | terminal tab created, WebSocket connected, snapshot replayed, shell prompt rendered, no page errors |

Unit witness: the new non-secure-context regression case passes on this branch and fails when the terminal call site is mutated back to the bare native call (byte-level restore verified). Each of the two no-crypto guards in the helper was removed individually and the new no-crypto case went red both times (byte-level restore verified). First-revision CI failure (`TS2835` in the integration typecheck, extensionless relative import) is fixed by explicit `.js` extensions and the exact CI command now exits 0 locally.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Node v24.22.1, vitest 3.2.7, headless Chromium (Playwright) against a live `qwen serve` daemon; dev-server proxy for the same-origin after arm.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: fallback ids must stay shape-compatible with consumers. They remain RFC 4122 v4 strings on every crypto-bearing path (pinned by tests); all consumers treat ids as opaque. The no-crypto last resort keeps the per-call randomness the split-view client id and IndexedDB keys require.
- Not validated / out of scope: macOS/Windows not tested locally; no server-side change.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

None — reported directly by a user accessing the daemon over plain HTTP from a remote machine.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

新增一个共享的 id 生成助手：浏览器暴露原生 UUID 生成器时直接使用；仅缺失受安全上下文限制的原生生成器时，用 `getRandomValues` 构造 RFC 4122 v4 UUID；在完全没有 crypto 全局的运行时里，以每次调用带随机性的兜底收尾。Shell 中所有未加守卫的 id 生成调用点统一接入该助手，既有的守卫工厂也合并到同一助手上，使包内只保留一套 id 策略。受影响的流程包括：打开终端页签、打开网页预览页签、本地/slash 命令 id、Managed 待发送提示存储、Managed 文件上传、重载后的转录块 id 重映射、daemon 客户端 id、分屏实例 id、子代理详情客户端 id、agent 聊天 @ 提及幂等键、live nonce、Managed 请求 id、local-files 桥连接 id。

## 为什么需要

原生 UUID 生成器只在安全上下文（HTTPS 或 loopback）暴露。Shell 也支持通过纯 HTTP 从远程主机访问——这是文档化的部署方式，用户在另一台电脑上打开 `http://<机器IP>:<端口>`。在这种场景下该生成器根本不存在，点击 Terminal 时点击处理器在创建页签之前就抛出 TypeError：按钮看起来「点了没反应」。同一隐患还导致同源下的网页预览页签与本地命令 id 失效。加入回退后，所有 id 生成流程在安全与非安全 origin 下行为一致；no-crypto 契约也与 provider 测试早已视为受支持的状态对齐。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

1. 以非 loopback 的纯 HTTP origin 打开 Shell（例如从另一台电脑访问 `http://<机器IP>:4170`，或把 dev server 绑到 `0.0.0.0` 后用机器 IP 访问），登录并打开任一会话，展开右栏点击 Terminal。改动前：无任何反应，浏览器控制台报 `TypeError: crypto.randomUUID is not a function`；改动后：终端页签正常打开并连接。网页预览与 slash 命令同理。
2. 在仓库根目录运行聚焦单测：`cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run client/utils/random-uuid.test.ts` 与 `cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run client/App.test.tsx -t 'non-secure context'`。App 用例通过移除原生生成器模拟非安全上下文，断言终端页签仍被创建；把终端调用点还原为裸原生调用会使用例失败。助手套件钉住委托行为、v4 格式、version/variant 位的双向取值、500 次抽取唯一性、以及整个 crypto 全局置空时 id 非空且互不相同。
3. 首版 CI 失败的集成车道 typecheck 可在仓库根复现：`npx tsc -p integration-tests/tsconfig.json --pretty false`（需要常规构建产物）。

### 证据（改动前后）

无头 Chromium 对同一 daemon、同一会话做 A/B，页面 origin 为 `http://215.192.77.27:…`（非安全上下文）：

| 臂 | 代码 | 结果 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 改动前 | 已发布 0.27.3 bundle | `pageerror: crypto.randomUUID is not a function`；无页签、无面板 |
| 对照 | 已发布 0.27.3 bundle，经 `http://127.0.0.1:4170` | 终端正常打开（loopback 是安全上下文） |
| 改动后 | 本分支，经机器 IP 的 dev server | 终端页签创建、WebSocket 连接、snapshot 回放、shell 提示符渲染，无页面错误 |

单测见证：新增的非安全上下文回归用例在本分支通过；把终端调用点变异回裸原生调用即失败（字节级还原已核对）。助手的两道 no-crypto 守卫分别单独移除，新 no-crypto 用例各红一次（每次字节级还原已核对）。首版 CI 失败（集成 typecheck 的 `TS2835`，无扩展名相对 import）已由显式 `.js` 扩展名修复，CI 原命令本地退出码 0。

### 测试平台

Linux ✅（本机实测）；macOS / Windows ⚠️（未本地验证）。

### 环境

Node v24.22.1、vitest 3.2.7、无头 Chromium（Playwright）对接真实 `qwen serve` daemon；改动后臂用 dev server 同源代理。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/权衡：回退 id 必须与消费方形状兼容。所有带 crypto 的路径仍产出 RFC 4122 v4 字符串（有测试钉住）；所有消费方把 id 当不透明字符串。no-crypto 兜底保留分屏客户端 id 与 IndexedDB 键所需的每次调用随机性。
- 未验证/范围外：macOS/Windows 未本地验证；无服务端改动。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无。

## 关联 Issue

无——用户从远程机器以纯 HTTP 访问 daemon 时直接报告。

prs.title: fix(cli): isolate PowerShell during Windows standalone updates
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Windows standalone updates now isolate the extraction subprocess from inherited PowerShell 7 module paths, allowing Windows PowerShell 5.1 to resolve its compatible Archive module without changing the parent environment or the system-wide execution policy.

Extraction errors are treated as failures and retain bounded, stream-decoded UTF-8 diagnostics. The subprocess also isolates encoding changes from the caller's console. Regression coverage exercises inherited and normal module environments, corrupt archives, and installation preservation after failure.

## Why it's needed

Updating the standalone installation from 0.26.9 to 0.27.3 under Microsoft Store PowerShell 7.7 failed with only `Expand-Archive exited with code 1`. The inherited `PSModulePath` caused Windows PowerShell 5.1 to load a PowerShell 7 Archive module, and discarded stderr concealed the underlying module-loading error.

Adding `-ExecutionPolicy Bypass` alone is insufficient: the incompatible module can report a missing .NET overload while exiting 0 without extracting the expected files. Selecting the compatible module and making extraction errors terminating addresses both failure modes.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. On Windows, use isolated archive/installation fixtures with the parent `PSModulePath` pointing to PowerShell 7 modules. Confirm that a valid archive is extracted and its manifest is parsed and validated, while the parent environment remains unchanged. Confirm the normal Windows PowerShell environment also works.
2. Supply a corrupt archive. Confirm that extraction fails with the underlying diagnostic, localized text survives UTF-8 decoding, and the existing installation is preserved with temporary extraction state and the update lock cleaned up.
3. In an isolated shared console seeded to input/output code pages 936/936, run the extraction subprocess with the production options. Confirm that the caller remains at 936/936 after child exit. The child may change its own output code page; a zero console-window handle alone does not prove console absence.

### Evidence (Before & After)

**Before:** the reported standalone update failed after download:

```text
更新失败：Expand-Archive exited with code 1
```

A read-only diagnostic in the original terminal exposed `PSSecurityException` / `UnauthorizedAccess` while Windows PowerShell 5.1 attempted to load the Microsoft Store PowerShell 7.7 Archive module.

**After, using isolated fixtures and real Windows subprocesses:**

- Valid archive: exit 0 with extracted contents verified byte-for-byte.
- Corrupt archive: exit 1 with lossless UTF-8 diagnostics, including Chinese text on the reproduction host.
- Native shared-console measurements: caller input/output code pages remained 936/936 before and after extraction. An independent asynchronous subprocess probe also confirmed the encoding change stayed isolated from the caller.
- Targeted updater tests: **86 passed, 72 platform-skipped**. These exercise the actual updater with fixture downloads; the valid archive is intentionally incomplete and reaches the later installation-layout check after successful extraction and manifest validation.
- Workspace build, all declared workspace and integration typechecks, targeted ESLint/Prettier checks, bundle, and bundled CLI version smoke check passed locally.

These results verify extraction and error handling; they do not claim a completed production upgrade.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| 🪟 Windows | ✅ Regression tests and real subprocess/console probes |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Windows x64; Node.js 26.8.2 for local builds and probes; Windows PowerShell 5.1.26100.9818; Microsoft Store PowerShell 7.7.0.0 module directory present. Windows PowerShell's effective execution policy was `Restricted` with all individual scopes `Undefined`. Console verification used disposable hidden consoles and isolated fixtures, leaving the real installation untouched.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Windows extraction now uses a sanitized child module environment and explicit diagnostic encoding. Native console probes verify isolation from the caller; they do not establish the absence of a child console.
- Not validated / out of scope: a full live 0.26.9 → 0.27.3 upgrade, including production download, installation replacement, rollback, and deferred swap; macOS/Linux runtime behavior. Scope is limited to Windows extraction and focused regression coverage.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No new dependencies or system-wide execution-policy changes are required. Existing checksum verification, extracted-path validation, replacement, and failure cleanup remain in place.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #17211

解压错误会作为失败处理，并保留有长度上限、采用流式 UTF-8 解码的诊断信息。子进程的编码变化也与调用方控制台隔离。回归测试覆盖继承模块路径、正常模块环境、损坏归档，以及失败后保留已有安装的行为。

## 审查者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 在 Windows 上使用隔离的归档与安装夹具，让父进程的 `PSModulePath` 指向 PowerShell 7 模块。确认有效归档能被解压，清单能够被解析和校验，且父进程环境保持不变；同时确认正常 Windows PowerShell 环境也能工作。

3. 在输入/输出代码页均设为 936 的隔离共享控制台中，使用生产配置启动解压子进程。确认子进程退出后，调用方仍为 936/936。子进程可能修改自身输出代码页；仅凭控制台窗口句柄为 0，不能证明它完全没有控制台。

### 证据（修改前后）

**修改前：** 用户报告独立安装版在下载后更新失败：

```text

```

在用户原始终端运行只读诊断，确认 Windows PowerShell 5.1 加载 Microsoft Store PowerShell 7.7 的 Archive 模块时，出现 `PSSecurityException` / `UnauthorizedAccess`。

**修改后，使用隔离夹具和真实 Windows 子进程验证：**

- 有效归档：退出码 0，解压内容逐字节核对正确。
- 损坏归档：退出码 1，诊断是无损 UTF-8，复现主机上的中文文本完整保留。
- 原生共享控制台测量：解压前后，调用方输入/输出代码页均保持 936/936。独立的异步子进程探针也确认编码变化未影响调用方。
- 更新器定向测试：**86 项通过、72 项按平台跳过**。测试通过夹具下载执行实际更新器；有效归档被故意设计为不完整，在成功解压并校验清单后，到达后续安装布局检查。
- 工作区构建、全部已声明的工作区及 integration 类型检查、定向 ESLint/Prettier 检查、bundle 和打包后 CLI 版本启动检查均在本地通过。

这些结果验证了解压与错误处理，不代表已经完成真实安装升级。

### 已测试的平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :---: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ✅ 回归测试及真实子进程/控制台探针 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |

### 环境（可选）

Windows x64；本地构建和探针使用 Node.js 26.8.2；Windows PowerShell 5.1.26100.9818；本机存在 Microsoft Store PowerShell 7.7.0.0 模块目录。Windows PowerShell 的有效执行策略为 `Restricted`，各独立作用域均为 `Undefined`。控制台验证使用一次性的隐藏控制台和隔离夹具，未触碰真实安装。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：Windows 解压现在使用清理后的子进程模块环境，并显式设置诊断编码。原生控制台探针验证了与调用方的隔离，但不证明子进程没有控制台。
- 未验证或范围外：真实的 0.26.9 → 0.27.3 完整升级，包括生产下载、安装替换、回滚和延迟替换；macOS/Linux 的运行时行为。本次范围仅限 Windows 解压及对应回归测试。
- 破坏性变更或迁移说明：无。无需新依赖，也无需修改系统全局执行策略。既有的校验和验证、解压路径校验、安装替换及失败清理逻辑继续保留。

prs.title: fix(cli): fail closed on expanding heredoc bodies in the worktree guard
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The daemon worktree guard keeps heredoc data out of command analysis without hiding commands Bash actually executes. Bodies that can execute or change shell state during expansion are denied. Multiple bodies are consumed in order, delimiter quoting and line continuations are respected, and consumed heredoc syntax is retired before recursive analysis. The original command sent to the shell is not rewritten.

The R7 follow-up also preserves a foreground directory change across comments and background commands. When the two existing command views cannot agree on pipe or background ownership, the guard denies the ambiguous input rather than treating every foreground command as a subshell.

## Why it's needed

Removing input data is safe only when it removes exactly what the shell treats as data. A wrong delimiter, an early CR match or a second strip of an already-consumed heredoc can delete a real command from the guard's view. Conversely, exposing a body line as a command can launder the tracked cwd back into the session worktree and authorize a Git mutation outside it.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Use guard requests with an outside-worktree target, not real destructive shell execution. Check ANSI-C and empty quoted delimiters, multiple queued bodies, LF input with a stray CR body line, folded body terminators, and a heredoc followed by a mutation inside a function or substitution. The mutation must stay visible and be denied. Unquoted expansions in a second body must be checked too.

A real pipe must still scope its cwd change; a preceding foreground cd must survive a later background command. A pipe-shaped comment must not become a pipe, while a hash inside an ordinary word must remain literal. Unsupported header continuations and unresolvable ownership must deny rather than guess. Quoted bodies with closing parentheses or substitution-shaped text, ordinary in-boundary work and value-only expansions must retain their allowances.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The final regressions against the original b2541b4 production code produce **18 failed, 492 passed, 4 platform skips**. Every failing assertion received allowed:true where denial was expected. Three other new cases are controls, not additional bypasses. Ten separate mechanism removals each make the relevant tests red; the original fixed bytes were restored after every run.

After a normal merge of main70a487be84, the exact tree515b11e272cd6e6b568b034f6a8b4ba70c5af6ba committed as b44b6f6757 passes the complete related source files:

| Local source coverage | Passed | Skipped |
| :--- | ---: | ---: |
| Primary guard suite | 510 | 4 |
| SSH-anchor ownership and external-policy controls | 3 | 0 |
| win32/cmd lane simulated on macOS, including replay of the guard suite | 435 | 95 |
| Total | 948 | 99 |

The simulated lane is not native Windows validation, and the SSH controls do not connect to a remote host. There were no test filters; original global setup and strict unhandled-error behavior were retained. The same three complete source files also pass on hosted Linux at this head: **948 passed, 99 skipped**.

Attempt 1 of [run 43322288385](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/43322288385) ended failed: 16 jobs were 6 successful, 6 failed and 4 skipped. Build, web-shell smoke shard 1 and both no-AK shards passed. Lint stopped while downloading actionlint after three connection timeouts, before producing a source lint result. The two Linux unit-test shards failed on separate external-context proxy tests: the real dispatcher did not reject a malformed environment value, and the packaged provider executable timed out instead of reporting its expected configuration error. Web-shell smoke shard 2 failed on an overview-menu click timeout. Its aggregate and the unit-test aggregate consequently failed too. These failures remain open; the three passing guard files do not make the overall workflow green.

The automatic retry on this head, attempt2, also ended failed: **8 successful jobs, 4 failed and 4 skipped**. Lint, build, Linux unit-test shard 1, both no-AK shards and web-shell smoke shard 1 passed. Linux unit-test shard 2 failed during checkout with Git RPC/connection errors, before tests, distinct from its attempt1 proxy assertion failure. Web-shell smoke shard 2 again had the overview More-button click timeout and 270 passing tests; the web-shell and unit-test aggregates consequently failed. The separate [Managed Agent gate](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/43322288454) also failed: two Aliyun tool-publication read-retry cases expected three fixture requests and observed two. That gate remains unresolved too.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ source coverage above; type-check limitation below |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ no native run; only the stated local lane simulation |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ three related source files; overall hosted run failed |

### Environment (optional)

Node.js26.5.0, macOS arm64, Vitest3.2.7 and TypeScript5.8.3. The native Bash3.2.57 controls use only cat, read, printf and isolated temporary directories; no reported Git mutation was executed. Existing same-project dependencies and dist prerequisites were reused, not reinstalled or presented as a fresh build.

Both net PR files pass Prettier, strict ESLint and the complete diff check against incoming main. Full local CLI tsc still exits2 with144 diagnostics. Replacing only the original guard module in memory under the same merged configuration gives the same144 diagnostics, with none added or removed. This is not a green full type check. A new full workspace build, preflight and installed/global-CLI run were not performed locally.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Inputs whose heredoc syntax or shell-state ownership cannot be resolved are denied rather than silently approved. Literal quoted-body and in-boundary controls remain covered.
- Not validated / out of scope: A complete Bash interpreter, native Windows execution, live SSH or Linux filesystem execution. The receiver gap tracked in #13705 and the previously deferred R7 suggestions are not being claimed resolved. No C=0 or automatic thread resolution is asserted.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: No public API or configuration change. This corrects the existing containment behavior rather than introducing a new feature or design contract.

## Linked Issues

Related #13705. Receiver handling remains separate from this change.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

daemon工作树guard在排除heredoc数据时，不再丢掉Bash实际会执行的命令。展开时可能执行命令或修改shell状态的body会被拒绝。多个body按出现顺序消费，分隔词引用和续行按对应语义处理，已消费的heredoc语法在递归分析前退出分析流。真正发给shell的原始命令不作改写。

R7增量还保留了跨注释与后台命令的前景目录变化。两个既有命令视图无法对应pipe或后台归属时，guard拒绝这个不确定输入，而不是把所有前景命令都当成subshell回滚。

## 为什么需要

只有删掉的内容恰好等于shell当作数据的内容时，移除stdin数据才安全。错认分隔词、提前匹配CR或再次strip已消费的heredoc，都可能把真实命令从guard视图中删掉。反过来，把body里的文字重新当作命令，会把追踪cwd洗回session工作树，从而放行工作树外的Git修改。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

使用指向工作树外目标的guard请求，不执行真实破坏性shell命令。检查ANSI-C及空引用分隔词、多个排队body、LF输入夹带CR的body行、经续行折叠的终止行，以及函数或substitution中heredoc后接修改命令的情况。真实修改必须仍可见并被拒绝。第二个未引用body的展开也必须检查。

真实pipe仍应隔离其cwd变化；先前已执行的前景cd必须穿过后续后台命令。注释里的pipe形状不能成为pipe，普通词内部的hash仍是字面字符。无法解析的header续行或归属必须拒绝，不能猜测。带右括号或substitution形状的引用body、普通工作树内操作和值读取展开仍保留原允许行为。

### 前后证据

最终测试搭配原b2541b4生产代码真实得到 **18 failed、492 passed、4项平台skip**。每条失败断言都是预期拒绝而实际allowed:true。另三个新增案例是控制，不冒充额外bypass。十个关键机制分别移除后，相应测试都会变红，每次运行后均精确恢复修复后的原始字节。

正常合入main70a487be84后，精确tree515b11e272cd6e6b568b034f6a8b4ba70c5af6ba已提交为b44b6f6757，完整相关源码文件的结果为：

| 本地源码覆盖 | Passed | Skipped |
| :--- | ---: | ---: |
| primary guard套件 | 510 | 4 |
| SSH锚点归属及外部策略控制 | 3 | 0 |
| macOS上模拟win32/cmd lane，含guard套件重放 | 435 | 95 |
| 合计 | 948 | 99 |

模拟lane不是原生Windows验证，SSH控制也没有连接远端主机。未筛选用例，保留原global setup与严格未处理错误检查。同head的三个完整源码文件也已在hosted Linux直接通过：**948 passed、99 skipped**。

[run43322288385](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/43322288385) attempt1已以failure结束：16 jobs为6 success、6 failure、4 skipped。build、web-shell smoke分片1和两个no-AK分片通过。lint下载actionlint时三次连接超时，尚未形成源lint结果。两个Linux单测分片分别在external-context代理测试失败：真实dispatcher未拒绝非法环境值，packaged provider可执行文件超时而未返回预期配置错误。web-shell smoke分片2在overview菜单点击时超时；该汇总门及单测汇总门相应失败。这些失败仍未闭合，三个guard文件通过不等于整个workflow通过。

同head的自动重试attempt2也已以failure结束：**8 success、4 failure、4 skipped**。lint、build、Linux单测分片1、两个no-AK及web-shell smoke分片1通过。Linux单测分片2在checkout时因Git RPC/连接错误失败，尚未运行测试，与attempt1的代理断言失败分开。web-shell smoke分片2再次在overview的More按钮点击时超时，270项通过；web-shell和单测汇总门相应失败。独立[Managed Agent gate](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/43322288454)也已失败：两个Aliyun工具发布读取重试案例预期三次fixture请求，实际两次。该门同样仍未闭合。

### 已测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 上述源码覆盖；类型检查限制见下 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未原生运行，仅有已说明的本地lane模拟 |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ 三个相关源码文件；整体hosted run失败 |

### 环境（可选）

Node.js26.5.0、macOS arm64、Vitest3.2.7、TypeScript5.8.3。原生Bash3.2.57控制只使用cat/read/printf和隔离临时目录，没有执行报告中的Git修改命令。复用同项目已有依赖及dist前置，没有重装或冒充新构建。

净PR两个文件的Prettier、严格ESLint和相对incoming main的完整diff检查通过。本地完整CLI tsc仍exit2、144项诊断。在相同合并配置中，仅将原guard模块注入内存作对照，也得到同样144项诊断，无新增或减少，不称完整类型通过。本机没有新跑完整workspace build、preflight或安装后全局CLI。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：无法解析heredoc语法或shell状态归属的输入会被拒绝，不再静默放行。引用body及工作树内控制仍有覆盖。
- 未验证或不包含：完整Bash解释器、原生Windows、真实SSH或Linux文件系统执行。#13705跟踪的receiver缺口和此前延期的R7建议不冒称解决。不声称C=0，也不自动resolve线程。
- 破坏性变化或迁移说明：没有公共API或配置变化；这是对既有containment行为的纠正，不是新增feature或设计契约。

## 关联 Issue

Related #13705。Receiver处理仍与本改动分开。

</details>
