prs.title: fix(web-shell): render code-mode exec calls as JavaScript
prs.body:
## What this PR does

A code-mode `exec` call now shows the JavaScript program it ran instead of the JSON object that wrapped it. The expanded tool card in the web shell (Desktop and Web Shell both render through it) puts the `source` string in a JavaScript-fenced code block, so the script keeps the indentation, line breaks and quotes the model wrote. Every other tool keeps the existing pretty-printed JSON arguments view.

## Why it's needed

`exec` takes exactly one argument, `source`, and its value is a program. Serializing the argument object meant the whole script arrived as a single JSON string: newlines became `\n`, every quote was escaped, and the user had to un-escape a one-line blob to read or copy what the agent actually ran. That is what #16675 reports — the request is to see the code as code, not to change what is stored or sent to the model.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the web-shell suite and open a session that used code mode.

1. `cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run client/components/messages/ToolGroup.test.tsx` — 162 tests pass, including the new `renders a code-mode exec call as JavaScript instead of JSON`.
2. Expand an `exec` tool row: the Arguments block shows the program across its original lines under a `javascript` language label, with no `"source"` key and no `\n` escapes.
3. Expand any other tool row (e.g. an MCP call): the Arguments block still shows pretty-printed JSON, unchanged.

The new test fails against `origin/main` (the block renders JSON and has no `javascript` fence) and passes with the change.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before, an `exec` call whose source is

```js
const content = ['const a = 1;', 'export const answer = 42;'].join('\n');
await tools.write_file({ file_path: 'a.js', content });
```

rendered as one line of JSON: `{ "source": "const content = [\n'const a = 1;', ... }`.

After, the same call renders the program over its own lines in a JavaScript code block. Reproduced through the component test rather than a live Desktop session — no screenshot is attached, and the visual output was not verified in the running app.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

`npx vitest run` under `packages/web-shell` on macOS. No build or browser run.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the JavaScript fence depends on the Shiki `javascript` grammar being available; if it is not loaded the block falls back to the same plain `<pre>` the JSON block already uses, so degradation is visual only.
- Not validated / out of scope: the `TurnCallsPanel` / trajectory inspector still renders its own arguments detail through `ToolCallDetail`; this PR only changes the tool card in the transcript. Package-level `tsc --noEmit` reports the same 12 pre-existing errors on `origin/main` and on this branch (stale `@qwen-code/sdk` typings in the worktree, unrelated to these files), so the package typecheck was not used as a gate; ESLint on the three touched files is clean.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. A transcript recorded before this change renders the same way, because the change derives the code from `args.source` at render time.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #16675

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

代码模式（code mode）的 `exec` 调用现在直接展示它执行的 JavaScript 程序，而不是包着它的那个 JSON 对象。Web Shell 的展开式工具卡片（Desktop 和 Web Shell 都走这条路）把 `source` 放进 `javascript` 代码块，因此脚本保留模型写下的缩进、换行和引号。其他工具的 Arguments 区块仍显示原有的美化 JSON。

## 为什么需要

`exec` 只有一个参数 `source`，它的值就是一段程序。把参数对象序列化后，整段脚本变成一行 JSON 字符串：换行成了 `\n`，每个引号都被转义，用户要读懂或复制 agent 实际执行的代码，得先给它去转义。这正是 #16675 报告的问题——诉求是把代码当代码显示，不改变存储内容和发给模型的内容。

## 评审验证方式

在 `packages/web-shell` 下运行 `npx vitest run client/components/messages/ToolGroup.test.tsx`：162 条全部通过，包含新增的 `renders a code-mode exec call as JavaScript instead of JSON`。展开任意 `exec` 工具行，Arguments 区块按原始行显示程序、语言标签为 `javascript`，不再出现 `"source"` 键和 `\n` 转义；展开其他工具行，Arguments 仍是美化后的 JSON，行为不变。该测试在 `origin/main` 上失败（渲染 JSON、没有 `javascript` 围栏），应用改动后通过。

## 证据

修改前，上例的 `exec` 调用显示成一行 JSON；修改后按程序自身的行显示在 JavaScript 代码块里。这是通过组件测试复现的，没有附截图，也没有在运行中的 Desktop 里核实视觉效果。

## 测试环境

macOS 上 `packages/web-shell` 的 `npx vitest run`，未做构建、未在浏览器里运行。Windows 与 Linux 未测试。

## 风险与范围

主要风险是 Shiki 的 `javascript` 语法未加载时退化为与现有 JSON 区块相同的纯 `<pre>`，仅影响外观。`TurnCallsPanel` / trajectory 检查器仍走自己的 `ToolCallDetail`，本 PR 只改转写区的工具卡片。包级 `tsc --noEmit` 在 `origin/main` 和本分支上都是同样的 12 个既存错误（worktree 里过期的 `@qwen-code/sdk` 类型，与这三个文件无关），因此没有把包级类型检查当作门槛；三个改动文件的 ESLint 干净。无破坏性变更：改动在渲染时从 `args.source` 推导，历史转写按同样方式显示。

</details>

prs.title: Verify agent loop execution across Managed entry points
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds an independent CI lane for the two Managed paths in block M of #17045. Each of the shared-loop and event-bus-enabled matrix jobs runs a real packaged Hosted workflow child through `agent()` → AgentHeadless/AgentCore, and an ordinary paired-engine daemon through Managed ACP. The lane runs on relevant PRs, main pushes, nightly and manual dispatch, independently of the Java gate's tier selection.

The Hosted scenario checks the model request, visible completion, persisted result and actual AgentCore loop marker. The daemon scenario rejects Legacy fallback, executes a real file read, checks that the provider receives the unique file contents, and verifies completion plus ACP shared-round/tool-batch markers. Both use a local controlled provider. Exactly two passing tests and two passing evidence files are required; retries are disabled and protocol/log evidence is retained on failure.

## Why it's needed

Enabling a loop flag does not prove that either Managed entry point reached that loop. This adds an executable acceptance gate for those paths, including assertions that catch fallback, missing execution evidence and skipped coverage. The dedicated suite is excluded from the ordinary E2E suite to avoid duplicate execution. The new workflow's byte-size and CI-budget registrations are included.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Both Managed loop jobs should pass both scenarios and publish their evidence artifacts. Hosted AgentCore should report the shared loop in one job and the event bus in the other; its persisted result must contain the provider-generated marker. The daemon must retain Managed ownership and send the file-read result back to the provider before completing.

Hosted workflow agents currently prohibit tools, so the Hosted request must advertise none. ACP currently executes shared rounds and tool batches in both jobs; the event-bus-enabled job is not a claim that ACP's separate kernel migration is complete. The workflow completion guard also has regression cases for skipped tests and absent evidence.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for UI. Local checks completed: Prettier formatting, syntax parsing of eight changed/new TS/JS files, YAML parsing, shell and completion-guard syntax, workflow byte-size baseline, bilingual design links, and `git diff --check`. Follow-up checks also passed: ESLint on all eight changed TS/JS files, Actionlint on the new workflow, the CI budget gate and the workflow size gate. These are static checks, not runtime acceptance.

The two process scenarios and workflow regression tests have not been run locally. This worktree has no current dependency/build output; no dependencies were installed and no build, full typecheck or test suite was run. Runtime acceptance remains pending CI.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--: | :--: |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ Static checks only; process tests not run |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ CI configured; runtime result pending |

### Environment (optional)

CI builds the packaged CLI from its checkout and uses isolated temporary workspaces, a local OpenAI-compatible provider and the existing Hosted HTTP store fixture backed by the local journal implementation. No external model credentials or Java service are required.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: two CI matrix jobs add build cost; execution evidence deliberately follows the current loop branches and must change with ACP's separate kernel migration. Production changes are limited to two ACP debug breadcrumbs.
- Not validated / out of scope: runtime results pending CI; no real-provider, Spring/MySQL, cancellation/recovery, cross-platform or Hosted Harness own-loop acceptance. Hosted tools remain prohibited.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No default switch changes or public protocol changes.

Design: [English](docs/design/2026-11-14-managed-loop-ci.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-11-14-managed-loop-ci.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Part of #17045 — block M, CI verification row only. The parent tracker and Hosted Harness loop evaluation remain open.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

为 #17045 M 块的两条 Managed 路径增加独立 CI。共享循环和事件总线开关开启两档矩阵，分别使用真实打包 CLI，运行 Hosted workflow 子 Session 的 `agent()` → AgentHeadless/AgentCore，以及普通双引擎 daemon → Managed ACP。在相关 PR、main push、nightly 和手动触发时执行，不依赖 Java gate 的分级选择。

Hosted 场景检查模型请求、可见完成、持久化结果和实际 AgentCore 循环日志。daemon 场景拒绝 Legacy 回退，真实读取文件，检查 provider 收到唯一文件内容，并验证完成及 ACP 共享模型轮、工具批日志。两者使用本地受控 provider。必须恰好两个测试通过，并有两份通过的证据文件；关闭重试，失败时仍保留协议和日志证据。

## 为什么需要

打开循环开关并不能证明 Managed 入口真的执行到该循环。本 PR 为这两条路径增加可执行验收，能够发现回退、缺失执行证据和跳过覆盖。专用套件从普通 E2E 中排除，避免重复运行；同时登记新 workflow 的字节大小基线和 CI 预算。

## Reviewer 验证计划

### 如何验证

两个 Managed loop 任务都应通过两个场景并上传证据。Hosted AgentCore 在一档报告共享循环，在另一档报告事件总线；持久化结果必须包含 provider 生成的唯一标记。daemon 必须归 Managed 所有，并在完成之前将真实读文件结果发送回 provider。

Hosted workflow 子代理当前禁止工具，因此模型请求不得声明工具。ACP 当前在两档下都执行共享模型轮和工具批；事件总线开关开启的任务不代表 ACP 的独立内核迁移已经完成。workflow 完成检查另有回归用例，覆盖跳过测试和缺失证据。

### 证据（前后对比）

UI 不适用。本地已完成 Prettier 格式整理、八个改动/新增 TS/JS 文件语法解析、YAML 解析、Shell 和完成检查脚本语法检查、workflow 大小基线、双语设计链接及 `git diff --check`。后续还通过了全部八个改动 TS/JS 文件的 ESLint、新 workflow 的 Actionlint、CI 预算和 workflow 大小检查。这些都是静态检查，不是运行验收。

两个进程场景和 workflow 回归测试尚未在本地运行。当前工作区没有本次代码的依赖和构建产物；未安装依赖，未运行构建、完整 typecheck 或测试套件。运行验收仍待 CI。

### 验证平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :--: | :--: |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ 仅静态检查；未运行进程测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未验证 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 已配置 CI；运行结果待确认 |

### 环境

CI 从当前 checkout 构建 CLI，使用隔离的临时工作区、本地 OpenAI-compatible provider，以及基于本地 journal 实现的现有 Hosted HTTP store fixture。无需外部模型凭证或 Java 服务。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：两个 CI 矩阵任务增加构建成本；执行证据对应当前循环分支，需要随 ACP 独立内核迁移更新。生产代码仅增加两处 ACP 调试日志。
- 未验证或不在范围内：运行结果待 CI；不覆盖真实 provider、Spring/MySQL、取消/恢复、跨平台或 Hosted Harness 自有循环验收。Hosted 工具继续禁止。
- 兼容与迁移：无破坏性变更，不修改默认开关或公开协议。

设计文档：[English](docs/design/2026-11-14-managed-loop-ci.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-11-14-managed-loop-ci.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 Issue

属于 #17045，仅实现 M 块 CI 验证子项。父追踪 issue 和 Hosted Harness 循环评估继续保留。

</details>

prs.title: feat(verify-pr): require a boundary declaration and own the watch state
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Makes the isolation boundary of a local deep-verification round a machine-enforced declaration: every round must ship a boundary artifact recording either a credential-free container or a maintainer's explicitly recorded waiver, and the consistency checker refuses a round without it. The CI publish job writes the CI lane's own declaration before running the checker, so rounds whose base-pinned skill predates this change still pass. The shared head-dedup state that manual and watch-triggered rounds register in moves from hand-written JSON into a small atomic helper with UTC timestamps and a duplicate-head exit code. The skill also gains the measured rig-reuse traps (a masking pipe eating the setup exit code, comparing before restoring a mutant, fresh worktrees missing built entry points) and an event-driven waiting rule, plus a bilingual design document for the Java container recipe that removes the reason Java-heavy rounds fall back to the host.

## Why it's needed

Two consecutive local rounds on PR #16866 executed the entire Java battery, mutation matrix and JS suites on the maintainer's host with no isolation gate, no waiver, and no boundary line in either report — the isolation rule existed only as prose and did not stop the silent fallback. The same PR's watch state was left two heads stale because the completion write was a manual JSON edit that busy rounds skipped, and one manual start write stamped local time with a `Z` suffix. One round also spent nine foreground sleeps (~14 minutes) polling background matrices whose completion notifications all arrived on time, and two rounds each rediscovered and re-patched the same rig failure because the first fix was never fed back into the inherited recipe. Each of these is now either enforced by a script, owned by a helper, or written down as a measured rule with a pin.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Run the affected suites from the repository root: `npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/verify-pr-check.test.js scripts/tests/verify-pr-watch-state.test.js scripts/tests/verify-pr-prepare.test.js scripts/tests/qwen-triage-workflow.test.js scripts/tests/verify-pr-model-proxy.test.js` — 368 tests pass. The checker tests cover a missing declaration, malformed shapes, a container declaration without a detail, and a waiver missing the approver or the reason; each is refused, and a consistent round with either valid shape is accepted.
- The workflow meta-test replays the real publish step with the real checker: confirm the CI lane declaration is written before the checker runs and the verdict stays trusted even though the fixture never writes a declaration itself — this is the rollout-safety property for rounds whose base-pinned skill predates the artifact.
- Watch-state helper: starting the same head twice exits 3 the second time (verified and in-flight both dedup, at any quoted OID length); completion rotates the previous verified head, records the verdict and comment id, and stamps UTC; a corrupt state file is ignored rather than crashing; no temporary file survives the atomic write.
- The skill text pins assert the new contract strings: the per-round waiver that never carries over unasked, the operator-owned declaration (CI publish job and the local recipe's host check step), the helper commands in both the manual follow-up step and the watch prompt, the rig traps, and the notification-first waiting rule.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — non-UI change (skill contract, checker, workflow, design docs).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Node 24, vitest through the scripts/tests config; the publish-step replay uses a stubbed `gh` and the real checker.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the checker now refuses rounds without the boundary declaration. CI is covered by the workflow-side write landing in the same change; local rounds get the requirement from the updated skill, and old local checkouts keep their old checker until synced, so nothing breaks retroactively.
- Not validated / out of scope: no full end-to-end `/verify-pr` dry-run (hours-long); the Java container recipe is a design proposal, not implemented here; one pre-existing serve-ab workflow test is red on local git 2.43.7 (the workflow it parses is untouched by this PR).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: local rounds must write the boundary artifact before posting; host execution now requires an explicit per-round maintainer approval recorded in the artifact, and the watch state must be written through the helper rather than by hand.

Design document: [English](docs/design/2026-11-14-verify-pr-java-container-recipe.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-11-14-verify-pr-java-container-recipe.zh-CN.md) — both versions are complete and synchronized (problem, current state, goals, non-goals, solution, decisions, constraints, risks, validation plan, acceptance criteria, open questions).

## Linked Issues

Measured on PR #16866 (rounds 10 and 11); no issue to close.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做什么

把本地深度验证轮的隔离边界变成机器强制的声明：每个轮次必须携带边界产物，记录无凭据容器或维护者显式记录的豁免，一致性检查器拒绝没有声明的轮次。CI 发布作业在运行检查器之前自行写入 CI 车道的声明，因此 base 钉住的旧 skill 产出的轮次仍能通过。手动轮与 watch 触发轮共同登记的去重状态，从手写 JSON 移入一个原子写入的小助手，带 UTC 时间戳和重复 head 退出码。skill 还写入了实测的 rig 复用陷阱（掩码管道吃掉 setup 退出码、还原前先比对变异体、新 worktree 缺已构建入口）与事件驱动的等待规则，并附一份双语设计文档，描述消除 Java 重轮次回退宿主理由的 Java 容器配方。

## 为什么需要

PR #16866 的连续两个本地轮次把整个 Java 电池、变异矩阵和 JS 套件跑在维护者宿主机上——没有隔离门禁、没有豁免、两份报告都没有边界行；隔离规则只是文字，没能阻止静默降级。同一 PR 的 watch 状态落后了两个 head，因为完成写入是忙碌轮次会跳过的手写 JSON 编辑；一次手动开始写入还把本地时间贴上了 `Z` 后缀。一个轮次花了九次前台 sleep（约 14 分钟）轮询后台矩阵，而它们的完成通知其实都准时到达；两个轮次各自重新发现并重新修补了同一个 rig 故障，因为第一次修复从未回灌进被继承的配方。这些现在要么由脚本强制、要么由助手接管、要么作为带 pin 的实测规则写入。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- 从仓库根运行受影响的套件：`npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/verify-pr-check.test.js scripts/tests/verify-pr-watch-state.test.js scripts/tests/verify-pr-prepare.test.js scripts/tests/qwen-triage-workflow.test.js scripts/tests/verify-pr-model-proxy.test.js` —— 368 例通过。检查器测试覆盖缺失声明、畸形形状、无 detail 的容器声明、缺批准人或理由的豁免，均被拒绝；带任一有效形状的一致轮次被接受。
- workflow meta-test 用真实检查器重放真实发布步骤：确认 CI 车道声明在检查器运行前写入，且即使夹具自己从不写声明，判定仍被采信——这是对 base 钉住旧 skill 轮次的 rollout 安全属性。
- watch-state 助手：同一 head 开始两次，第二次 exit 3（verified 与 in-flight 都去重，任意引用长度的 OID 均匹配）；完成时轮转上一个已验证 head、记录判定与评论 id、打 UTC 时间戳；损坏的状态文件被忽略而非崩溃；原子写后不残留临时文件。
- skill 文本 pin 断言新契约字符串：逐轮豁免不自动延续、由边界运营方写声明（CI 发布作业与本地配方的宿主检查步）、手动 follow-up 步骤与 watch prompt 中的助手命令、rig 陷阱、通知优先的等待规则。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A —— 非 UI 改动（skill 契约、检查器、workflow、设计文档）。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ 已测试 |

### 环境（可选）

Node 24，经 scripts/tests 配置的 vitest；发布步骤重放使用桩 `gh` 与真实检查器。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：检查器现在拒绝没有边界声明的轮次。CI 由同一变更落地的 workflow 侧写入覆盖；本地轮次从更新后的 skill 获得要求，旧本地 checkout 在同步前仍用旧检查器，因此不追溯破坏。
- 未验证 / 范围外：未跑完整端到端 `/verify-pr` dry-run（小时级）；Java 容器配方是设计提案，本 PR 不实现；一条既有的 serve-ab workflow 测试在本机 git 2.43.7 上红（它解析的 workflow 未被本 PR 触及）。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：本地轮次发布前必须写边界产物；宿主执行现在需要维护者逐轮显式批准并记录在产物中；watch 状态必须经助手写入而非手写。

设计文档：[English](docs/design/2026-11-14-verify-pr-java-container-recipe.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-11-14-verify-pr-java-container-recipe.zh-CN.md) —— 两版完整同步（问题、现状、目标、非目标、方案、决策、约束、风险、验证计划、验收标准、开放问题）。

## 关联 issue

实测于 PR #16866（第 10、11 轮）；无 issue 需要关闭。

prs.title: feat(live-voice): add configurable turn_detection for realtime session.update
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Live Voice now negotiates a turn detection mode that the selected realtime model actually supports. When `experimental.liveVoice.turnDetection` is unset or empty, the session defaults to `server_vad` for qwen-audio realtime models and keeps `semantic_vad` for all other models, preserving the existing omni realtime behavior. The default is resolved from the effective realtime model — the model that actually goes on the wire — so `provider:modelId` selectors such as `dashscope:qwen-audio-3.0-realtime-plus` also receive the correct default. A new enum setting lets users override the mode with `server_vad`, `smart_turn`, `smart_turn_v2`, or `semantic_vad`. The Host client applies the model-aware default inside its session layer; the daemon resolves it during credential resolution (and it can be overridden there via experimental.liveVoice.turnDetection).. An invalid setting value is a configuration error that makes Live Voice unavailable without taking the daemon down at boot. The `null` push-to-talk mode from the previous revision is removed: with no server-side VAD nothing commits the input audio buffer on this path, so the mode could connect but never answer; making it viable requires a client-side commit trigger, which is separable follow-up work.

## Why it's needed

Fixes #17000. The qwen-audio realtime family rejects `turn_detection.type: 'semantic_vad'` — the value both realtime clients hardcoded — so Live Voice fails at `session.update` with `Unsupported turn_detection.type` even though the WebSocket handshake succeeds and the session reports ready. Users with a qwen-audio realtime route cannot use Live Voice at all. The server's own default for these models is `server_vad` (visible in `session.created`), which is what this PR now sends.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the focused checks locally (all executed on macOS against this revision): `npx prettier --check` on the changed files, `npx eslint --max-warnings 0` on the changed TypeScript files, `tsc --noEmit` in `packages/cli` and `packages/qwen-live`, and vitest on the three touched test files — 47 + 40 + 85 = 172 tests pass. `npm run generate:settings-schema` was run and the regenerated schema is committed; re-running it produces no further diff.

For the behavioral claim, configure a `realtimeOnly` route for `qwen-audio-3.0-realtime-plus`, resolve the credential through the fixed resolution path, and open a Realtime WebSocket to the derived endpoint. Sending the old hardcoded `semantic_vad` in `session.update` is rejected by the server (Arm A below); sending the resolved `server_vad` is accepted with `session.updated` (Arm B); an explicit `smart_turn_v2` override is also accepted (Arm C). A reviewer should additionally confirm that the default keys off the effective wire model (unit test with a `provider:modelId` selector), that an invalid value degrades to `provider_config` unreadiness instead of crashing app construction (the boot read is now wrapped; there is no dedicated test harness for the boot path itself, so that part is covered by inspection), and that the Host client still sends `create_response: false`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Non-UI change: wire transcripts against the real endpoint instead of screenshots. Probe run 2026-11-12 against `wss://token-plan.ap-southeast-1.maas.aliyuncs.com/api-ws/v1/realtime`, model `qwen-audio-3.0-realtime-plus`, voice `longanqian`; the credential (including `turnDetection: server_vad`) was resolved by the fixed code from a real user configuration. API key redacted.

Arm A — before (old hardcoded value), sent `session.update`:

```json
{
  "type": "session.update",
  "session": {
    "modalities": ["text", "audio"],
    "model": "qwen-audio-3.0-realtime-plus",
    "voice": "longanqian",
    "turn_detection": { "type": "semantic_vad", "create_response": true, "interrupt_response": true },
    "input_audio_format": "pcm",
    "output_audio_format": "pcm",
    "input_audio_transcription": { "model": "qwen3-asr-flash-realtime" }
  }
}
```

Server response:

```json
{
  "event_id": "event_IfXcIZ1DBBSxKxYaapbDi",
  "type": "error",
  "error": {
    "type": "invalid_request_error",
    "code": "invalid_value",
    "message": "Unsupported turn_detection.type: 'semantic_vad'. Supported values: server_vad, smart_turn, smart_turn_v2. Use turn_detection: null for push-to-talk mode.",
    "param": "session.update"
  }
}
```

Arm B — after (resolved default), sent `session.update`:

```json
{
  "type": "session.update",
  "session": {
    "modalities": ["text", "audio"],
    "model": "qwen-audio-3.0-realtime-plus",
    "voice": "longanqian",
    "turn_detection": { "type": "server_vad", "create_response": true, "interrupt_response": true },
    "input_audio_format": "pcm",
    "output_audio_format": "pcm",
    "input_audio_transcription": { "model": "qwen3-asr-flash-realtime" }
  }
}
```

Server response:

```json
{
  "event_id": "event_Fig5L9JqDchGYudRRCa6P",
  "type": "session.updated",
  "session": {
    "id": "sess_VsEhTzNuX85X9poHbhAih",
    "object": "realtime.session",
    "model": "qwen-audio-3.0-realtime-plus",
    "modalities": ["text", "audio"],
    "voice": "longanqian",
    "output_audio_format": "pcm",
    "input_audio_transcription": { "model": "qwen3-asr-flash-realtime" },
    "turn_detection": { "type": "server_vad", "threshold": 0.5, "silence_duration_ms": 800 }
  }
}
```

Arm C — explicit `smart_turn_v2` override: the server answered `session.updated` (`sess_DnapvOkZdHsXOk3zdHdVF`) echoing `"turn_detection": { "type": "smart_turn_v2", "threshold": 0.5, "silence_duration_ms": 3000 }`.

Speech turns with real microphone audio after the accepted update: **not tested** (requires interactive audio input); everything above was observed live against the real endpoint.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment

Node + pnpm workspace install; focused vitest, tsc, eslint, prettier; live WebSocket probe from macOS. Full preflight/build/e2e were not run locally; fork CI is pending maintainer approval (`action_required`).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: qwen-audio realtime sessions now receive `server_vad` instead of a value the server rejects; omni and all other models keep `semantic_vad`, so existing working setups are unchanged, and the override setting is opt-in.
- Not validated / out of scope: end-to-end speech turns with real microphone audio (the probe verifies `session.update` acceptance only); boot-path degradation is covered by inspection, not a dedicated test; full CI has not run locally (fork PR); push-to-talk (`turn_detection: null`) is removed from this PR and needs a client-side input-commit trigger as separable follow-up; `smart_turn`/`smart_turn_v2` are accepted by the endpoint but not exercised with real speech.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none for existing configurations. The unreleased `null`/empty-string push-to-talk behavior from the previous revision of this PR is removed; an empty string now means unset (model-aware default), consistent with the other `liveVoice` fields.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #17000

prs.title: feat(cli): restore native Memory controls and file actions
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Restores four native `/memory` controls and real User/Project file or managed-folder actions. Workspace settings persist across reopening and restart. Errors remain visible, and asynchronous actions stay bound to their selected runtime owner.

## Why it's needed

The native panel only shows paths and three readonly statuses. Ink already supports editing all four settings and opening the selected target. This change restores those interactions without changing Core APIs, memory policy or Ink production code.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Use a disposable trusted workspace and owned user/memory roots. Toggle all four values, reopen and restart: Workspace values should persist while unrelated settings remain unchanged. Select User/Project and check the correct configured file or managed directory opens. An editor failure should retain a usable error panel.

Resize and navigate every control, including the wrapped confirmation label. Replacing the runtime must invalidate old callbacks. Escape closes only the current owner; numbered target shortcuts retain Ink behavior.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The global Ink baseline passed; the original native readonly-panel failure remains preserved. The frozen local candidate passed four complete groups on Node/Ink, Bun/Ink and strict Bun/OpenTUI: 12 executions, 15 natural exit0/signal0 outcomes and zero model requests, independently reviewed.

Qualified normal checks cover build, typecheck, zero-warning lint, format, bundle, 358 CLI tests and 202 workflow meta tests. Five skips remain explicit: one Linux-only unit and four meta cases. These are qualified stages, not a claim that every intermediate pipeline passed; prior failures remain in detailed E2E/provenance records.

Ten separate native layout cases cover two modes and five sizes. Their deterministic error seam verifies layout, not real disk failure or GUI completion.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | Three public runtime profiles and native layout |
| Windows | Not tested |
| Linux | Not tested locally; headless unit skipped |

### Environment

Local pre-documentation-followup source `6f754be6+d05ff3fa`, bundle `5428965d`. Public cases retain 12-second observations, 120-second cases and zero retries.

## Risk & Scope

Only auto-skill uses its existing live setter; confirmation policy retains its startup semantics. Native automatic SkillReview approval presentation remains an unimplemented follow-up. This change does not add approval bypasses or qualify generated-skill approval.

Owned editor/opener fixtures prove process/file effects, not desktop GUI success. No installed/final-main, untested platform, default-switch, Ink-removal or overall migration approval is claimed.

Designs: [English](https://github.com/chiga0/qwen-code/blob/feat/opentui-memory-manager-20261114/docs/design/2026-11-14-opentui-memory-manager.md), [中文](https://github.com/chiga0/qwen-code/blob/feat/opentui-memory-manager-20261114/docs/design/2026-11-14-opentui-memory-manager.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Part of the Ink→OpenTUI migration; no automatic issue closure.

prs.title: feat(serve): make the PR watch operator-owned and retire the channel's
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The daemon now owns PR-state transitions, and the operator owns the subscription. A new operator-only `serve.sessionPrWatch` setting carries the four transition types, `wakeDormant`, and role-keyed instruction templates. The watch is enabled by the presence of an effective event set rather than by an internal constant, so the periodic tick and the on-demand drain agree by construction. The detector filters transitions inside the single detection function both producers call, and `actions` / `wakeDormant` now reach the drain instead of being declared-but-inert seams.

The GitHub channel stops detecting and delivering state transitions. Its poll keeps the candidate selection, the per-PR state file, the budget gate and the comment cursors, so the comment lane's delivery path is unchanged. The configurable `prWatchLimit` is removed with the rest of the watch knobs; the consequence is named under Risk. At the first connect after the upgrade it counts the transitions it still held without delivering them, strips the state-watch fields while preserving the comment cursors and the last title, and retires persisted watch tasks privately. The file is not renamed: renaming it would let the comment watch deliver a backlog.

For one minor release the channel still accepts `prWatchEvents` and the `watch:*` action keys. It logs one warning naming the setting and detects nothing; the daemon reads those keys as a per-host alias when the setting is unset, for PRs on the channel's web host. An explicit setting always wins. The alias's rebuild signature covers the events, the action templates and the bound-delivery switch, so editing a channel while the daemon runs takes effect without a restart.

The one visible comment-prompt change is named in the docs: `%title%` keeps the last title the old state watch recorded and is no longer refreshed.

## Why it's needed

The master design forbids a build in which both pollers deliver; landing the setting, the migration and the enablement together is the only way to satisfy that. Operators also need a supported way to configure the watch: before this change it ran from an internal constant, and the channel's state watch lagged the PR lifecycle by days in practice. Moving it to the daemon gives one poller, one definition of the transition rules, and a configuration surface that can be validated at boot.

The per-tick scan cost was measured rather than inherited from the earlier deferral: two workspaces of 32 sessions cost 8.49 ms mean per scan, so the three scans a tick now makes cost about 51 ms, and the design records the decision to keep them separate.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the unit and gate commands below. For the real-daemon checks, the attached E2E report describes an isolated daemon (its own port, `QWEN_HOME`, runtime and `gh` stub) and the cases it ran: no setting, a setting, an invalid setting, an invalid action map, a workspace-scope setting, an operator/workspace conflict, an event the operator did not subscribe, role-keyed delivery, and an alias-only channel. A reviewer can re-run the same rig against `dist/cli.js`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no TUI surface changes. The user-visible changes are the new setting, the channel's deprecation warning, and the stale `%title%` note; the E2E report comment carries the daemon evidence.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment

Local Linux, Node 24, unit tests and the isolated E2E daemon described above. macOS and Windows were not run locally; CI covers them.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: detection latency moves from the channel's 60-second poll to the daemon's refresh interval (5 minutes by default), and the daemon's CI predicate counts cancelled and stale checks as failing, so superseded runs can produce `ci_failure` noise. Both are named in the design and the user page.
- Main risk or tradeoff: detection latency moves from the channel's 60-second poll to the daemon's refresh interval (5 minutes by default), and the daemon's CI predicate counts cancelled and stale checks as failing, so superseded runs can produce `ci_failure` noise. Both are named in the design and the user page. Removing the configurable `prWatchLimit` also removes the comment watch's old 30-PR fan-out cap: the channel now comment-fetches every bound PR, so the ~70–75 bound-PR ceiling of a 5,000/hour PAT is reached sooner. The pass still yields at the 200-request reserve, so the effect is skipped passes and delayed comments rather than rejected requests; an operator with many bindings should lower `pollInterval` or set `prCommentWatch: false`.
- Not validated / out of scope: the channel's comment-lane rewrite, the transition rules, the drain's locking and the delivery envelope; PR A settled those. The one-minute refresh floor and the alias while the refresh timer is disabled are documented rather than changed.

prs.title: test(integration): deflake queued-input parity case (#17217)
prs.body:
## What this PR does This PR stabilizes the queued-input case in the TUI agent-loop parity suite. The case's shell tool now blocks until the harness confirms the queued follow-up is visibly in the TUI queue, instead of the harness relying on fixed sleeps to beat the tool's exit. A small workspace script prints the marker the harness waits for and then polls for a release file; the harness writes that file only after the queued prompt's preview row is on screen. The scenario's expectations, assertions, and the shared/control/kernel comparisons are unchanged. ## Why it's needed CI failure patrol flagged this case as flaky on #17199. The follow-up input's Enter and the shell tool's exit were unordered: under contention the message could be handled after the tool result, so it started a third turn instead of riding the tool-result round, changing the request count and the recorded message order. The fix makes that ordering explicit rather than approximating it with sleeps. ## Reviewer Test Plan ### How to verify Run the named case repeatedly from `integration-tests` (each invocation runs the control, shared-loop, and event-bus-kernel arms): `QWEN_SANDBOX=false npx vitest run interactive/tui-agent-loop-parity.test.ts -t 'input queued while a tool runs'`. Expect every run to pass in roughly 20–26 seconds; the old scenario spent 5 seconds inside the tool. To confirm the handshake is load-bearing, temporarily write the release marker before sending the queued input and remove the preview wait; the case should fail with `expected 3 to be 2`, meaning the queued message started its own turn. Restore the handshake and it passes again. ### Evidence (Before & After) Before: the case waited a fixed second after `queue-now`, then pressed Enter with no guarantee the message was enqueued before the 5-second tool exited. Removing the new ordering makes the case fail deterministically with `expected 3 to be 2`. After: six consecutive passes of the named case (25.5s, 21.1s, 21.2s, 20.9s, 21.0s, 21.4s) with the scenario's request/round/batch counts, `sent` assertion, and parity comparisons untouched. ### Tested on | OS | Status | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ | | 🐧 Linux | ✅ | ### Environment (optional) The integration harness drives the bundled CLI (`dist/cli.js`) under Node 22 with `QWEN_SANDBOX=false`. ## Risk & Scope - Main risk or tradeoff: test-only change. The scenario now waits for the queue preview instead of a timer, so a renderer that never showed the preview would fail the case with a timeout and its viewport rather than silently passing. - Not validated / out of scope: macOS, Windows, and the exact CI contention that triggered the flake. Evidence is six repeated Linux runs plus the deterministic mutation probe. - Breaking changes / migration notes: none. ## Linked Issues Fixes #17217
中文说明 ## 本 PR 做了什么 本 PR 稳定了 TUI agent-loop parity 套件中的排队输入用例。该用例的 shell 工具现在会一直阻塞，直到测试框架确认排队的后续输入已经显示在 TUI 队列中；不再依赖测试框架用固定 sleep 去抢在工具退出之前完成输入。一个小型工作区脚本会打印测试框架等待的标记，然后轮询释放文件；只有排队提示的预览行出现在屏幕上之后，测试框架才写入该文件。场景的预期、断言以及 shared/control/kernel 对比均未改变。 ## 为什么需要它 CI failure patrol 在 #17199 上将这个用例标记为偶发失败。后续输入的回车与 shell 工具的退出之间没有顺序保证：资源竞争时，消息可能在工具结果之后才被处理，于是它开启了第三个回合，而不是搭上工具结果回合，导致请求数量和记录的消息顺序改变。本修复把这一顺序显式化，而不是用 sleep 近似。 ## 评审测试计划 ### 如何验证 在 `integration-tests` 目录下重复运行该命名用例（每次调用都会跑 control、shared-loop 和 event-bus-kernel 三条臂）：`QWEN_SANDBOX=false npx vitest run interactive/tui-agent-loop-parity.test.ts -t 'input queued while a tool runs'`。预期每次都能在约 20–26 秒内通过；旧场景会在工具里固定消耗 5 秒。若要确认握手是承重的，可临时在发送排队输入之前写入释放标记并去掉预览等待；用例应以 `expected 3 to be 2` 失败，表示排队消息开启了独立回合。恢复握手后即可重新通过。 ### 证据（修复前与修复后） 修复前：用例在 `queue-now` 之后固定等待一秒，然后按回车，无法保证消息在 5 秒工具退出前已经入队。去掉新的顺序保证后，用例会以 `expected 3 to be 2` 确定性失败。修复后：该命名用例连续通过六次（25.5s、21.1s、21.2s、20.9s、21.0s、21.4s），场景的请求/回合/批次计数、`sent` 断言和 parity 对比均保持不变。 ### 测试环境 | OS | 状态 | | :--------: | :--: | | 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ | | 🐧 Linux | ✅ | ### 环境（可选） 集成测试框架在 Node 22 下、以 `QWEN_SANDBOX=false` 驱动打包后的 CLI（`dist/cli.js`）。 ## 风险与范围 - 主要风险或取舍：仅测试改动。场景现在等待队列预览而不是计时器；如果某个渲染器从不显示预览，用例会带着超时和屏幕内容失败，而不是静默通过。 - 未验证 / 超出范围：macOS、Windows，以及触发该偶发失败的确切 CI 资源竞争条件。证据是六次 Linux 重复运行加上确定性的变异探针。 - 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。 ## 关联 Issue Fixes #17217

prs.title: fix(acp): surface failed todo_write calls instead of dropping them
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Failed `todo_write` calls are now reported to the ACP client as a terminal `tool_call_update` with `status: failed`, instead of producing no frame at all. Successes keep the existing plan-only representation, which is what the client renders as the task list.

## Why it's needed

A `todo_write` result is deliberately rendered as a plan update rather than a tool card, and every failure path returned early without emitting anything:

- `ToolCallEmitter.emitResult` returned on `!success`;
- `Session.runTool` skipped the terminal emission for `todo_write`;
- the `earlyErrorResponse` path skipped `TODO_WRITE`;
- a discarded tool-call preparation returned without a frame;
- transcript replay dropped the record the same way.

A failed `todo_write` normally writes no plan, so a failed call was invisible on the wire: no plan frame, no `tool_call` start, no `tool_call_update`. In ACP hosts the plan panel is the *only* progress surface, so the failure was silently swallowed and there was nothing to diagnose from. This was called out as an actionable follow-up in the triage for this issue.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Run the emitter tests: `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/acp-integration/session/emitters/tool-call-emitter.test.ts` — the new cases assert that a failed `todo_write` result emits one `tool_call_update` with `status: 'failed'` and the error text, that an execution error message wins over the display text, and that a subagent `todo_write` still emits nothing.
2. Run the replay tests: `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/acp-integration/session/history-replayer.test.ts` — the new cases assert that replaying a failed `todo_write` record surfaces a failed tool update, while a successful record without a plan still emits no tool update.
3. Optional end-to-end check: make `todo_write` fail (for example by sending a todo list with a dependency cycle) and confirm the ACP stream now carries a failed `tool_call_update` for that call id.

I also ran the whole `packages/cli` `Session.test.ts` suite (1436 tests) — it passes.

Expected: the failure is observable. Observed before the change: nothing was emitted.

I also ran the whole `packages/cli` `Session.test.ts` suite (1436 tests) — it passes.

Note on the red/green check: with only the test files applied, the new replay test fails against unmodified `transcript-replay.ts` and passes after the fix; the emitter tests were written against the fixed emitter, and the equivalent pre-change behaviour was a bare `return`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Non-UI change (wire protocol): N/A for screenshots.

Before: a failed `todo_write` produced no `sessionUpdate` frame at all.
After: it produces `{ sessionUpdate: 'tool_call_update', status: 'failed', content: [<error text>], _meta: { toolName: 'todo_write' } }`.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only, run from a fresh worktree with `packages/*/node_modules` symlinked to the main checkout.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: ACP hosts now receive a `tool_call_update` for `todo_write`, a tool that normally never produces one. Clients that key on the tool name to suppress todo cards could show an extra failed card — which is the intent here, but it is a visible behaviour change.
- Not validated / out of scope: I did not run the full `npm run build`, nor the rest of the `packages/cli` suite beyond `Session.test.ts` and the two files above. I did not verify the change against a real JetBrains/ACP client.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none for the transcript format; replay and the live path now agree.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #8544

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

失败的 `todo_write` 调用现在会向 ACP 客户端发送一条终态的 `tool_call_update`（`status: failed`），而不是什么都不发。成功的调用维持原有「只发 plan」的表示方式，客户端把它渲染成任务列表。

## 为什么需要

`todo_write` 的结果是被有意渲染成 plan 更新而不是工具卡片的，而所有失败路径都提前返回、什么都不发：

- `ToolCallEmitter.emitResult` 在 `!success` 时直接返回；
- `Session.runTool` 对 `todo_write` 跳过终态发送；
- `earlyErrorResponse` 路径跳过 `TODO_WRITE`；
- 被丢弃的工具调用准备阶段直接返回、不发帧；
- 会话重放同样丢弃该记录。

失败的 `todo_write` 一般不会写出 plan，所以一次失败的调用在协议层上完全不可见：没有 plan 帧、没有 `tool_call` 起始帧、也没有 `tool_call_update`。在 ACP 宿主里 plan 面板是**唯一**的进度界面，因此失败被静默吞掉、无从排查。这一点已在该 issue 的 triage 中被列为可执行的后续项。

## 评审者的验证方式

### 如何验证

1. 跑 emitter 测试：`cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/acp-integration/session/emitters/tool-call-emitter.test.ts`。新增用例断言失败的 `todo_write` 结果会发出一条 `status: 'failed'` 的 `tool_call_update` 并带上错误文本，执行错误信息优先于展示文本，子 agent 的 `todo_write` 仍然不发任何帧。
2. 跑重放测试：`cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/acp-integration/session/history-replayer.test.ts`。新增用例断言重放一条失败的 `todo_write` 记录会还原出失败的 tool update，而成功但没有 plan 的记录仍然不产生 tool update。
3. 可选端到端：让 `todo_write` 失败（例如提交带依赖环的 todo 列表），确认 ACP 流里出现了对应 call id 的失败 `tool_call_update`。

另外也跑完了整个 `packages/cli` 的 `Session.test.ts`（1436 条），全部通过。

预期：失败可见。改动前观察到：什么都没发。

关于红→绿：只应用测试文件时，新增的重放用例在未修改的 `transcript-replay.ts` 上失败，应用修复后通过；emitter 用例是针对修复后的实现写的，改动前的等价行为是一句裸 `return`。

### 证据（Before & After）

非 UI 改动（协议帧），截图不适用。

改动前：失败的 `todo_write` 不产生任何 `sessionUpdate` 帧。
改动后：产生 `{ sessionUpdate: 'tool_call_update', status: 'failed', content: [<错误文本>], _meta: { toolName: 'todo_write' } }`。

### 测试环境

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### 环境

只跑了单元测试，在新建的 worktree 里执行，`packages/*/node_modules` 软链到主克隆。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：ACP 宿主现在会收到原本不会出现的 `todo_write` 的 `tool_call_update`。按工具名抑制 todo 卡片的客户端可能会多显示一张失败卡片——这正是本次改动的意图，但确实是可见的行为变化。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：没有跑完整的 `npm run build`，也没有跑 `packages/cli` 套件里除 `Session.test.ts` 和上面两个文件之外的部分。没有在真实的 JetBrains/ACP 客户端上验证。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：transcript 格式无变更；重放路径与实时路径现在一致。

## 关联 issue

Fixes #8544

prs.title: fix(ci): route classify_pr by association and admit dispatch to the fleet
prs.body:
## What this PR does

`classify_pr`'s `runs-on` goes back to association-gated routing: same-repo PRs, fork PRs whose author has write access (OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR), the merge queue, pushes to main, and `workflow_dispatch` run on the self-hosted pool; every other fork PR falls back to `ubuntu-latest`.

`workflow_dispatch` is included because the comment above the job already promised it while the expression did not deliver it: `github.event.pull_request` is empty on a dispatch, so every PR clause was false and a maintainer-triggered run fell to the hosted runner. The dispatch arm follows the same `linux_runner` input the job's own routing step already treats as authoritative, so a maintainer who asks for hosted because the pool is drained gets hosted here too; `classify_pr` also gains an explicit 10-minute timeout, since it is the `needs` prerequisite of every Linux lane.

The expression keeps `github.repository == 'QwenLM/qwen-code'` as its leading condition. Without it, a fork named `qwen-code` satisfies `head.repo.full_name == github.repository` on its own PRs and resolves to self-hosted labels the fork does not have — `classify_pr` would never return and the run would produce no verdict at all.

The routing test matrix follows the change: it pins the default routing for every association and same-repo combination, keeps the kill-switch winning for everyone, and now also pins the dispatch case across three associations (including the empty one a dispatch actually carries).

## Why it's needed

`#16019` removed the association clause so that fork PRs would stop queueing on the scarce hosted pool. That traded a real queue problem for a misleading one: the job's own comment went on describing a gate that no longer existed.

What this restores is a **routing policy, not a security boundary**, and the repository already records that. `docs/design/2026-10-31-lint-static-ecs-routing.md` states that "the association gate is throughput policy, not an enforceable trust boundary": a `pull_request` run executes the PR's own YAML, so a fork can delete this clause in the same diff that rewrites `runs-on` — which is exactly what `#16019` did — and GitHub's first-timer workflow approval is the outer gate that actually holds.

So the value here is twofold and modest: unreviewed forks stop occupying a scarce self-hosted pool by default, and the clause stays as one layer of defence in depth for the accidental case, not the deliberate one. This PR should not be cited as fork hardening.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. `node --test .github/scripts/ci-runner-routing.test.mjs` — all 111 tests pass, including the association matrix and the new dispatch pins.
2. Open a fork PR from an account without write access: `Classify PR` starts on `ubuntu-latest` instead of a self-hosted runner.
3. Set `MAINTAINER_ECS_RUNNER_DISABLED=true` and re-run: every event returns to the hosted pool, dispatch included.
4. Run `workflow_dispatch` on this workflow: `Classify PR` lands on the self-hosted pool (this is the case the expression used to miss).
5. `bash .github/scripts/check-workflow-size.sh` — exit 0 with the baseline entry described below.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — routing and prose only, no user-visible behaviour.

Mutation for the new dispatch pin: deleting `|| github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'` from the expression gives 110 pass / 1 fail with `AssertionError: dispatch (assoc='') must reach ECS`; restoring it returns 111/111.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | ✅ Routing tests 111/111 pass |
| Windows | N/A |
| Linux | Covered by this PR's CI |

### Environment (optional)

N/A — Node's built-in test runner against the checked-in workflow YAML.

## Risk & Scope

- **Tradeoff:** untrusted fork PRs queue on the hosted pool for the `classify_pr` gate (~30 min observed on #15851). The gate is lightweight (base-SHA checkout plus shell routing), so that delay is the price of not spending self-hosted capacity on unreviewed forks — a throughput trade, not a trust decision.
- **Size ratchet:** `ci.yml` ships at **217,327** bytes against merge base `e1755142` at 216,195 — **+1,132 from this PR**. `.size-baseline` recorded `217,019`, a number set from an intermediate commit on this branch, so this PR re-records it to `217,327` instead of banking the 308-byte gap inside the 4,096 allowance. Composition against the old baseline: **+4,051 was main-side drift** (main's `ci.yml` was already 216,195 while the baseline still said 212,144) and **+1,132 is this PR** — the association clause, the dispatch arm and the routing pins — partly paid back by collapsing the triplicated policy prose into a single canonical copy in the design doc.
- **Not a security boundary:** as above. A fork that rewrites the YAML can remove this clause; GitHub's first-timer workflow approval is the control that applies there.
- **Out of scope:** `lint_and_static` keeps its unconditional fleet routing (accepted 2026-10-31, tracked in #16514). The `issue_comment`-triggered workflows (`auto-minimize-spam`, `comment-attachment-guard`, `qwen-code-pr-review`) run the default branch's YAML, so the modify-YAML route does not apply to them; their self-hosted routing still lacks an explicit fork clause, which is a separate question.
- **No breaking changes:** downstream outputs (`ubuntu_runner`, `lint_runner`, `pr_test_runner`) are unchanged.

## Linked Issues

Related to #16514 (isolate external PR CI with disposable runners). This PR does **not** close that issue's dispatch-boundary acceptance step, and this description should not claim it does: that step asks for a controlled fork PR to prove a fork that rewrites `runs-on` never executes on the sensitive pool, and no expression inside the workflow can satisfy it — a fork deletes this clause in the same diff, as the Why section above concedes. What this PR restores is the default routing and the dispatch arm; the acceptance step stays open.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

`classify_pr` 的 `runs-on` 恢复为按 association 路由：同仓库 PR、作者有写权限（OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR）的 fork PR、merge queue、推送到 main、以及 `workflow_dispatch` 走自建池；其余 fork PR 回退到 `ubuntu-latest`。

之所以把 `workflow_dispatch` 一并纳入：作业上方的注释早就这样承诺，而表达式并没有兑现——dispatch 事件下 `github.event.pull_request` 为空，所有 PR 条件均为假，维护者手动触发的运行实际落到托管 runner。该分支同时服从 `linux_runner` 输入（与作业自身的路由步骤一致）：维护者因池排空而要求 hosted 时，这里也走 hosted；此外 `classify_pr` 补了显式 10 分钟超时，因为它是所有 Linux 车道的 `needs` 前置。

表达式最前面保留 `github.repository == 'QwenLM/qwen-code'`：没有它时，一个名叫 `qwen-code` 的 fork 在自己的 PR 上就能满足 `head.repo.full_name == github.repository`，从而解析到该 fork 并不存在的自建 label——`classify_pr` 永不返回，整条 run 没有任何裁决。

路由测试矩阵随之更新：逐组合钉住默认路由与同仓库情形、保留 kill-switch 对所有人优先，并新增 dispatch 的钉子（三种 association，含 dispatch 实际携带的空值）。

## 为什么需要

`#16019` 移除了 association 子句，好让 fork PR 不再排在稀缺的托管池后面。它用一个真实的排队问题，换来了一个误导：作业自己的注释仍在描述一道已经不存在的门。

本 PR 恢复的是**路由策略，不是安全边界**——仓库自己也是这么记的。`docs/design/2026-10-31-lint-static-ecs-routing.md` 明确写着「the association gate is throughput policy, not an enforceable trust boundary」：`pull_request` 运行执行的是 PR 自己的 YAML，fork 在改写 `runs-on` 的同一个 diff 里就能删掉这个子句（`#16019` 正是这么干的），真正起作用的闸门是 GitHub 对首次贡献者的 workflow 审批。

所以这里的价值是两层且有限：未审 fork 默认不再占用稀缺自建池，同时该子句作为纵深防御的一层保留下来——它防的是无意的情形，不是刻意的。**不要把本 PR 当作 fork 加固来引用。**

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

1. `node --test .github/scripts/ci-runner-routing.test.mjs` —— 111 项全过，含 association 矩阵与新增的 dispatch 钉子。
2. 用一个没有写权限的账号开 fork PR：`Classify PR` 应落在 `ubuntu-latest` 而非自建 runner。
3. 设 `MAINTAINER_ECS_RUNNER_DISABLED=true` 后重跑：所有事件（含 dispatch）都回托管池。
4. 对本工作流执行 `workflow_dispatch`：`Classify PR` 应落在自建池——这正是表达式原先漏掉的情形。
5. `bash .github/scripts/check-workflow-size.sh` —— exit 0，且基线条目如下文所述。

### 证据（修改前后）

N/A —— 仅路由与文案，无用户可见行为变化。

新增 dispatch 钉子的变异验证：删掉表达式里的 `|| github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'` → 110 pass / 1 fail，报 `AssertionError: dispatch (assoc='') must reach ECS`；还原 → 111/111。

### 测试环境

| OS | 状态 |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | ✅ 路由测试 111/111 通过 |
| Windows | N/A |
| Linux | 由本 PR 的 CI 覆盖 |

### 环境（可选）

N/A —— 用 Node 自带的测试运行器直接针对仓库内的 workflow YAML。

## 风险与范围

- **权衡：** 不可信 fork PR 的 `classify_pr` 会在托管池排队（`#15851` 观察到约 30 分钟）。该 gate 很轻（base-SHA checkout 加 shell 路由），这个延迟换来的是「不把自建容量花在未审 fork 上」——是吞吐权衡，不是信任决策。
- **体积棘轮：** `ci.yml` 现在出货 **217,327** 字节，合并基点 `e1755142` 是 216,195，**本 PR 增加 1,132 字节**。`.size-baseline` 里记的 `217,019` 是本分支中间某个 commit 的数字，因此本 PR 把它重记为 `217,327`，而不是把 308 字节的差额藏进 4,096 的允许量。相对旧基线的构成：**+4,051 是 main 侧漂移**（main 的 `ci.yml` 早已 216,195，而基线还写着 212,144），**+1,132 是本 PR**——association 子句、dispatch 支与路由钉，其中一部分由把三份重复的政策文案收敛成设计文档里的唯一一份回吐。
- **不是安全边界：** 同上。改写 YAML 的 fork 可以删掉这个子句；那种情形下起作用的是 GitHub 的首次贡献者 workflow 审批。
- **范围外：** `lint_and_static` 保持无条件 fleet 路由（2026-10-31 已接受，见 #16514）。`issue_comment` 触发的三个工作流（`auto-minimize-spam`、`comment-attachment-guard`、`qwen-code-pr-review`）执行的是默认分支的 YAML，故「改 YAML」路径对它们不适用；它们的自建路由缺少显式 fork 子句是另一个问题。
- **无破坏性变更：** 下游输出（`ubuntu_runner`、`lint_runner`、`pr_test_runner`）不变。

## 关联 Issue

与 #16514（用一次性 runner 隔离外部 PR 的 CI）相关。本 PR **没有**关掉该 issue 的 dispatch 边界验收项，正文也不应这样声称：该项要求用受控 fork PR 证明「改写 `runs-on` 的 fork 永远不会在敏感池上执行」，而 workflow 里的任何表达式都无法满足它——fork 在同一个 diff 里就能删掉这个子句，正如上文 Why 段所承认的。本 PR 恢复的是默认路由与 dispatch 支；验收项仍然开放。

</details>

prs.title: fix(acp): schedule managed skill review on ACP turns
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Runs the managed skill review on ACP turns (`qwen serve`, daemon, the ACP-bridged CLIs) the same way the interactive CLI does, instead of leaving the trigger state accumulating and unread. The auto-skill gate that used to be inlined in the client's post-turn memory tasks is now a small public method, and ACP's post-turn path calls it in the branch where ACP — not the client — owns that work.

## Why it's needed

`Session.runTool()` calls `recordCompletedToolCall()` on every completed tool, which increments `LlmClient.toolCallCount` and sets `skillsModifiedInSession`. Those two fields exist only to feed `MemoryManager.scheduleSkillReview()`. On the interactive path that call happens inside `runManagedAutoMemoryBackgroundTasks()`; ACP's `Session` never calls that method — it schedules Extract and Dream itself in `#recordPromptCompletionEffects()` and stops there. So on `qwen serve` the counter only ever grew, `AUTO_SKILL_THRESHOLD` was never evaluated, and a long daemon session never produced an auto-skill candidate while reporting nothing about it. The design doc for the ACP auto-memory work recorded this as deliberately deferred by that PR; the issue asks for it to be closed, and a maintainer review of the same issue agreed the extraction is the right shape.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Unit level: on `origin/main`, `packages/cli/src/acp-integration/session/Session.test.ts` has no test that reaches skill review, and `runManagedAutoSkillReview` does not exist. With this branch:

```
cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/core/client.test.ts -t autoSkill
cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/acp-integration/session/Session.test.ts -t "managed auto-memory"
```

Expected: the new ACP case asserts the post-turn branch calls `runManagedAutoSkillReview()` exactly once and still does not call `runManagedAutoMemoryBackgroundTasks()`; the new core cases assert the extracted method reads the live `toolCallCount` and no-ops when `getAutoSkillEnabled()` is false.

Removing the one added line in `Session.ts` and re-running the ACP case fails it (`toHaveBeenCalledOnce()` on the new method), which is the regression this PR closes.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no user-visible surface changes; the observable effect is `.qwen/pending-skills/` receiving staged candidates after enough tool calls on a served session, which needs an enabled auto-skill setting and a real model round to reach.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only; `packages/core` was built with `scripts/build_package.js` so the CLI suite could import it.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the legacy ACP branch now schedules work it did not before. It is gated by `getAutoSkillEnabled()`, which is opt-in (`memory.enableAutoSkill`, off by default), false in bare/safe mode, and false under a shell sandbox. With `autoSkillConfirm` at its default (true), a review only stages new skills in `.qwen/pending-skills/` — the artifact the TUI accept/discard dialog reads — so it cannot silently write into a skills root.
- Not validated / out of scope: ACP has no accept/reject surface for pending skills (that is a separate product decision, tracked as a follow-up); the review still fires at user-turn boundaries only, so a threshold crossed mid-turn is deferred to the next turn rather than dropped. Not exercised: a live `qwen serve` session with a real model round, and Windows/Linux.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #12209

prs.title: feat(core): reduce repeated edit text with snapshot references
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Recoverable edit failures now return bounded current target content instead of only asking the model to read again. A session-scoped recovery reference lets the next edit omit the old text and reuse the previous replacement when it is still appropriate. Bounded reads and complete success snippets also provide snapshot references for whole-line edits, avoiding old-text transcription on the first attempt.

References are materialized before hooks, permissions and approval, so reviewers see the actual proposal. Exact source bytes, file identity and version are checked through confirmation, execution and pre-write. Only a complete recovery block included in the outgoing model request activates its reference; history changes and stale snapshots invalidate it.

## Why it's needed

Observed user sessions show small transcription mistakes triggering another read and large repeated old/new payloads. This change implements all three stages of the recovery design: actionable failures, recovery references, and read-range references. It includes fifty sanitized observed failures from fifty independent sessions and keeps the original evidence and anonymization maps private.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Read a small text file and edit a selected range using its returned snapshot reference. When the file has duplicate blocks, only the selected range should change. Deliberately misspell an ordinary replacement's old text while keeping its surrounding context: the failure should show the current candidate without writing, and an explicit recovery-reference retry should succeed without repeating old text. Omit the replacement to reuse it, or supply a corrected replacement.

Change the file after a reference is issued and verify the old proposal is rejected without overwriting the change. Read denial must suppress candidate disclosure. Hooks and human confirmation must receive real old/new content, and a hook's replacement must be honored. Large, ambiguous, unsupported or incompletely delivered targets must retain a safe conventional fallback.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the installed CLI rejected both reference-only forms for missing old text; no-match returned no current content, and stale recovery required another read. After: twelve compiled-CLI scenarios pass, including an actual terminal approval interaction, compact wire arguments, duplicate ranges, encoding, permissions, hooks and two sanitized production cases.

The fifty-case real-I/O corpus reproduces 39 no-match and 11 stale rejections with unchanged file bytes. Seven cases have independent same-target expected results, all passing: four recover by recovery reference and three by bounded read-range reference. The other 43 prove refusal safety, not recovery correctness; offering a candidate reference is not counted as proof that it is the intended target.

Local verification passed 2,774 core tests and 1,574 ACP tests, full build/typecheck, bundle startup-closure checks, lint and formatting. A bounded real `DeepSeek/deepseek-v4-flash` smoke completed five API requests and four tool calls: bounded read, read-reference edit, intentional no-match, then recovery-reference retry with neither old/new nor an intervening read. Captured API arguments and final file content matched expectations.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Node 22.17.0; real filesystem, compiled CLI and terminal approval |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not run locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not run locally |

### Environment

Standard local Node execution. Deterministic CLI scenarios use a localhost mock provider; the separate configured DeepSeek smoke uses a real provider. The original global CLI baseline is 0.18.5-preview.0; the candidate bundle is 0.27.2.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: this is a core feature spanning tool declarations, read delivery, approval and lifecycle state. Maintainer review is requested. References use exact snapshots rather than automatic fuzzy writes or relocation.
- Not validated / out of scope: reference transport for managed/container/SSH execution, provider-wide schema compatibility, paired token/latency experiments, and production rollout. Real AUTO-classifier and real IDE modify-and-confirm acceptance were not exercised end to end.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: conventional edit inputs remain supported. Reference-enabled sessions use bounded raw-text read output. Source snapshots are limited to 1 MiB; each reference block to 120 lines/16 KiB; session retention to eight references/1 MiB. Unsupported routes do not issue references. No persistent-state migration is introduced.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/22c763636a297190eb121a9973269bf571c4018c/docs/design/2026-11-14-edit-recovery.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/22c763636a297190eb121a9973269bf571c4018c/docs/design/2026-11-14-edit-recovery.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Refs #14979.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

可恢复的 edit 失败会返回有界的当前目标内容。下一次编辑可以使用 session 范围的恢复引用，免传 old；原替换内容仍适用时，也无需重复 new。有界读取和完整成功片段还提供快照引用，让首次整行编辑也不必转录旧文本。

引用会在 hook、权限和审批前展开，审核方继续看到真实提案。在确认、执行及最后写入前核对准确源字节、文件身份和版本。只有完整恢复块进入待发送模型请求时，引用才会激活；历史变化和快照过期会使引用失效。

## 为什么需要

真实会话中，小的转录错误会触发重读和大段 old/new 重发。本 PR 一起实现方案的三个阶段：可直接用于恢复的失败反馈、恢复引用、读取范围引用，并包含来自五十个独立 session 的五十例脱敏真实失败。原始证据及脱敏映射保持私有。

## 审核者测试计划

### 如何验证

读取小文本文件，使用返回的快照引用修改指定范围；存在重复块时，只应修改选中范围。故意把普通编辑的 old 写错，同时保留外围上下文：失败应返回当前候选且不写文件，随后明确选择恢复引用即可免传 old 重试。可省略 new 复用原替换内容，或提交修正后的 new。

引用发出后修改文件，旧提案应被拒绝，不能覆盖新变化。Read 拒绝时不应暴露候选。hook 和人工确认应看到真实 old/new，hook 修改的 new 应被采用。超大、歧义、不支持或未完整送达的目标应保留安全的普通调用回退。

### 前后证据

之前：全局 CLI 会因缺少 old 拒绝两种仅引用调用；no-match 不返回当前内容，stale 后必须重读。之后：十二个编译 CLI 场景通过，包含真实终端确认、紧凑 wire 参数、重复范围、编码、权限、hook，以及两例脱敏生产案例。

五十例真实 I/O 语料复现了 39 个 no-match、11 个 stale，失败前后文件字节不变。七例有独立的同目标预期结果，全部通过：四例走恢复引用，三例走有界读取范围引用。另外 43 例证明拒写安全，不证明恢复正确；发出了候选引用也不等于证实它是预期目标。

本地 2,774 个 core 测试、1,574 个 ACP 测试，以及完整 build/typecheck、bundle 启动依赖检查、lint 和格式检查通过。真实 `DeepSeek/deepseek-v4-flash` 有界 smoke 完成五次 API 请求、四次工具调用：有界读取、读取引用编辑、故意 no-match、仅恢复引用重试，没有 old/new 或中间重读。API 捕获参数和最终文件均符合预期。

### 测试系统

| OS | 状态 |
| :---: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Node 22.17.0；真实文件系统、编译 CLI 和终端确认 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地运行 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未在本地运行 |

### 环境

标准本地 Node 执行。确定性 CLI 场景使用 localhost mock provider，单独的 DeepSeek smoke 使用真实 provider。原全局 CLI 基线为 0.18.5-preview.0，候选 bundle 为 0.27.2。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险及取舍：这是涉及工具声明、读取送达、审批和生命周期状态的 Core 功能，请 maintainer 审核。引用绑定准确快照，不自动模糊写入或重定位。
- 未验证及范围外：managed/container/SSH 的引用传输、全部 provider 的 schema 兼容、token/耗时配对实验及生产发布。没有对真实 AUTO 分类器或真实 IDE modify-and-confirm 做端到端验收。
- 兼容及迁移：继续支持普通 edit 参数；启用引用的 session 使用有界原文读取输出。源快照上限 1 MiB，单个引用块 120 行/16 KiB，session 最多保留八个引用/1 MiB。不支持的路径不发引用，没有持久化状态迁移。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/22c763636a297190eb121a9973269bf571c4018c/docs/design/2026-11-14-edit-recovery.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/22c763636a297190eb121a9973269bf571c4018c/docs/design/2026-11-14-edit-recovery.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #14979。

</details>

prs.title: feat(cli): add OpenTUI selection clipboard and right-click paste
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds first-class clipboard and mouse interactions to the OpenTUI renderer: completing a text selection in any region copies it, a transient confirmation appears at the bottom, and right-click is a shell-wide two-way action (clear a transcript selection, otherwise paste into the composer). It also adds page/home/end transcript navigation, a jump-to-bottom hint, and an opt-in native scrollbar.

It also makes the native clipboard fallback usable on macOS and Windows for app-level text reads, while keeping Linux's existing tool chain and OSC 52 fallback.

## Why it's needed

OpenTUI previously only painted a selection: releasing the mouse did not copy, right-click did nothing, and the transcript scrollbar consumed a column. On macOS and Windows the shared clipboard path returned no text, so a right-click text paste was a no-op even when image paste worked. This makes the OpenTUI surface match the interaction users expect and closes the platform gap without changing Linux behavior.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Set `QWEN_TUI_RENDERER=opentui` and launch the built CLI in a terminal that reports mouse events (not Apple Terminal.app; see the macOS terminal notes below).

Drag-select text in the transcript, footer, and composer; release. Expect the highlight to remain, the text on the clipboard, and a two-second bottom-right confirmation. The confirmation uses the bottom row when the jump hint is hidden and moves up one row when it is shown. Selecting text inside a dialog or confirmation also copies it, but silently: the confirmation is never drawn over a modal. Left-click once in the transcript (no drag), then right-click: the clipboard should still be pasted. Focus a foreground shell (Ctrl+F) and right-click: the clipboard text should go to the shell, not the composer.

Right-click with no transcript selection; expect the clipboard text to be pasted through the composer's existing paste path (image-first, then text). Right-click with a transcript selection; expect the selection to clear and nothing to paste. Repeat over the composer and footer; the paste should work there too.

Scroll away from the tail; expect the `Jump to bottom (ctrl+End)` hint. PageUp/PageDown move one viewport; Ctrl+Home/Ctrl+End jump to the ends; clicking the hint returns to the tail.

Launch with `ui.showOpenTuiScrollbar` unset and confirm the transcript has no native bar; set it true and restart to see OpenTUI's default bar, which shows whenever the transcript overflows.

On macOS, confirm text copies via `pbcopy` and right-click text paste reads through the native addon; a copied line should not gain a trailing blank row. On Windows, the same backend is wired through `clip` and the native addon, but OpenTUI packaging is not part of this PR.

Terminal requirements on macOS: Apple Terminal.app does not implement xterm mouse reporting, so drag-select and right-click never reach the app there — use Terminal.app's own selection and ⌘C/⌘V. iTerm2 keeps its native context menu on right-click even with mouse reporting enabled, so use the menu's Paste (or ⌘V) instead of the in-app right-click paste. Terminals that forward right-click — VS Code's integrated terminal, Ghostty, kitty, WezTerm — get the in-app behavior.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: OpenTUI selection only painted; right-click was a no-op; there was no copy confirmation; the scrollbar always occupied a column.

After: selection copies with a confirmation, right-click clears or pastes, page/edge navigation and the jump hint work, and the scrollbar is hidden by default.

Linux and Windows x64 were verified manually with the bundled Bun runtime (Windows: Bun 1.4.4, real mouse input through ConPTY). macOS arm64 was verified on hardware with iTerm2 and Bun 1.3.11 using real SGR mouse input: drag-select copy in the transcript and composer, the copy confirmation, right-click paste and selection clearing, PageUp/PageDown and Ctrl+Home/Ctrl+End, the jump hint (including clicking it), and both scrollbar states. The macOS clipboard paths were exercised against the real system clipboard: `pbcopy` writes, the `@teddyzhu/clipboard` addon read, and CRLF/trailing-newline normalization.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ✅   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment

Local build of the CLI, OpenTUI via the bundled Bun 1.4.4 runtime on Linux/Windows and Bun 1.3.11 on macOS; the focused suites (195 tests) and typecheck run locally.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the native clipboard helper now owns the write path on Linux and adds app-level text reads on macOS/Windows. Windows ARM64 OpenTUI packaging is still blocked on Bun and is out of scope; Windows x64 and macOS arm64 were validated on real terminals, with macOS exercised through iTerm2 using real SGR mouse input.
- Not validated / out of scope: Windows ARM64 packaging; no in-app context menu. Terminal-side limits are documented above: Terminal.app cannot report the mouse, and iTerm2 intercepts right-click.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: `ui.showOpenTuiScrollbar` is new and defaults to false (requires restart); on macOS/Windows the app now reads clipboard text where the previous behavior returned none. This also reaches Ink: its app-level clipboard key (Alt+V on Windows, Ctrl+V on macOS) now pastes clipboard text when there is no image, where it previously inserted nothing. A terminal bracketed paste is unaffected and still inserts once.

Design docs: [English](https://github.com/MikeWang0316tw/qwen-code/blob/feat/opentui-selection-clipboard/docs/design/2026-11-09-opentui-selection-clipboard.md) | [简体中文](https://github.com/MikeWang0316tw/qwen-code/blob/feat/opentui-selection-clipboard/docs/design/2026-11-09-opentui-selection-clipboard.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Tracking: #8662

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做什么

为 OpenTUI 渲染器补上完整的剪贴簿与鼠标交互：在任意区域完成文字选取后会复制，底部出现短暂确认；右键是全局的双向操作（有对话选取时清除，否则贴到 composer）。同时加入 PageUp/PageDown、Ctrl+Home/Ctrl+End、跳到底部提示，以及可选的原生 scrollbar。

它也让 macOS 与 Windows 的 app 层文字读取能走 native clipboard fallback，同时保留 Linux 原有的工具链与 OSC 52 fallback。

## 为什么需要

OpenTUI 之前只会把选取画成反白：放开鼠标不会复制、右键没有反应，而且对话 scrollbar 一直占一栏。在 macOS 与 Windows 上，共用的剪贴簿路径不会返回文字，所以即使图片贴上可用，右键文字贴上也完全没有反应。这个 PR 让 OpenTUI 的交互符合预期，并补上平台缺口，同时不改变 Linux 行为。

## 审查者测试计划

### 如何验证

设定 `QWEN_TUI_RENDERER=opentui`，在开启 mouse tracking 的终端启动 build 后的 CLI。

在 transcript、footer 与 composer 拖曳选取文字后放开。预期反白保留、文字进入剪贴簿、右下角出现两秒确认。jump hint 隐藏时确认使用最底列；hint 出现时确认往上移一列。在对话框或确认画面中选取文字也会复制，但不显示确认：确认绝不会盖在弹窗上。在 transcript 中单纯左键点一下（不拖曳），再按右键：剪贴簿内容仍应贴上。聚焦前台 shell（Ctrl+F）后按右键：剪贴簿文字应写入 shell，而不是 composer。

在没有对话选取时按右键；预期剪贴簿文字走 composer 既有的贴上路径（先图片、再文字）。有对话选取时按右键；预期清除选取且不贴上。在 composer 与 footer 上重复；右键贴上也应该有效。

往上卷离尾部；预期出现 `Jump to bottom (ctrl+End)` 提示。PageUp/PageDown 移动一个视窗页；Ctrl+Home/Ctrl+End 跳到两端；点提示回到尾部。

在 `ui.showOpenTuiScrollbar` 未设定时启动，确认 transcript 没有原生 scrollbar；设为 true 并重启，确认 OpenTUI 默认的 bar 回来（只要 transcript 超出视口就会显示）。

在 macOS 上确认文字透过 `pbcopy` 复制，右键文字贴上透过 native addon 读取；复制一行文字不应多出结尾空白列。Windows 使用 `clip` 与 native addon 的同一套 backend，但 OpenTUI 封装不在这个 PR 范围内。

macOS 终端限制：Apple Terminal.app 没有实作 xterm 鼠标回报，拖曳选取与右键根本不会送进 app，请改用 Terminal.app 自己的选取与 ⌘C/⌘V。iTerm2 即使开了 mouse reporting，右键仍会跳出它自己的选单，请用选单里的 Paste（或 ⌘V）代替 app 内右键贴上。会转发右键的终端（VS Code 整合终端、Ghostty、kitty、WezTerm）才有 app 内右键行为。

### 证据（Before & After）

Before：OpenTUI 选取只会反白；右键没有反应；没有复制确认；scrollbar 一直占一栏。

After：选取会复制并显示确认，右键可清除或贴上，翻页/跳端与 jump hint 正常，scrollbar 预设隐藏。

Linux 与 Windows x64 已用内附 Bun runtime 手动验证（Windows：Bun 1.4.4、透过 ConPTY 送真实鼠标输入）。macOS arm64 已在实机用 iTerm2 与 Bun 1.3.11、以真实 SGR 鼠标输入验证：transcript 与 composer 的拖曳复制、复制确认、右键贴上与清除选取、PageUp/PageDown 与 Ctrl+Home/Ctrl+End、jump hint（含点击）、两种 scrollbar 状态。macOS 剪贴簿路径也对着真实系统剪贴簿验证：`pbcopy` 写入、`@teddyzhu/clipboard` addon 读取，以及 CRLF/结尾换行正规化。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ✅   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### 环境

本地 build 的 CLI，OpenTUI 在 Linux/Windows 用内附 Bun 1.4.4、在 macOS 用 Bun 1.3.11；聚焦测试（195 个）与 typecheck 都在本地跑过。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：Linux 的 native 剪贴簿 helper 现在负责写入，macOS/Windows 则新增 app 层文字读取。Windows ARM64 的 OpenTUI 封装仍卡在 Bun，不在本 PR 范围；Windows x64 与 macOS arm64 都已在实机终端验证，macOS 是透过 iTerm2 送真实 SGR 鼠标输入完成。
- 未验证／不在范围：Windows ARM64 封装；没有 in-app context menu。终端本身的限制已写在上方：Terminal.app 无法回报鼠标，iTerm2 会拦截右键。
- 破坏性变更／迁移：`ui.showOpenTuiScrollbar` 是新设定，预设 false（需重启）；macOS/Windows 现在会读取剪贴簿文字，之前的行为是不读取。这也影响 Ink：其 app 层剪贴簿按键（Windows 为 Alt+V、macOS 为 Ctrl+V）在没有图片时现在会贴上剪贴簿文字，之前不会插入任何内容。终端机的 bracketed paste 不受影响，仍只插入一次。
