prs.title: perf(cli): reduce cold ACP initialization work
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Reduces work on the first native ACP session without starting a channel in advance. Independent extension resource reads overlap and drain before returning an ordered failure. The ripgrep check overlaps initialization and joins at the original tool decision, with cancellation drained on exit. Successful repeated YAML input reuses a bounded private raw result while callers receive fresh sanitized values. Unselected top-level commands and export/attach dependencies load when needed, preserving the original synchronous command builders and handlers.

## Why it's needed

A fresh session still pays for module loading, resource discovery and repeated parsing after the separately merged watcher optimization in #17177. In eight interleaved pairs against the same clean main revision, the complete first SDK median changes from 815.994 to 706.277 ms and the mean from 833.257 to 719.861 ms. One candidate pair is slower; every observation is retained. No source-only observation is below 500 ms, so this improves startup without completing that target.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Create fresh native ACP sessions with populated extension/Skill directories. Verify new identities, resource/tool readiness, workspace activation, edit/delete refresh and normal shutdown. Interrupt or fail initialization during a pending health check; its child must be reaped before initialization settles. A later tool rebuild must retry a failed check.

Compare help, command aliases, nested options, required-argument errors, completion markers and exit codes. Repeat YAML inputs and mutate nested return values; later results must stay independent and existing warnings/debug output must remain visible. Explicit refresh and new-session menus should converge after resource mutations. Ordinary catalog GETs retain their existing stale-while-revalidate contract; sampled refresh latency is not claimed identical.

### Evidence (Before & After)

No UI change. Same-main measurements use eight fresh processes per condition, a complete SDK await, no preheat and initially absent Node code caches:

| Metric | Main | Candidate |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| First SDK median / mean, ms | 815.994 / 833.257 | 706.277 / 719.861 |
| Daemon spawn through SDK completion median / mean, ms | 1456.511 / 1517.299 | 1385.197 / 1384.047 |
| First SDK below 500 ms | 0/8 | 0/8 |

Build, typecheck and bundle pass. CLI focused tests pass 1110/1110; Core passes 2090/2091, with the existing extension network-policy assertion independently reproduced on clean main and candidate. A subsequent test-only update corrects a managed-host spy for the optional private parameter; its full file passes 60/60 locally, with production bytes unchanged. Integration E2E passes 59 checks on each condition; all recorded daemon/ACP processes disappear after normal shutdown. Complete rows, retained slow observations, experimental cache cohorts and limitations are in the English and Chinese performance reports linked below.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | Unit, integration behavior and local performance tested |
| Windows | Not tested locally |
| Linux | Not tested locally |

### Environment

macOS arm64, Node 26.7.0, SDK 0.1.32; complete reconstructed inventory with 31 resources, 90 custom and 16 bundled Skills. Hook definitions remain present, disableAllHooks is false and external MCP discovery is filtered. No model or business-tool request is submitted. This is not latency of a deployed preproduction instance.

## Risk & Scope

- Independent warnings/reads may interleave; the returned first error retains resource order and all started reads drain. The bounded process cache retains parsed frontmatter until eviction or exit; returned values remain fresh. Conservative CLI name matches can load an extra implementation without dispatching it.
- Managed/Sandbox performance, complete model/tool behavior, every external Core consumer and a tail-latency SLA are not qualified locally. Public Core/config and cross-package scope requires normal maintainer review. This source change delivers no resolver hook, installed AOT cache or experimental GC/launcher policy.
- No new setting, daemon route or required migration. Existing readiness, authentication, trust, activation and tool decisions retain their original paths.

Designs and complete performance reports: [ACP design (English)](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/df0e055bb2a79669c60412c91ad220f9e5e375eb/docs/design/acp-first-session-startup.md); [ACP 设计（中文）](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/df0e055bb2a79669c60412c91ad220f9e5e375eb/docs/design/acp-first-session-startup.zh-CN.md); [YAML cache design (English)](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/df0e055bb2a79669c60412c91ad220f9e5e375eb/docs/design/yaml-frontmatter-parse-cache.md); [YAML 缓存设计（中文）](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/df0e055bb2a79669c60412c91ad220f9e5e375eb/docs/design/yaml-frontmatter-parse-cache.zh-CN.md); [Performance report (English)](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/df0e055bb2a79669c60412c91ad220f9e5e375eb/docs/performance/acp-initialization-evaluation.md); [性能报告（中文）](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/df0e055bb2a79669c60412c91ad220f9e5e375eb/docs/performance/acp-initialization-evaluation.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Related: #17177.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

### 本 PR 的改动

在不提前启动 channel 的前提下减少首个原生 ACP 会话的工作。Extension 的独立资源读取并行，在按原顺序返回首个错误前等待全部读取结束。ripgrep 检查与初始化重叠，在原有工具决策处等待结果，退出初始化前取消并回收检查子进程。成功的重复 YAML 输入复用容量受限的私有原始结果，调用者仍得到全新清理值。仅在需要时加载顶层命令和 export/attach 依赖，保留原有同步 builder 和 handler。

### 为什么需要

独立合并的 watcher 优化 #17177 之后，新会话仍承担模块加载、资源发现和重复解析。与同一干净 main 版本进行八对交错实验，完整首 SDK 中位数从 815.994 降到 706.277 ms，均值从 833.257 降到 719.861 ms。一对候选更慢，全部观察均保留。源码条件下没有任何首会话低于 500 ms，因此此次改善尚未完成该目标。

### Reviewer Test Plan

#### How to verify

使用包含 Extension/Skill 的目录创建全新原生 ACP 会话，验证新身份、资源和工具就绪、工作区激活、编辑/删除刷新及正常关闭。在健康检查尚未结束时中断初始化或使其失败，初始化结束前检查子进程应已回收。随后重建工具应重试失败检查。

对照帮助、命令别名、嵌套选项、必填参数错误、补全标记和退出码。重复解析 YAML 并修改返回的嵌套值，后续结果应保持独立，既有警告和调试输出仍可见。资源修改后显式刷新与新会话菜单应收敛。普通目录 GET 保留既有后台重验证和旧快照契约，不宣称采样刷新时延完全相同。

#### Evidence (Before & After)

无 UI 变化。同 main 测量，每个条件八次全新进程，完整 SDK await，无预热且 Node 代码缓存初始不存在：

| 指标 | Main | 候选 |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| 首 SDK 中位数 / 均值，ms | 815.994 / 833.257 | 706.277 / 719.861 |
| daemon spawn 到 SDK 完成中位数 / 均值，ms | 1456.511 / 1517.299 | 1385.197 / 1384.047 |
| 首 SDK 低于 500 ms | 0/8 | 0/8 |

构建、类型检查和打包通过。CLI 定向测试 1110/1110 通过；Core 为 2090/2091，既有 Extension 网络策略断言已在干净 main 与候选分别复现。后续仅修正一处受管 host 测试 spy 的可选私有参数断言，该文件本地 60/60 通过，生产字节不变。两侧整合 E2E 各通过 59 项，记录的 daemon/ACP 进程均正常关闭并消失。完整计时行、保留慢样本、实验缓存队列和限制见下方双语性能报告。

#### Tested on

| OS | 状态 |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | 已验证单测、整合行为和本地性能 |
| Windows | 未在本地验证 |
| Linux | 未在本地验证 |

#### Environment

macOS arm64、Node 26.7.0、SDK 0.1.32，完整重建清单包含 31 项资源、90 个自定义和 16 个内置 Skill。Hook 定义保留，disableAllHooks 为 false，过滤外部 MCP 发现。不提交模型或业务工具请求。这不代表已部署预发实例的时延。

### Risk & Scope

- 独立读取和警告可能交错；返回的首个错误仍按资源顺序选择，全部已启动读取结束后才退出。容量受限的进程缓存保留解析后的 frontmatter，直到淘汰或进程退出；返回值仍为新对象。CLI 名称的保守匹配可能额外加载实现，但不会派发执行。
- 本地不验证 Managed/Sandbox 性能、完整模型/工具行为、所有外部 Core 调用者或尾延迟 SLA。公开 Core/config 和跨包范围仍需正常 maintainer 评审。此次源码改动不交付 resolver hook、已安装 AOT 缓存或实验 GC/launcher 策略。
- 无新增设置、daemon 路由或必需迁移。既有 readiness、认证、信任、资源激活和工具决策保留原路径。

设计和完整性能报告：[ACP design (English)](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/df0e055bb2a79669c60412c91ad220f9e5e375eb/docs/design/acp-first-session-startup.md); [ACP 设计（中文）](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/df0e055bb2a79669c60412c91ad220f9e5e375eb/docs/design/acp-first-session-startup.zh-CN.md); [YAML cache design (English)](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/df0e055bb2a79669c60412c91ad220f9e5e375eb/docs/design/yaml-frontmatter-parse-cache.md); [YAML 缓存设计（中文）](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/df0e055bb2a79669c60412c91ad220f9e5e375eb/docs/design/yaml-frontmatter-parse-cache.zh-CN.md); [Performance report (English)](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/df0e055bb2a79669c60412c91ad220f9e5e375eb/docs/performance/acp-initialization-evaluation.md); [性能报告（中文）](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/df0e055bb2a79669c60412c91ad220f9e5e375eb/docs/performance/acp-initialization-evaluation.zh-CN.md)。

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): accept PUBLISHED as the settled state for Agent configuration reads
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The managed-session record reader now resolves the two Agent-configuration resource kinds in the settled state their publisher actually leaves them in, instead of demanding a state those rows never reach. The exemption is bounded exactly as the transaction reader bounds it: only those two kinds, only schema version 1, and only within each kind's existing byte ceiling. Every other kind still has to be referenced, and the storage-mode, object-reference, encryption and deletion-intent predicates are unchanged.

The capture guards are corrected to match the transaction reader rather than exceed it. A row whose capture state is `VERIFIED` stays readable; every other non-null capture state is refused. The first draft of this change required the capture state to be null outright, which is stricter than the transaction reader and would have refused a row shape that admission really produces.

Two regression arms are added for the paths that had no coverage: a row that has moved on to the referenced state, and an admitted captured receipt whose capture state is still set.

## Why it's needed

A public child session launched from the DAC consumer host never got past its start step. Every launch that referenced the parent's published Agent configuration failed with `Missing committed MCP resource.`, so the parent turn waited forever for a child that could never be created.

The cause is two readers of the same resource row disagreeing. The publisher writes the settled state once at session creation and never promotes these two kinds; the transaction reader already treats that state as committed for them, under its own schema-version and byte bounds. The record reader on the child-launch path still required the referenced state alone. The failure was therefore deterministic for every content-only suite launch, not a race.

## Reviewer Test Plan

Four behaviors are worth confirming, in this order:

1. A published Agent-configuration row resolves to its original bytes and digest, and the same row after it moves to the referenced state still resolves. This is the path the child launch takes.
2. The exemption does not leak. A published row of any other kind is still refused even inside its own byte ceiling, and either configuration kind is refused as soon as schema version, byte ceiling, storage mode, object reference, encryption key or deletion intent stops holding.
3. The capture guards. An admitted captured receipt — referenced, inline, capture state `VERIFIED` — stays readable, because the transaction reader accepts that shape and admission does not clear the capture state. `QUARANTINED`, `CANDIDATE` and `COLLECTED` are refused.
4. The referenced branch carries no kind whitelist. Only the published exemption is kind-bounded, so a referenced row of a tool-output kind still resolves.

### How to verify

The failure is a read-semantics mismatch, so the cheapest confirmation is at the SQL level rather than through a live launch. From `packages/managed-agent-server`, with JDK 21:

```bash
mvn -B -pl verification -am \
  -Dtest=ManagedPublishedAgentConfigurationTest -DfailIfNoTests=false \
  test checkstyle:check
```

```text
[INFO] Tests run: 4, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0, Time elapsed: 3.978 s -- in com.alibaba.qwen.code.managedagent.ManagedPublishedAgentConfigurationTest
[INFO] --- checkstyle:3.6.0:check (default-cli) @ qwen-managed-agent-persistence ---
[INFO] You have 0 Checkstyle violations.
[INFO] --- checkstyle:3.6.0:check (default-cli) @ qwen-managed-agent-verification ---
[INFO] You have 0 Checkstyle violations.
[INFO] BUILD SUCCESS
[INFO] Total time:  46.552 s
```

The MySQL counterpart inherits the same four cases and runs against a real MySQL 8.4 server, with Flyway migrating the committed schema baseline into an empty database:

```bash
mvn -B -pl verification -am \
  -Dtest=ManagedPublishedAgentConfigurationMySqlIT \
  -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false -DfailIfNoTests=false \
  -Dmysql.url='jdbc:mysql://127.0.0.1:3306/qwen_it_17207?useSSL=false&allowPublicKeyRetrieval=true&serverTimezone=UTC&characterEncoding=utf8' \
  -Dmysql.user=root -Dmysql.password= \
  test checkstyle:check
```

```text
o.f.core.internal.command.DbMigrate : Migrating schema `qwen_it_17207` to version "1 - managed schema"
[INFO] Tests run: 4, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0, Time elapsed: 5.733 s -- in com.alibaba.qwen.code.managedagent.ManagedPublishedAgentConfigurationMySqlIT
[INFO] BUILD SUCCESS
```

The server was MySQL 8.4.11 (Homebrew, arm64) starting from an empty database, so the identity binds, the binary slot literal and the whole predicate are exercised on real MySQL and not only on H2's MySQL mode.


To confirm the new arms actually pin the behavior rather than restating it, each predicate was reverted on its own, the same class re-run, and the file restored afterwards. Every mutation fails, and fails in the arm that owns it:

| Mutation | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Capture guard back to `capture_state IS NULL` (the first draft of this change) | `anAdmittedCapturedReceiptStaysReadableAndAQuarantinedOneDoesNot` errors with `Missing committed MCP resource.` — the admitted receipt becomes unreadable |
| Capture guard removed entirely | the same case fails with `Expecting code to raise a throwable.` on the `QUARANTINED` arm |
| Kind whitelist moved outside the published arm so that it also bounds referenced rows | the same case errors with `Missing committed MCP resource.` on the admitted receipt, while the other three stay green — the referenced branch must not be kind-bounded |

The capture guard is a narrowing relative to the pre-change reader, so the three suites that create non-`VERIFIED` capture rows were re-run on this revision together with the reader's own suite and one of its callers:

```bash
mvn -o -B -pl verification -am -DfailIfNoTests=false \
  -Dtest='ManagedPublishedAgentConfigurationTest,ManagedExtensionRecordStoreTest,ToolPublicationStoreTest,ToolPublicationAcknowledgementTest,ToolPublicationAsyncVerificationTest,ManagedSessionResourcesServiceTest' \
  test
```

[INFO] Tests run: 4, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0, Time elapsed: 3.732 s -- in com.alibaba.qwen.code.managedagent.ManagedPublishedAgentConfigurationTest

### Evidence (Before & After)

No TUI surface changes, so screenshots are N/A. The before/after is at the read itself, on the same published row:

|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |

macOS is this revision, locally, on both H2 and real MySQL 8.4.11. Linux is covered by CI: the fast tier ran the H2 class green on the pre-fix revision (job `132284473767`, `Tests run: 2, Failures: 0, Errors: 0`), and re-runs on this one. Windows is not exercised by this module's lanes.

### Environment (optional)

JDK 21.0.12.1 (Homebrew), Maven 3.10.0. H2 in-memory in MySQL mode for the unit class; MySQL 8.4.11 (Homebrew) for the IT, schema migrated by Flyway from `db/managed-schema`. No CLI or TUI runtime is involved.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the predicate is shared by every caller of the record reader, so the widening is deliberately bounded by kind, schema version and byte ceiling, and the negative arms pin those bounds. The capture guard is a deliberate narrowing relative to the pre-change reader for `QUARANTINED` / `CANDIDATE` / `COLLECTED` rows, matching what the transaction reader already refuses. No current caller of this reader reads those kinds — the child-result relay and the tool-result projector each use their own read — and the suites that create non-`VERIFIED` capture rows were re-run green on this revision (see How to verify). A future caller that moves a tool-outcome or manifest read onto this reader will now get that refusal instead of silently reading quarantined bytes, which is the intended direction.
- Not validated / out of scope: the end-to-end pre-prod regression is not re-run on this revision. The MySQL IT runs in CI only in the full tier, which starts on a maintainer approval, so that leg is pending CI here rather than claimed. The record reader still does not reproduce the transaction reader's refusal of capture-segment and capture-seal resource ids; that gap predates this change, and those rows are capture-slot rows that this reader's state and kind bounds already exclude. Child-result-relay binding diagnostics and close-debt are separate root causes and are deliberately not carried here.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No schema change, no API change, no migration. Already-written rows are read differently only in the two directions described above.

Scope question for the managed-direction owner: this was a draft waiting on a decision about whether to also carry the child-result-relay binding diagnostics. Staying draft was self-blocking — drafts are skipped by the review bot, the triage bot and the no-AK integration gate, so nothing routed the question to an owner. The decision taken here is to keep this change to the read-semantics fix and leave the binding diagnostics to a separate change. Please confirm that in review.

## Linked Issues

None. The failure was found in the DAC pre-production environment and no public issue tracks this symptom. The close-debt root cause referred to in the earlier draft body is investigated separately, is out of scope here, and is not linked.

prs.title: feat(headless): keep provider HTTP status on terminal error results
prs.body:
## What this PR does

A provider failure that ends a headless run now keeps the upstream HTTP status on the terminal result envelope. The machine-readable error object gains an optional `status` field carrying the provider's own status code (401, 429, 5xx), emitted only when the provider actually supplied one. Transport-level failures such as a closed socket leave the field absent rather than filling it with a sentinel.

The status travels on the same marker that already carries the formatted message out of the stream handler, so the three stream-error branches in the non-interactive runner now share one helper instead of repeating the same format/write/throw block. The status is deliberately kept separate from the process exit code, which stays 1.

## Why it's needed

Headless automation had no reliable way to tell an authentication failure from a rate limit from a provider outage. The stream event already carries the structured status, but the terminal result kept only the formatted message, so consumers had to parse `[API Error: ...]` prose and string-match status numbers out of it. That is fragile across provider wording and localization, and it breaks entirely for providers whose error text omits the code. This is the follow-up requested in the review of #8925, kept separate so the public structured-output schema could get its own review.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

The two new cases in `packages/cli/src/nonInteractiveCli.test.ts` pin both halves of the contract:

- `keeps the provider status on the stream-json terminal error result` — feeds a `LlmEventType.Error` stream event carrying `status: 429`, asserts exactly one terminal result with `subtype: error_during_execution`, `is_error: true`, the formatted message preserved, and `error.status === 429`, while the thrown marker keeps `exitCode: 1`.
- `omits the provider status when the error carries no HTTP status` — feeds an error with no status and asserts the result's error object has no `status` property at all.

To confirm the regression, I reverted only the three source files, kept the new tests, and re-ran them: the status case fails with the diff showing `+ "status": 429` missing, and passes again once the source is restored.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Non-user-visible schema change; no TUI surface. Red→green on `origin/main` with the tests kept:

```
# source reverted to origin/main, new tests kept
 × keeps the provider status on the stream-json terminal error result
   -   "status": 429,
 Tests  1 failed | 1 passed | 313 skipped (315)

# with the change
 Tests  2 passed | 313 skipped (315)
```

Full file with the change applied:

```
 ✓ src/nonInteractiveCli.test.ts (315 tests | 1 skipped) 7714ms
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  314 passed | 1 skipped (315)
```

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Local macOS worktree; unit tests run with the package's own vitest config. Full `npm run build` was not run.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: an additive field on the public structured-output result schema. Existing consumers that read only `message` are unaffected; the field is omitted rather than nulled when there is no provider status, so it cannot be mistaken for a transport-level sentinel. The status is not repurposed as an exit code, so scripts keying on exit status keep today's behavior.
- Not validated / out of scope: only `packages/cli/src/nonInteractiveCli.test.ts` was run. `packages/cli` package-level `tsc --noEmit` still reports two pre-existing `TS6305` errors about unbuilt `packages/core` outputs, unrelated to this change; `packages/core` typechecks clean. No full repository build, no Windows or Linux run.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The field is optional and additive in both JSON and stream-JSON output, including reusable session turns, which go through the same result builder.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #8967

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

provider 报错导致 headless 运行结束时，终止结果（terminal result）现在会保留上游的 HTTP 状态码。机器可读的 error 对象新增一个可选的 `status` 字段，携带 provider 自己的状态码（401、429、5xx），且只在 provider 确实提供了状态时才出现。传输层失败（例如 socket 被关闭）不会填哨兵值，而是完全不出现该字段。

状态码挂在本就负责把格式化消息带出流处理器的同一个标记上，因此非交互 runner 里的三处流错误分支改为共用一个辅助函数，不再各自重复一遍「格式化 / 写 stderr / 抛出」。状态码与进程退出码刻意保持分离，退出码仍然是 1。

## 为什么需要

headless 自动化此前无法可靠区分认证失败、限流和 provider 故障。流事件里已经带了结构化状态码，但终止结果只保留了格式化后的文本，消费方只能去解析 `[API Error: ...]` 这类文字并从中做字符串匹配。这种做法对 provider 的措辞和本地化很脆弱，遇到错误文本里不带状态码的 provider 更是完全失效。这是 #8925 review 中提出的后续项，单独拆出来以便公共结构化输出的 schema 变化能单独评审。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

`packages/cli/src/nonInteractiveCli.test.ts` 中新增的两个用例分别固定了契约的两半：

- `keeps the provider status on the stream-json terminal error result` —— 喂入带 `status: 429` 的 `LlmEventType.Error` 流事件，断言只产生一个终止结果，`subtype: error_during_execution`、`is_error: true`、格式化消息保持不变，且 `error.status === 429`；同时抛出的标记保留 `exitCode: 1`。
- `omits the provider status when the error carries no HTTP status` —— 喂入不带状态的错误，断言结果的 error 对象上根本没有 `status` 属性。

为确认这是回归，我只把三个源文件还原到 `origin/main`、保留新测试后重跑：状态用例失败，diff 显示缺少 `+ "status": 429`；恢复源码后重新通过。

### 证据（前后对比）

不可见的 schema 变更，没有 TUI 表现。保留测试、把源码还原到 `origin/main` 的红→绿对照：

```
# 源码还原到 origin/main，保留新测试
 × keeps the provider status on the stream-json terminal error result
   -   "status": 429,
 Tests  1 failed | 1 passed | 313 skipped (315)

# 应用改动后
 Tests  2 passed | 313 skipped (315)
```

应用改动后整份文件：

```
 ✓ src/nonInteractiveCli.test.ts (315 tests | 1 skipped) 7714ms
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  314 passed | 1 skipped (315)
```

### 测试环境

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 环境（可选）

本机 macOS worktree，单测使用该包自带的 vitest 配置。未运行完整 `npm run build`。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：这是公共结构化输出结果 schema 上的一个新增字段。只读取 `message` 的既有消费方不受影响；没有 provider 状态时字段是「不出现」而非 null，因此不会被误认为传输层哨兵。状态码没有被当作退出码使用，依赖退出状态判断的脚本行为保持不变。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：只运行了 `packages/cli/src/nonInteractiveCli.test.ts`。`packages/cli` 包级 `tsc --noEmit` 仍报两个既有的 `TS6305` 错误（`packages/core` 产物未构建），与本次改动无关；`packages/core` 类型检查干净通过。未跑全仓构建，未在 Windows / Linux 上运行。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。该字段在 JSON 与 stream-JSON 输出中都是可选新增；可复用 session turn 走的是同一个结果构造函数。

## 关联 issue

prs.title: fix(web-shell): fit the todo detail tooltip to its column and open the panel from it
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The todo hover tooltip — the full todo list that appears above the "Step N / M" pill in the Web Shell bottom bar — now sizes itself to the column it lives in instead of the browser viewport, and it opens the same tasks/workflow panel that the pill opens when clicked.

Concretely, three small changes in `TodoPanel`:

1. `.detail` (the tooltip) width changes from `min(560px, calc(100vw - 48px))` to `min(560px, 100%)`.
2. `position: relative` is removed from `.panel`. The tooltip is absolutely positioned and was centered against the fit-content pill wrapper; with the wrapper no longer a containing block, it resolves against the bottom-panels container, which spans the full column width. In wide layouts the rendered position is unchanged.
3. The tooltip list takes the same `onOpen` callback the pill uses (`onClick` on the list), plus a pointer cursor — only when a handler is present, so a non-clickable list (session workflow disabled) keeps the default cursor and stays inert.

Three regression tests pin the new behavior: clicking the list calls `onOpen`, the pointer affordance is present exactly when `onOpen` is provided, and the list stays inert without it.

## Why it's needed

In split view, a pane's bottom bar is often much narrower than the viewport. The tooltip was still sized against `100vw` (560px in a ~420px column) and centered against the fit-content pill wrapper, so the pane's `overflow: hidden` clipped it on both sides — in the reporter's ~422px pane, ~69px was cut off per side; in my CDP reproduction in a 469px pane, 46px on the left and 45px on the right, with the start of every row (and the status icons) lost. Separately, the list itself could not be clicked: it is a `role="tooltip"` with no handler, so the only way to open the panel was the small pill — awkward when the point of hovering the pill is to read the full list.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

In a session with an active todo list:

1. Split the view (or use any narrow pane, under 560px wide) and hover the "Step N / M" pill. The tooltip should span the pane width, show every row's icon and full text, and not be clipped by the pane edge.
2. Click the tooltip list — in a pane where the pill itself is clickable (e.g. a single view) — and the tasks panel opens (or the workflow inspector, when Session Workflow is enabled), the same target the pill opens. In a split pane the nested pane currently does not pass `onOpen` to the panel, so neither the pill nor the list is clickable there (pre-existing behavior, unchanged by this PR).
3. In a wide pane the tooltip stays 560px, centered above the pill, as before.
4. With Session Workflow disabled the tooltip renders as before but has no pointer cursor, and clicking it does nothing.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Same session, split-view pane (~469px in the captures below; ~422px in the reporter's setup):

**Before — 560px box clipped by the 469px pane (46px left / 45px right; ~69px per side in the reporter's 422px pane)**

![Before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4ekuct25/qwen-code/images/16970-todo-tooltip/docs/screenshots/todo-tooltip-16970/before.png)

**After — tooltip spans the pane, full rows, pointer cursor**

![After](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4ekuct25/qwen-code/images/16970-todo-tooltip/docs/screenshots/todo-tooltip-16970/after.png)

**After, single view — clicking the list opens the same panel the pill opens**

![After — click opens the panel](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4ekuct25/qwen-code/images/16970-todo-tooltip/docs/screenshots/todo-tooltip-16970/after-click.png)

Before: the tooltip measured 560px inside the 469px pane, centered on the fit-content pill wrapper, clipped by the pane's `overflow: hidden` (46px left / 45px right); the list had no click handler and the default cursor. After: the tooltip measures the pane width (467px in the 469px pane), both row icons and full text are visible, the cursor is a pointer, and clicking the list opens the tasks panel. Clickability follows the pill: wherever the pill receives `onOpen` (single view) the list is clickable; in split panes the nested pane's `TodoPanel` currently receives no `onOpen` at all, so the pill itself is a plain non-clickable label there — pre-existing behavior, out of scope here. Automated evidence: 6 TodoPanel tests (3 new) pass; full web-shell client vitest suite, package typecheck, ESLint, and Prettier pass on Linux (node:22-bookworm) — see the `upstream-pr-check` summary attached here.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

macOS: Web Shell of the local runtime, driven over CDP — split-pane captures at a 1024px window, click capture in a 1280px single view. Linux: `upstream-pr-check` container (node:22-bookworm) — install, build, vitest, tsc, eslint, prettier. Windows: pending (UTM VM pass scheduled after the other legs).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: removing `position: relative` changes the tooltip's containing block from the pill wrapper to the bottom-panels container. The wrapper is the container's only child and the container has no padding, so the tooltip's anchor (top of the bar, centered) is unchanged; the only rendered difference in wide layouts is none (560px cap still wins). `.detail` is the only absolutely positioned child of `.panel`.
- Not validated / out of scope: Windows pass (pending); embedded hosts other than the split-view pane are reasoned about via the wide-layout invariance rather than a separate capture.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #16970.

4. 会话工作流关闭时浮窗渲染不变，但无 pointer 光标，点击无反应。

### 证据（改动前后）

同一会话、分栏（下方截图为 ~469px 栏；报告者环境为 ~422px）：

**改动前 — 560px 浮窗被 469px 栏裁切（左 46px / 右 45px；报告者 422px 栏中每侧 ~69px）**

![改动前](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4ekuct25/qwen-code/images/16970-todo-tooltip/docs/screenshots/todo-tooltip-16970/before.png)

**改动后 — 浮窗铺满栏宽，行完整，pointer 光标**

**改动后（单栏视图）— 点击列表打开与徽章相同的面板**

改动前：浮窗在 469px 栏中宽 560px、相对 fit-content 外壳居中，被栏的 `overflow: hidden` 裁切（左 46px / 右 45px）；列表无点击处理函数、默认光标。改动后：浮窗宽度等于栏宽（469px 栏中为 467px），行图标与完整文本可见，光标为 pointer，点击列表打开任务面板。可点击性跟随徽章：凡是徽章收到 `onOpen` 的地方（单栏视图）列表即可点击；分栏中嵌套面板的 `TodoPanel` 目前完全不接收 `onOpen`，徽章本身也是不可点击的纯标签——既有行为，不在本 PR 范围。自动化证据：TodoPanel 共 6 个测试（新增 3 个）通过；完整 web-shell client vitest 套件、包级类型检查、ESLint、Prettier 在 Linux（node:22-bookworm）容器通过——见附上的 `upstream-pr-check` 摘要。

prs.title: feat(web-shell): make the local files bridge easier to discover and use
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Improves the usability of the Web Shell **Local files** entry (the client-files bridge, whose relay foundation is already on `main`). It makes the bridge's state visible at a glance and shortens the common paths, without changing the session scoping, trust gating, or held-elsewhere semantics of the bridge.

Concretely, the Local files entry now: colors the trigger dot by state (failed = red, needs-gesture / reconnecting = amber, connected = primary) and shows a state-aware tooltip naming the directory instead of a static label; offers a one-step **Change directory…** action while connected (a cancelled or failed re-pick keeps the running bridge); raises a one-time warning toast when a stored grant falls back to needing re-authorization, so it is not discovered only by opening the popover; names the bound session in the connected panel and offers **New session** when none exists; and turns the blockers into actions — one-click copy of the daemon startup command and of a derived SSH tunnel command, clearer ineligible-workspace copy, and a **Retry** label for a failed bridge that still has a grant. The popover panel stays prop-driven and hook-free, and both the daemon and Managed entries share the new affordances.

## Why it's needed

The Local files bridge worked, but its state was nearly invisible (a 16px icon with a 1.5px dot shown only while connected/busy, and no dot at all on failure), changing the granted directory took disconnect-then-reconnect, a grant needing re-authorization after a reload was only discoverable by opening the popover, the panel never said which session was bound, and several blockers explained the cause without giving the fix. These made a safety-relevant feature (the agent reading/writing the user's local disk) harder to understand and operate than it should be.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Unit suites (run from `packages/web-shell`, Node 22/24): `npx vitest run client/components/LocalFilesPanel.test.tsx client/components/LocalFilesControl.test.tsx client/components/ManagedLocalFilesControl.test.tsx client/local-files/useLocalFilesBridge.test.tsx client/local-files/useManagedLocalFilesBridge.test.tsx client/components/sidebar/WebShellSidebar.local-files-footer.test.tsx client/i18n.test.ts`. Expected: all green, including new affordance/zh-matrix tests, trigger dot/tooltip tests, toast-dedupe and copy/new-session wiring tests, and `forcePicker` hook tests (re-pick, cancel/failure keep the running bridge) on both the daemon and Managed hooks. Real-browser E2E: `npx playwright test client/e2e/managed-local-files.spec.ts --project=chromium` (asserts the connected panel names the session and offers Change directory…).

Live end-to-end (real daemon, not the mock peer): start `qwen serve` with `QWEN_SERVE_CLIENT_MCP_OVER_WS=1` on loopback serving the built web-shell same-origin, create a session, open Local files (in the sidebar footer "More" menu), connect a directory. Expected: panel shows Connected, the directory, a "Session: <title>" row, the registered tool count, and Change directory…; clicking Change directory re-opens the picker and stays connected; Disconnect returns to Not connected. Against a daemon without the feature, the panel shows the unsupported-daemon blocker and a Copy startup command button that copies `QWEN_SERVE_CLIENT_MCP_OVER_WS=1 qwen serve` and raises a "Command copied" toast.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the trigger tooltip was the static "Local files" regardless of state; a connected panel showed only the directory, tool count, and Disconnect; a failed bridge had no dot and its button read "Connect a directory…". After (real daemon + real Chromium, zero page errors): tooltip "Local files — Connected (my-dir)"; connected panel shows "Session: say ok", 4 tools, Change directory…; change-directory re-invoked the picker (pick calls 1→2) and stayed Connected; disconnect returned to "Not connected"; the feature-less daemon showed the Copy startup command button which copied the exact command and toasted "Command copied". Screenshots are posted in the verification report comment below.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Real `qwen serve` daemon (isolated HOME, loopback, `--require-auth`, `QWEN_SERVE_CLIENT_MCP_OVER_WS=1`) with a minimal mock OpenAI-compatible model so a session can spawn without a real API key; the built web-shell served same-origin; headless Chromium driven by Playwright with a `showDirectoryPicker` stub. Unit tests under vitest (jsdom).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: `forcePicker` touches the grant-acquisition lifecycle in both bridge hooks; it only skips stored-handle reuse and reuses the existing picker/save/rebuild path and its race guards (generation/stale checks, re-entrancy guard on the Managed hook), and a cancelled/failed re-pick deliberately preserves the running bridge's status. Covered by hook tests on both the daemon (mocked socket) and Managed (real relay peer) paths.
- Not validated / out of scope: the needs-gesture warning toast and the insecure-context tunnel copy were verified by unit tests but not in the live run (they need a persisted grant with `prompt` permission / a non-loopback origin, which the picker stub cannot produce); WebKit/mobile legs were not run locally. No takeover of a held-elsewhere bridge, no new tools, no read-only mode, no change to session scoping or trust gating.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; `connect()` gains an optional argument and the panel gains optional props, so existing callers are unchanged.

Design documents (both languages, complete and synchronized): [English](docs/design/2026-11-14-local-files-usability.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-11-14-local-files-usability.zh-CN.md). The bridge foundation is described in [2026-09-03-client-filesystem-bridge.md](docs/design/2026-09-03-client-filesystem-bridge.md).

## Linked Issues

N/A

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

改进 Web Shell **本地文件**入口（client-files 桥，其 relay 基础已在 `main` 上）的易用性。让桥的状态一目了然、缩短常见操作路径，且不改变桥的会话作用域、信任门禁或 held-elsewhere 语义。

具体而言，本地文件入口现在：按状态给触发器圆点着色（失败=红、需重新授权/重连中=琥珀、已连接=主色），tooltip 显示状态与目录名而非固定标签；已连接时提供一步「更换目录…」（取消或失败的重选会保留仍在运行的桥）；当存储授权回落到需要重新授权时触发一次性警告 toast，不必打开 popover 才能发现；已连接面板点名绑定会话，无会话时提供「新建会话」；并把阻断变为动作——一键复制 daemon 启动命令与推导出的 SSH 隧道命令、更清晰的工作区不可用文案、带授权的失败桥显示「重试」。popover 面板保持 prop 驱动、无 hook，daemon 与 Managed 两个入口共享这些新可供性。

## 为什么需要

本地文件桥原本可用，但状态几乎不可见（16px 图标只在已连接/忙碌时显示 1.5px 圆点，失败时完全没有圆点）；更换授权目录要先断开再连接；刷新后需要重新授权的授权只有打开 popover 才能发现；面板从不说明绑定的是哪个会话；若干阻断只解释原因不给修复动作。这让一个安全相关的功能（agent 读写用户本地磁盘）比应有的更难理解和操作。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

单元套件（在 `packages/web-shell` 下、Node 22/24 运行）：`npx vitest run client/components/LocalFilesPanel.test.tsx client/components/LocalFilesControl.test.tsx client/components/ManagedLocalFilesControl.test.tsx client/local-files/useLocalFilesBridge.test.tsx client/local-files/useManagedLocalFilesBridge.test.tsx client/components/sidebar/WebShellSidebar.local-files-footer.test.tsx client/i18n.test.ts`。预期全绿，含新增可供性/中文矩阵、触发器圆点/tooltip、toast 去重与复制/新建会话接线、`forcePicker` hook 测试（重选、取消/失败保留运行中桥），覆盖 daemon 与 Managed 两个 hook。真实浏览器 E2E：`npx playwright test client/e2e/managed-local-files.spec.ts --project=chromium`（断言已连接面板点名会话并提供更换目录）。

真实端到端（真实 daemon，非 mock peer）：以 `QWEN_SERVE_CLIENT_MCP_OVER_WS=1` 在回环地址启动 `qwen serve` 并同源伺服构建后的 web-shell，创建会话，打开本地文件（侧边栏 footer「More」菜单），连接目录。预期：面板显示已连接、目录、「会话: <标题>」行、注册工具数与「更换目录…」；点更换目录重新打开选择器并保持连接；断开回到未连接。对未启用该特性的 daemon，面板显示 unsupported-daemon 阻断与「复制启动命令」按钮，复制 `QWEN_SERVE_CLIENT_MCP_OVER_WS=1 qwen serve` 并弹「命令已复制」toast。

### 证据（改动前后）

改动前：tooltip 无论状态都是固定「Local files」；已连接面板只有目录、工具数与断开；失败桥无圆点、按钮为「连接目录…」。改动后（真实 daemon + 真实 Chromium，零页面错误）：tooltip「Local files — Connected (my-dir)」；已连接面板显示「Session: say ok」、4 个工具、更换目录…；更换目录使选择器调用 1→2 并保持连接；断开回到「Not connected」；未启用特性的 daemon 显示复制启动命令按钮，复制了准确命令并弹「Command copied」。截图见下方验证报告评论。

### 测试平台

macOS ⚠️ 未测 · Windows ⚠️ 未测 · Linux ✅ 已测。

### 环境

真实 `qwen serve` daemon（隔离 HOME、回环、`--require-auth`、`QWEN_SERVE_CLIENT_MCP_OVER_WS=1`）+ 最小 mock OpenAI 兼容模型（无需真实 API key 即可 spawn 会话）；构建后的 web-shell 同源伺服；Playwright 驱动无头 Chromium，`showDirectoryPicker` 用桩。单测为 vitest（jsdom）。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/权衡：`forcePicker` 触及两个桥 hook 的授权获取生命周期；它只跳过存储句柄复用，复用既有选择/保存/重建路径及其竞态守卫（generation/stale 检查、Managed hook 的重入守卫），取消/失败的重选刻意保留运行中桥的状态。daemon（mock socket）与 Managed（真实 relay peer）两条路径均有 hook 测试覆盖。
- 未验证/范围外：needs-gesture 警告 toast 与 insecure-context 隧道复制由单测验证、未在真实环境跑（需要持久化的 `prompt` 授权/非回环源，选择器桩无法产生）；WebKit/移动端本机未跑。不接管 held-elsewhere 桥、不新增工具、无只读模式、不改会话作用域或信任门禁。
- 破坏性变更/迁移：无；`connect()` 增加可选参数、面板增加可选 props，既有调用方不变。

设计文档（中英完整同步）：[英文](docs/design/2026-11-14-local-files-usability.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-11-14-local-files-usability.zh-CN.md)。桥基础见 [2026-09-03-client-filesystem-bridge.md](docs/design/2026-09-03-client-filesystem-bridge.md)。

## 关联 Issue

无

</details>

prs.body:
## What

Adds a first-party **Todos** page to the qwen serve Web Shell (sidebar entry → full page → daemon route, the Goals / Scheduled Tasks pattern) that aggregates every session's native todo list (`<runtimeBaseDir>/todos/<sessionId>.json`) across all projects.

Closes #14236

## Why

Todos are per-session: once a session ends its list is invisible, and there is no way to see open work across projects from the Web Shell. This surfaced repeatedly while juggling multiple workspaces — the unfinished items live in dead sessions nobody reopens.

## How

- `GET /todos` (read-only): aggregates the native todo store, attributing each session to its project cwd — live session registry first, per-project `chats/<sessionId>.runtime.json` `work_dir` as fallback, `(unmapped project)` otherwise. Sessions whose todos are all completed are excluded unless `?all=1`.
- `POST /todos/update` (non-strict `mutate()` gate, same capability class as scheduled-task edits): flips exactly one todo status and/or sets a due date. Due dates live in a **sidecar overlay** (`todos/due-dates.json`, keyed `sessionId:todoId` → `YYYY-MM-DD`): `todo_write` rewrites its whole file from the agent's list, so an extra field stored inside a native file would be silently dropped on the next write. The overlay never touches native files.
- Web Shell: `TodosDialog` with three views —
  - **Kanban** — Pending / In progress / Completed columns; drag a card between columns to change status (native HTML5 DnD; ✓ / ▶ card buttons as the no-drag fallback).
  - **Agenda** — Today / Next week (+7d) / Next month (+31d) / Later / No due date buckets, sorted by due date, red *overdue* chips.
  - **Project** — project picker scopes the board to a single project.
  - Per-card due-date editor (date picker + clear), search across content and project paths, en + zh-CN strings.
- Follows existing conventions throughout: route module in `packages/cli/src/serve/routes/` (modeled on `goals.ts`), page id in `WEB_SHELL_PAGES`, `MainView`/navigation mappings, `WebShellSidebarPrimaryNavItem`, workspace-actions client (`listTodos` / `updateTodo` modeled on `listGoals`), CSS module with `:global(.theme-light)` overrides.

## Testing

- Live workspace verification: 121 stored sessions across ~10 projects — aggregation + cwd attribution correct; status flip and due-date set/clear round-trip verified through the API (`before`/`after` echoed, overlay persisted then cleared).
- `packages/web-shell` typecheck + vite build clean; targeted suites pass: i18n (incl. en/zh parity), navigation — 72 tests green.
- Manual: full page exercised in a browser against a dev daemon — all three views, drag-and-drop, due-date editing, theme light/dark.

## Screenshots

To follow in comments (kanban / agenda / project views) — happy to add any specific flow maintainers want to see.

prs.title: fix(qqbot): accept QQ voice attachments from the voice CDN
prs.body:
## What this PR does

A voice message sent to the QQ bot in a direct chat never arrives as audio. The agent sees an empty turn and replies that it received nothing. An image sent in the same chat is still downloaded and kept. Converted voice WAVs are served from qqbot.ugcimg.cn, and the attachment download only allowed hosts ending in .qq.com or .qq.com.cn. That host matched neither suffix, so the download refused the URL and the voice file was skipped instead of stored.

Images stay on hosts the suffix list already covered, which is why only voice failed.

The download guard now allows the exact host qqbot.ugcimg.cn after lowercasing the hostname, and still rejects every other ugcimg.cn name, including other subdomains and lookalikes. The voice WAV fixture uses that host, and the download tests cover a successful fetch of converted-voice bytes (including an uppercase host), a non-https URL on that host, and the lookalike hosts that must stay blocked. Redirects are still rejected. There are no breaking changes and no migration: previously allowlisted hosts behave as before, and only this one voice CDN host is newly accepted.

Because this is a host-level fix, file, image, and video attachments from the same exact host also pass the host check; their other download checks still apply. This does not establish whether QQ serves those attachment types from this host.

## Why it's needed

#15334 reports a real QQ direct-chat failure: `skipping voice attachment: attachment host not allowed: qqbot.ugcimg.cn`. Allowing this observed host restores the converted-voice download path without allowing every subdomain of ugcimg.cn.

## Reviewer Test Plan

Tests for the qwen-code downloadQQAttachment change live in `packages/channels/qqbot/src/events.test.ts` and `packages/channels/qqbot/src/media.test.ts`.
The targeted tests for the qwen-code downloadQQAttachment change pass locally.
The tests in `packages/channels/qqbot/src/events.test.ts` and `packages/channels/qqbot/src/media.test.ts` fail without the fix in the qwen-code downloadQQAttachment change (checked by reverting the source changes).

### How to verify

Covered in the summary above.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Wenshao's verification report for head `4882a8e96eb288d8978a61a787a356e0df166e1d` records 3 failures when the PR tests run against base source and 155/155 passing against head. The base voice case drops the attachment and produces `(User sent media but download failed)`.

The report also records a real-fetch/TLS harness: base rejects the voice CDN before fetching; head downloads the 16-byte WAV. Both arms retain the tested HTTPS, redirect, lookalike-host, and size restrictions. The full qqbot package passed 380/380 tests at that head and on a trial merge; eslint, prettier, and TypeScript checks passed on the trial merge.

These results apply to the reported commits, not the later head `d48b1c39873356fac03c30672df623a377267b54`. They verify the download/storage path, not live QQ delivery or model-side audio understanding.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | No result recorded; CI lane skipped at verified head `4882a8e`. |
| 🪟 Windows | No result recorded; CI lane skipped at verified head `4882a8e`. |
|  🐧 Linux  | Ubuntu Node 22.x test check passed at `4882a8e`, according to the finalized CI table. |

### Environment (optional)

Nothing to add for this change.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: This expands the outbound-fetch allowlist by one exact host. Any additional voice CDN host requires a separate entry; unknown hosts continue to fail closed. HTTPS, redirect rejection, and size limits remain in place.
- Not validated / out of scope: Live QQ platform delivery, other possible voice CDN hosts, model-side audio handling, and QQ WebSocket gateway behavior. The independent verification covered the qqbot package, not the repository-wide suite; macOS and Windows CI lanes were skipped at the verified head.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None. Existing allowlisted hosts retain their behavior; only qqbot.ugcimg.cn is newly accepted.

## Linked Issues

Closes #15334

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

修复 QQ 私聊语音附件因转换后的 WAV 来自 qqbot.ugcimg.cn 而被主机白名单拒绝的问题。仅放行该精确主机，不放行整个 ugcimg.cn 域；HTTPS、禁止重定向和大小限制保持不变。同一主机上的其他附件类型也适用该主机校验修复。

独立验证报告在提交 4882a8e 上记录了目标测试 155/155 通过，base 源码运行相同测试时有 3 项失败；qqbot 包测试 380/380 通过。真实 fetch/TLS 测试验证了下载路径，但未使用真实 QQ 账号验证平台下发，也未验证模型侧音频理解。这些结果不代表后续提交的验证结果。无破坏性变更，无需迁移。

</details>

prs.title: fix(core): keep persisted-output stubs out of microcompaction clearing
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Microcompaction's clearing branch treated an already-spilled `<persisted-output>` stub like any other tool result and replaced the whole `response.output` — saved-to path, sha256 digest and preview included — with the bare `[Old tool result content cleared]` placeholder. This PR treats a stub as un-clearable, so the reference to the saved file survives age-out.

## Why it's needed

The bytes stayed on disk for the 24 h cleanup window, but the reference to them was destroyed, so the recoverability the truncation path had already paid for was thrown away at age-out. It also dropped the digest line `loopDetectionService` reads for its result-aware guards.

A stub is already preview-sized, so clearing it saves almost nothing and costs the only reference to the saved file.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- `getClearableToolOutput` (new, behind the existing `getToolOutputChars`) reports a `<persisted-output>` stub's resident preview length *and* flags it `persisted`.
- The size-trigger plan counts a stub toward the total so the trigger still sees those bytes, but never selects it for clearing; it only ever joins `totalChars`, not the call sites that reclaim.
- The clearing branch re-checks the same predicate, so a stub cannot be blanked by any path.
- The idle path no longer spends a `keepRecent` slot on a stub; that slot now protects the most recent ordinary result, which the same pass would otherwise blank.

Truncations without a saved file (`... [CONTENT TRUNCATED] ...`, the `Tool output was too large…` sentinel) keep their previous behaviour — they carry no path, so there is nothing to orphan. The envelope's opening tag is now `PERSISTED_OUTPUT_STUB_PREFIX` in `tools/truncation.ts`, used by both `buildStub` and this consumer so producer and consumer cannot drift.

### The accounting change this carries

Counting a stub's resident preview in the size trigger, while never making it spendable, is a change to what the size plan sees and not only to what the clearing branch does. A history dominated by stubs still trips the trigger, but the plan can then select only ordinary results, so the watermark is a best-effort target rather than something this pass is guaranteed to reach. Stating it here because the next reader of that accounting will otherwise expect `totalChars` to fall by exactly the bytes the plan spends.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Two regressions in `microcompact.test.ts`:

- a stub plus ordinary oversized results over the size threshold: the stub survives and the ordinary results are still cleared (the size plan does not stall on it);
- an idle-path pass with `toolResultsNumToKeep: 1`: the older ordinary result keeps the slot and the stub is untouched.

Both fail on `main` and pass with the change.

```sh
npx vitest run packages/core/src/services/microcompaction/microcompact.test.ts
```

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only; no dev server or sandbox.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the size plan's totals change for histories dominated by stubs, described above. A smaller effect is that one `keepRecent` slot shifts from a stub to the most recent ordinary result.
- Not validated / out of scope: the full `npm run build`. The local `node_modules` cannot typecheck the whole package for the pre-existing reason below.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

### Local checks run

- `vitest run packages/core/src/services/microcompaction/microcompact.test.ts` — 104 passed
- `vitest run packages/core/src/core/coreToolScheduler.test.ts` — 541 passed (truncation is exercised from there)
- `vitest run` on `loopDetectionService.test.ts` + `memoryPressureMonitor.test.ts` + `fileReadCache.test.ts` — 332 passed
- `eslint` and `prettier --check` clean on the changed files
- `tsc --noEmit -p packages/core` reports no errors in the changed files. The package reports 9 pre-existing errors in `utils/fileUtils.ts`, `utils/filesearch/ignore.ts`, `utils/gitIgnoreParser.ts` and `utils/qwenIgnoreParser.ts`; these come from a stale local `node_modules` (`ignore` 5.3.2 installed against `^7.0.0`), not from this change.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #16596

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

microcompaction 的清理分支把已经落盘的 `<persisted-output>` 信封当成普通工具结果处理，把整个 `response.output`——保存路径、sha256 摘要和预览——替换成一句 `[Old tool result content cleared]`。这个 PR 把这类信封视为不可清理，于是指向已保存文件的引用不会在老化时丢掉。

## 为什么需要

字节本身在 24 小时清理窗口内还留在磁盘上，但指向它们的引用被销毁了，截断路径已经付出成本换来的可恢复性在老化时被白白丢掉。它同时还抹掉了 `loopDetectionService` 用来做结果感知判断的摘要行。

信封本身就是预览大小，清理它几乎省不下什么，却要付出唯一那条指向保存文件的引用。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- `getClearableToolOutput`（新增，挂在既有的 `getToolOutputChars` 之下）把 `<persisted-output>` 信封报告为 0 字符，*并且* 标记为 `persisted`。
- 因此按大小触发的计划永远不会把信封计入总量，也不会选中它去清理。
- 清理分支会重新检查同一个判据，所以任何路径都无法把信封清空。
- 空闲路径不再为一个信封占用 `keepRecent` 名额；该名额现在保护最近一条普通结果，而同一轮否则会把它清掉。

没有保存文件的截断（`... [CONTENT TRUNCATED] ...`、`Tool output was too large…` 哨兵）行为不变——它们不带路径，没有会被孤立的引用。信封的开头标签现在统一为 `tools/truncation.ts` 里的 `PERSISTED_OUTPUT_STUB_PREFIX`，由 `buildStub` 和这个消费方共用，生产方和消费方不会跑偏。

### 随之而来的计量变化

把信封报告为 0 字符改变的是大小计划看到的东西，不只是清理分支的行为。以信封为主的历史现在对 `pendingChars` 几乎不贡献，于是触发可能照常成立、而计划什么都选不中：没有可清理的就等于什么都不用做，这个结果是正确的，但它是计划总量上一处可见的差异，值得写给下一个读这段计量的人。

### 证据（前后对比）

`microcompact.test.ts` 里新增两条回归：

- 一个信封加若干超过大小阈值的普通结果：信封保留，普通结果照常被清理（大小计划不会卡在它上面）；
- `toolResultsNumToKeep: 1` 的空闲路径：较旧的普通结果保住名额，信封不动。

两条在 `main` 上失败、打上改动后通过。

### 测试环境

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### 运行环境（可选）

仅单元测试；没有起开发服务器或沙箱。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：以信封为主的历史，大小计划的总量会变化，见上文。次要影响是有一个 `keepRecent` 名额从信封挪给了最近一条普通结果。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：完整的 `npm run build`。本地 `node_modules` 无法对整个包做类型检查，原因见下。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

### 本地跑过的检查

- `vitest run packages/core/src/services/microcompaction/microcompact.test.ts` —— 104 通过
- `vitest run packages/core/src/core/coreToolScheduler.test.ts` —— 541 通过（截断路径从这里被覆盖）
- `vitest run` `loopDetectionService.test.ts` + `memoryPressureMonitor.test.ts` + `fileReadCache.test.ts` —— 332 通过
- 改动文件上 `eslint` 与 `prettier --check` 干净
- `tsc --noEmit -p packages/core` 在改动文件上没有报错。整包有 9 条既有错误，位于 `utils/fileUtils.ts`、`utils/filesearch/ignore.ts`、`utils/gitIgnoreParser.ts`、`utils/qwenIgnoreParser.ts`，来自本地陈旧的 `node_modules`（`ignore` 装的是 5.3.2 而声明是 `^7.0.0`），与本改动无关。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #16596

</details>

prs.title: fix(cli): keep one stream-json message id across block-type transitions
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When a single model response streams thinking and then text, the stream-json adapter splits it into two `assistant` snapshots, because one assistant message may carry only one block type. The second snapshot minted a fresh `message.id` and restarted block numbering at 0, so `--include-partial-messages` emitted one `message_start` (id A), a thinking block at index 0, then a text block at index 0 again with a snapshot carrying id B.

This PR keeps the turn's `message.id` across an intra-turn block-type change: the pending snapshot is still closed (the single-type rule is unchanged), but the continuation reuses the id and carries the block counter forward, so the text block streams at index 1.

## Why it's needed

An SDK consumer that pairs streamed blocks with the final `assistant` snapshot by `message.id` — the natural rule, and the one that works for a plain-text response — sees the text as a *second* message. The reporter's integration library rendered a 22-character answer as 44 characters against a real Model Studio endpoint, and the block index reuse makes `(message.id, index)` ambiguous even for consumers that key on both.

The issue asked for a wire-contract decision. This follows option 1 as described there: one `message.id` per model response, one `message_start`/`message_stop` pair, and the text block at index 1 so the two blocks stay distinguishable inside the single message. That is also how Claude Code's stream-json behaves, which this format follows.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Drive one turn that streams thinking and then text, with partial messages on:

```bash
qwen -p "..." --output-format stream-json --include-partial-messages
```

Before: one `message_start` with id A, `content_block_start` at index 0 twice, and two `assistant` snapshots with ids A and B.
After: one `message_start` with id A, block indexes 0 (thinking) and 1 (text), and both `assistant` snapshots carrying id A.

The two added unit tests pin exactly that: one asserts both snapshots share `message.id`, the other asserts the block indexes are `[0, 1]`. Both fail on `main` and pass with the change.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — non-UI wire-format change. Under the unfixed adapter the two new cases fail with `expected 'id-b' to be 'id-a'` and `expected [0, 0] to deeply equal [0, 1]`; with the change the suite is green.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only: `npx vitest run` from `packages/cli`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: consumers that relied on the split ids to tell the thinking snapshot from the text snapshot now get one id. They can still distinguish the snapshots by block type and by the block index range, which is what the issue asked for; the alternative (a second `message_start`/`message_stop` pair) would make a consumer counting messages or usage see two.
- Not validated / out of scope: the subagent path keeps its own per-tool-call message ids; this change only affects intra-turn transitions. `content_block_stop` for the final block is still emitted by `finalizeAssistantMessage`, unchanged.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none in the schema; the `message.id` stability is a behavioral fix.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15875

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

当一个模型响应先流式输出 thinking 再输出 text 时，stream-json 适配器会把它拆成两个 `assistant` 快照，因为一条 assistant 消息只能承载一种 block 类型。第二个快照重新生成了 `message.id`，并把 block 序号从 0 重新开始，于是 `--include-partial-messages` 会发出一个 `message_start`（id A）、一个 index 0 的 thinking 块，然后又是 index 0 的 text 块，且快照携带 id B。

本 PR 让同一轮内的 block 类型切换保留 `message.id`：待发送的快照仍然会被关闭（单类型约束不变），但续接部分复用同一个 id 并延续 block 计数，因此 text 块以 index 1 流式发出。

## 为什么需要

按 `message.id` 把流式块和最终 `assistant` 快照配对，是消费者的自然做法，纯文本响应下也一直成立。现在 text 会被当成第二条消息：提报方的集成库在真实 Model Studio 端点上把 22 字符的答案渲染成了 44 字符；而 block 序号复用也让按 `(message.id, index)` 配对的消费者无法区分两个块。

issue 里说明这需要先定线上契约。本 PR 采用其中描述的方案一：一个模型响应对应一个 `message.id`、一对 `message_start`/`message_stop`，text 块用 index 1，使两个块在同一条消息内仍可区分。这也是本格式所对齐的 Claude Code stream-json 的行为。

## 验证

用一个先 thinking 后 text 的回合，开启 partial messages：

```bash
qwen -p "..." --output-format stream-json --include-partial-messages
```

改动前：一个 id 为 A 的 `message_start`，`content_block_start` 的 index 出现两次 0，两个 `assistant` 快照 id 分别为 A、B。
改动后：一个 id 为 A 的 `message_start`，block index 为 0（thinking）与 1（text），两个快照都是 id A。

新增的两条单测分别钉住这两点：一条断言两个快照共享 `message.id`，另一条断言 block index 为 `[0, 1]`。在 `main` 上均失败，应用改动后通过。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：原先依赖 id 区分 thinking 快照与 text 快照的消费者，现在拿到同一个 id。它们仍可通过 block 类型与 block index 区间区分，这正是 issue 要求的；另一种做法（再来一对 `message_start`/`message_stop`）会让按 `message_start` 计消息或用量的消费者看到两条。
- 未覆盖：subagent 路径沿用各自的每次工具调用消息 id，本改动只影响轮内切换；最后一个块的 `content_block_stop` 仍由 `finalizeAssistantMessage` 发出，行为不变。
- 破坏性变更：schema 无变化，`message.id` 的稳定性属于行为修复。

## 关联 issue

Fixes #15875

</details>

prs.title: fix(core): keep the model name for Ollama llama4 scout and maverick tags
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Ollama's `llama4:scout` and `llama4:maverick` tags now normalize to `llama4`, so they match the existing Llama 4 vision row and keep image input, like `llama4:16x17b` and `llama4:latest` already do.

## Why it's needed

The colon handling only recognised a fixed list of right-side tags. `scout` and `maverick` were not on it, so the id was split at the colon and only the tag was kept. The model became `scout` or `maverick`, matched nothing, and image input was turned off.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

`normalize('llama4:scout')` and `normalize('llama4:maverick')` should return `llama4`, and image input should be on for both. The other Llama 4 tags behave as before. The new unit tests cover these cases.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before the fix:

```
× normalize > should keep the model name when the colon carries a variant tag
× defaultModalities > other open-weight vision models > returns image for llama4 scout tag (Ollama)
× defaultModalities > other open-weight vision models > returns image for llama4 maverick tag (Ollama)
```

prs.title: fix: enforce Read deny rules on grep and glob results
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Fixes read permission enforcement for search results by applying the same deny/ask path filtering to the default `RipGrepTool`, fallback `GrepTool`, and `GlobTool` before truncation and result formatting.

## Why it's needed

The default configured ripgrep tool could still return paths covered by read permission rules, while the legacy grep/glob paths filtered them. A read rule with `ask` also needs to be excluded from unattended search results because returning the content would bypass the read confirmation. Permission filtering now happens once per distinct search-result file, and glob retains truncation context even when the collected entries are all excluded.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Configure a read deny rule and search for a matching file.
2. Configure a read ask rule and verify the path is not returned as a readable search result.
3. Verify truncation and result counts are computed after filtering.
4. Run the targeted ripgrep, grep, and glob tests.

### Evidence (Before & After)

- Before: the default `RipGrepTool` could return denied/ask-protected paths, and glob could report a capped scan as a confident “No files found” after permission filtering.
- After: filtering runs before counts, truncation, and output generation; ripgrep and grep permission decisions are cached per file; glob reports a truncated scan when all collected entries are denied.
- Targeted ripgrep test: `pnpm --filter @qwen-code/qwen-code-core exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts src/tools/ripGrep.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false` — 81 passed, 1 skipped.
- Targeted glob test: new “reports truncation when every collected entry is denied” regression passed; the file suite had 61 passed and 13 Windows symlink-permission failures unrelated to this change.

### Tested on

| OS | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Windows 11 | ✅ Targeted tests passed; symlink-only failures are blocked by the worker's Windows symlink privilege |

## Risk & Scope

Low-to-medium risk. Search results may now omit paths that require read approval, matching the permission contract. Changes are limited to ripgrep/grep/glob filtering, shared read-rule evaluation, truncation messaging, and regression coverage.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15129

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

修复默认 `RipGrepTool`、备用 `GrepTool` 与 `GlobTool` 未执行读权限过滤的问题，并覆盖 deny/ask 规则，确保搜索结果不会绕过读取确认；同时保留 glob 截断提示，并缓存 ripgrep/grep 的按文件权限判断。

</details>

## AI Disclosure

This PR was prepared with AI assistance. The author reviewed the implementation, tests, and permission-scope impact.

prs.title: fix(cli): keep the footer mounted while messages are queued
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Keeps the footer mounted while the queued-message list is non-empty, so the "N queued" badge it already renders stays on screen for the whole time a message sits in the queue. The badge was in the footer before, but the footer was only mounted while the input was active, which is exactly the window the badge does not need to cover.

## Why it's needed

`isInputActive` goes false for the entire busy window a queued message can exist in: slash-command processing, approval-mode resets, and `WaitingForConfirmation` (the confirmation prompt is rendered outside `InputPrompt`, so the input is inactive while the user is deciding). During that window the footer — the only always-on place the "N queued" badge is drawn — unmounted (#8666). The remaining indicator, `QueuedMessageDisplay`, sits above `InputPrompt`, is short, and in VP mode can be clipped off-screen during long turns, which is the clipping family tracked in #5798/#5799. The result is that a user who pressed Ctrl+Q had nothing on screen confirming the message was registered, even though the queue state itself was intact.

With this change the footer mounts when the input is active, while configuration is still initializing (unchanged, that keeps startup progress visible), or while the queue is non-empty. The idle-and-empty state keeps the previous behavior of hiding the footer when the input is inactive.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the Composer suite:

```bash
cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/ui/components/Composer.test.tsx
```

The new case "keeps the footer mounted while messages are queued during a busy turn" renders Composer with `isInputActive: false`, `isConfigInitialized: true`, and one queued message, and asserts both the footer and the queued message are present. On `origin/main` that case fails (the footer is unmounted); with the change it passes. The sibling case "keeps the footer hidden when input is inactive and the queue is empty" pins that the new mount condition does not keep the footer on screen when nothing is queued.

### Evidence (Before & After)

`Composer.test.tsx` with the new cases, against `origin/main`:

```
× keeps the footer mounted while messages are queued during a busy turn
```

and with this branch:

```
✓ src/ui/components/Composer.test.tsx (28 tests) 406ms
```

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only, run with a local vitest config whose `globalSetup` is stubbed out (the repo's setup script needs the built `packages/cli` artifacts, which a fresh worktree does not have). No live terminal reproduction.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the footer now occupies its rows during a busy turn while something is queued, which costs vertical space at exactly the moment the terminal is busiest. That is the tradeoff the issue asks for — a persistent, perceivable indicator over a clipped one — but it is a visible layout change in VP mode.
- Not validated / out of scope: the VP-mode clipping root cause itself (stale `controlsHeight` during long turns), which the issue tracks separately; this PR only makes the badge survive that clipping. No live terminal reproduction, and Windows/Linux were not tested.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Refs #8666

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

在排队消息列表非空时保持 footer 挂载，让 footer 里已有的 "N queued" 徽标在消息排队期间始终可见。这个徽标本来就在 footer 里，但 footer 只在输入激活时才挂载，而那恰好是徽标不需要覆盖的窗口。

## 为什么需要

`isInputActive` 在排队消息可能存在的整个忙碌窗口里都是 false：斜杠命令处理、审批模式重置、以及 `WaitingForConfirmation`（确认提示渲染在 `InputPrompt` 之外，所以用户在决定时输入是未激活的）。在这个窗口里，footer —— 唯一常驻绘制 "N queued" 徽标的地方 —— 被卸载了（#8666）。剩下的指示器 `QueuedMessageDisplay` 位于 `InputPrompt` 上方，行数很少，在 VP 模式下长回合中可能被裁到屏幕外，这正是 #5798/#5799 跟踪的那类裁剪问题。结果是按下 Ctrl+Q 的用户在屏幕上得不到任何"已登记"的确认，尽管队列状态本身是完整的。

改动后 footer 在三种情况下挂载：输入激活时、配置仍在初始化时（保持不变，用于让启动进度可见）、或队列非空时。空闲且队列为空时，输入未激活则仍按原样隐藏 footer。

## 审阅验证方式

运行 Composer 测试：

```bash
cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/ui/components/Composer.test.tsx
```

新增用例 "keeps the footer mounted while messages are queued during a busy turn" 以 `isInputActive: false`、`isConfigInitialized: true` 和一条排队消息渲染 Composer，断言 footer 与排队消息都出现。在 `origin/main` 上该用例失败（footer 被卸载），改动后通过。同一组的 "keeps the footer hidden when input is inactive and the queue is empty" 则锁定：队列为空时新条件不会让 footer 常驻。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：忙碌回合且有排队消息时 footer 会占用自己的行，恰在终端最紧张时消耗垂直空间。这正是 issue 要求的取舍——宁可常驻可见也不要被裁掉——但在 VP 模式下是可见的布局变化。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：VP 模式裁剪本身的根因（长回合中 `controlsHeight` 过期），issue 单独跟踪；本 PR 只保证徽标在被裁剪时仍然存在。没有做真实终端复现，Windows/Linux 未测试。
- 破坏性变更：无。

</details>

Changelog

Sourced from codewhale-hq/Codewhale's changelog.

Changelog Archive

Older releases of Codewhale (v0.8.39 and earlier). Recent releases live in CHANGELOG.md.

[0.8.39] - 2026-05-17

Fixed

  • Feishu/Lark bridge startup order is guarded. The bridge now keeps ThreadStore initialized before startup opens persisted thread state, with a regression test to prevent moving it below its first use.
  • /model picker opens instantly with the curated list again. Reverted the v0.8.38 live-catalog rework: the picker no longer makes a blocking network call on open and once again shows the curated auto / deepseek-v4-pro / deepseek-v4-flash rows. The /models command still lists the live provider catalog.
  • "Approve for session" groups by command family again. Session approvals are keyed by a lossy, arity-aware fingerprint once more, so approving cargo build also covers cargo build --release. Denials keep the exact per-call fingerprint from #1617, so denying one call no longer over-blocks later, different calls to the same tool.
  • Docker first-run state directories are writable. The image now pre-creates /home/deepseek/.deepseek with deepseek ownership so the documented named-volume launch can create runtime thread state on first use (#1684).
  • Runtime API system prompt overrides survive the first turn. Threads created with a system_prompt override now keep that prompt through mode/context refreshes before the model request is built (#1688).
  • Compaction keeps a user text query in tool-heavy histories. Automatic compaction now pins the latest user text message when the retained tail only contains tool calls/results, avoiding OpenAI-compatible Jinja template failures on the next request (#1704).
  • Pager jumps land at the visible bottom. Pressing G or End in the pager no longer overshoots the render clamp, so k/Up scrolls upward immediately afterward, and mouse wheels now scroll pager overlays directly (#1706, #1716).
  • Mouse-wheel-as-arrow scrolling preserves composer drafts. When composer_arrows_scroll is enabled, Up/Down now scroll the transcript even with text in the composer instead of replacing the draft with input history (#1677).
  • Multiline composer arrows move between input lines. Plain Up/Down now move the cursor within multiline drafts before falling back to input history, while single-line mouse-wheel-as-arrow scrolling remains unchanged (#1721).
  • Third-party reasoning_content streams no longer corrupt text output. Generic OpenAI-compatible providers that stream answer text in reasoning_content now render it as normal text unless the selected provider is one whose reasoning-content semantics are supported (#1673).
  • macOS system theme detection recognizes Light mode. When COLORFGBG is missing or unusable, theme = "system" now falls back to macOS appearance detection and treats a missing AppleInterfaceStyle key as Light mode

prs.body:
Bumps [codewhale-hq/Codewhale/scripts/github-action/publish](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/codewhale) from b0b2b9a335cc1d24abe8a087189bed080d1cc3db to 43c87b459914d58e056e207b99b270ba5ddebe74.
Changelog

Sourced from codewhale-hq/Codewhale/scripts/github-action/publish's changelog.

Changelog Archive

Older releases of Codewhale (v0.8.39 and earlier). Recent releases live in CHANGELOG.md.

[0.8.39] - 2026-05-17

Fixed

  • Feishu/Lark bridge startup order is guarded. The bridge now keeps ThreadStore initialized before startup opens persisted thread state, with a regression test to prevent moving it below its first use.
  • /model picker opens instantly with the curated list again. Reverted the v0.8.38 live-catalog rework: the picker no longer makes a blocking network call on open and once again shows the curated auto / deepseek-v4-pro / deepseek-v4-flash rows. The /models command still lists the live provider catalog.
  • "Approve for session" groups by command family again. Session approvals are keyed by a lossy, arity-aware fingerprint once more, so approving cargo build also covers cargo build --release. Denials keep the exact per-call fingerprint from #1617, so denying one call no longer over-blocks later, different calls to the same tool.
  • Docker first-run state directories are writable. The image now pre-creates /home/deepseek/.deepseek with deepseek ownership so the documented named-volume launch can create runtime thread state on first use (#1684).
  • Runtime API system prompt overrides survive the first turn. Threads created with a system_prompt override now keep that prompt through mode/context refreshes before the model request is built (#1688).
  • Compaction keeps a user text query in tool-heavy histories. Automatic compaction now pins the latest user text message when the retained tail only contains tool calls/results, avoiding OpenAI-compatible Jinja template failures on the next request (#1704).
  • Pager jumps land at the visible bottom. Pressing G or End in the pager no longer overshoots the render clamp, so k/Up scrolls upward immediately afterward, and mouse wheels now scroll pager overlays directly (#1706, #1716).
  • Mouse-wheel-as-arrow scrolling preserves composer drafts. When composer_arrows_scroll is enabled, Up/Down now scroll the transcript even with text in the composer instead of replacing the draft with input history (#1677).
  • Multiline composer arrows move between input lines. Plain Up/Down now move the cursor within multiline drafts before falling back to input history, while single-line mouse-wheel-as-arrow scrolling remains unchanged (#1721).
  • Third-party reasoning_content streams no longer corrupt text output. Generic OpenAI-compatible providers that stream answer text in reasoning_content now render it as normal text unless the selected provider is one whose reasoning-content semantics are supported (#1673).
  • macOS system theme detection recognizes Light mode. When COLORFGBG is missing or unusable, theme = "system" now falls back to macOS appearance detection and treats a missing AppleInterfaceStyle key as Light mode

prs.title: fix(net): match network entries written as internationalized domains
prs.body:
**This touches network policy, which CONTRIBUTING lists as trust-boundary surface that needs maintainer sign-off first.** I opened #7302 with the reproduction before this PR. Please confirm the direction (compare entries and hosts in the IDNA ASCII form) before reviewing the code; I am happy to change the approach or close this if you prefer to handle it yourselves.

## What and why

A `[network]` entry written with a non-ASCII domain never matched (`crates/net/src/network_policy.rs`). With `deny = ["例子.com"]`, `https://例子.com/` was allowed under `default = "allow"` and prompted under `prompt`. `/network deny 例子.com` writes exactly such an entry. Allow entries never matched either.

- **Root cause**: hosts reach `NetworkPolicy::decide` from `Url::host_str`, which returns the IDNA ASCII form (`xn--fsqu00a.com`). `normalize_host` only lowercased ASCII, so an entry typed as `例子.com`, `*.中国` or `BÜCHER.de` was compared in a different form from the host.
- **Fix**: `normalize_host` converts a non-ASCII name to the URL parser's ASCII form, so entries and hosts use the same form. The `*.` / `.` wildcard prefix is kept. ASCII entries take the same path as before and are unchanged. A name the URL parser rejects is kept as written, as before.

## Where this came from

Closes #7302

## How I tested it

- New regression test `deny_entries_match_internationalized_domain_names` (`例子.com`, `*.中国`, `BÜCHER.de`). It fails on `main` (`https://例子.com/` -> `Allow`) and passes with the fix.
- `cargo test -p codewhale-net --lib`: 73 passed, 1 ignored, 0 failed
- `cargo clippy -p codewhale-net --all-targets`: clean
- `cargo fmt --all -- --check`: clean

## Checklist

- [x] One focused change, started from current `main` (no need to rebase when `main` moves)
- [x] `cargo fmt --all` passes, and tests cover new or changed behavior
- [ ] If this adds or changes a user-facing feature, I updated its docs and its row in `docs/features.toml` (not applicable: bug fix only)

prs.title: fix(sanitize): mask provider keys written next to CJK text
prs.body:
## What and why

The bare-token pass of `redact_secrets` and `redact_model_bound_secrets` (`crates/sanitize/src/redact.rs`, also the last step of `sanitize_text`) missed provider keys written in CJK prose:

- `密钥：sk-…`, `我的密钥是sk-…`, `（ghp_…）` and a key after U+3000 passed through unmasked.
- `sk-…，然后重试` was masked together with the Chinese text after it.

- **Root cause**: the pass split a line on ASCII spaces and trimmed only ASCII punctuation from each word. CJK text puts no space around a key, so the key and the text around it formed one word that matched no token shape.
- **Fix**: credential tokens are ASCII, so each word is now checked one ASCII run at a time, with the existing trims and token shapes. Each run that is a token is masked, and the non-ASCII text around it is kept. An ASCII-only word is a single run and is handled exactly as before.

Not covered here, as the issue says: keyed assignments with a full-width colon and a non-prefixed value (`password：hunter2`) and Chinese key names (`密码=…`). Those need vocabulary decisions, not a split fix.

## Where this came from

Closes #7301

## How I tested it

- New regression test `a_bare_token_next_to_cjk_text_or_full_width_punctuation_is_masked`. It fails on `main` (`密钥：sk-…` unchanged) and passes with the fix.
- `cargo test -p codewhale-sanitize --lib`: 12 passed, 0 failed
- `cargo test -p codewhale-config redact`: 37 passed, 0 failed
- `cargo test -p codewhale-secrets`: 55 + 1 passed, 0 failed
- `cargo clippy -p codewhale-sanitize --all-targets`: clean
- `cargo fmt --all -- --check`: clean

## Checklist

- [x] One focused change, started from current `main` (no need to rebase when `main` moves)
- [x] `cargo fmt --all` passes, and tests cover new or changed behavior
- [ ] If this adds or changes a user-facing feature, I updated its docs and its row in `docs/features.toml` (not applicable: bug fix only)
